title: Operations & Documentation Executive (Entry-Level)
description:
**Company**
: Wayver, Advocates & Solicitors

**Location:**
Okhla, New Delhi (On-site)

**Experience:**
Freshers or 0–2 years

**About Us**

Wayver is a corporate and intellectual property law firm based in New Delhi. We are a growing, technology-driven team that believes in organised workflows, efficient systems and attention to detail.We are looking for a smart, organised and tech-savvy individual to assist with documentation, data management, online applications and day-to-day operations.

This is an excellent opportunity for a graduate looking to build practical experience in a professional environment while learning new skills and digital tools.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Maintain and update records, spreadsheets, trackers and internal databases.
* Prepare, organise and manage documents, forms and correspondence.
* Assist with online applications and filings, including applications on the Indian Trade Marks Registry portal.
* Enter and verify client information, application details and supporting documents.
* Monitor application statuses, deadlines and pending tasks through our internal tracking system.
* Draft routine professional emails, letters and notices using approved templates under supervision.
* Assist with preparing cease-and-desist letters and other standard documents for lawyer review.
* Use Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, Word, PDF tools and AI-powered applications for daily tasks.
* Maintain organised digital records and ensure timely follow-ups.

**Who We're Looking For**

* Education: B.Com, B.A., B.Sc., BBA or an equivalent bachelor's degree.
* Experience: Fresh graduates are welcome. Previous administrative experience is a plus.
* Good written and spoken English.
* Comfortable using computers, spreadsheets and online platforms.
* Strong attention to detail and the ability to identify errors in documents and data.
* Organised, responsible and capable of managing multiple tasks.
* Quick learner who enjoys working with technology and digital tools.
* Willingness to follow established processes and learn new systems.

**No legal qualification, law degree or previous experience in the legal industry is required. Full training will be provided.**

**What We Offer**

* Hands-on training in professional documentation and operations.
* Exposure to modern technology, automation and AI tools.
* Opportunity to learn specialised administrative processes.
* Direct mentorship and training from the firm's founders.
* A structured work environment with opportunities for long-term professional growth.

**How to Apply**

Apply through LinkedIn with your updated CV.

Please include a short note describing your familiarity with Excel, Google Sheets or any other software tools you have used.

We look forward to hearing from you!

title: WordPress Developer & Content Writer
description:
**This is not a typical content role.**

If your instinct is to:

* Use ChatGPT to write content
* Optimize for speed over quality
* Follow templates without thinking

This role is not for you.

**About Perfect Clicks LLC - Based In New Jersey, USA**

Perfect Clicks is a performance-driven SEO and digital marketing company focused on one core mission: creating irreplaceable, human-written content that dominates Google rankings and becomes a source for AI systems. We don’t chase trends or shortcuts. We build long-term digital assets through deep research, structured thinking, and high-quality execution. Our work spans SEO, content strategy, branding, and full-funnel marketing, all tied to measurable results including rankings, traffic, and revenue growth. With over a decade of experience, hundreds of brands served, and thousands of top-ranking keywords, we operate as strategic partners—not vendors—helping businesses scale through content that compounds over time and cannot be replicated by AI.

We work with high-traffic financial platforms, e-commerce brands, media companies, startups, agencies, and enterprise clients. Since SEO content is the foundation of our business's marketing deliverables, you'll be responsible for writing high quality blog posts, articles, and case studies for a wide range of niches, including wealth management, hospitality, music therapy, pain management, finance, construction, food and restaurants, and more.

We do not:

* Produce generic SEO content
* Use AI to write blogs
* Optimize for volume

We do:

* Create specific, technical, value-driven content
* Build real expertise through human-created work
* Develop team members into strategic partners — not just writers

**The Role: WordPress Developer & Content Writer**

As a content manager with a focus in SEO, you will start by writing — but this is not a traditional writing role.

Writing is how you:

* Learn industries deeply
* Understand client businesses
* Develop strategic thinking

This role is designed as a structured path from execution to strategy, where content writing is the foundation, not the end goal. You will begin by writing and contributing directly to client work, learning how to research, think, and produce high-quality content that drives real SEO performance. As you develop, you will move from task-based execution to owning outcomes—understanding client goals, analyzing data, and contributing to strategy. Over time, high performers transition into leadership roles, managing projects, guiding team members, and participating in client decision-making. With a clear progression from training to independent contribution to strategic direction, this role is built to develop long-term thinkers who can grow into executive-level responsibilities within 6 months to 3 years based on performance and ownership.

**LOCATION:**
Virtual

**HOURS:**
8:30 AM EST to 5 PM EST (6 PM to 2:30 AM)

**SALARY:**
6 to 10 LPA

**Career Growth Path (Year 1):**

**Bootcamp Phase (0-1 month)**

Intensive training focused on writing, research, and core frameworks. You will learn how to produce high-quality, manual content, understand industries deeply, and build the foundation for strategic thinking. This phase is about learning how to think, not just execute.

**Core Team (1-6 months)**

Transition into a full contributor role, owning content production and taking responsibility for quality, timelines, and communication. You will begin making independent decisions, improving efficiency, and developing a deeper understanding of client goals and SEO performance.

**Lead Team (6-12+ months)**

Move into strategy and leadership, managing projects, guiding team members, and contributing to client direction. You will take ownership of outcomes, including content performance, growth, and long-term strategy, while mentoring others and helping scale operations.

The goal is to become someone clients trust to make decisions and become a leader on our team, not just write blogs.

**Core Beliefs on AI Content vs. Human Content**

No generative AI tools for writing content.

* No ChatGPT
* No Gemini or Claude
* No AI-generated drafts

*If AI can write your content, you are not adding value.*

AI-generated content leads to generic output, weak differentiation, and poor long-term performance. Our goal is to create content that AI cannot replicate, only reference.

* **AI-generated writing is not allowed -**
  We maintain a zero-tolerance policy for AI-written content. It goes against our standards, our values, and the level of quality we expect.
* **AI content does not create value -**
  AI-generated content is easy to produce, but also easy to replace. It lacks originality, depth, and true expertise—making it ineffective for long-term SEO performance and client growth.
* **Human content is what AI depends on -**
  AI systems do not create knowledge—they aggregate it. The only content that holds value is original, human-created insight that AI can reference and learn from.
* **We aim to be the source, not the output -**
  Our goal is to create content that ranks on Google and is used in AI Overviews, ChatGPT responses, and other AI systems—not content that competes with them.
* **AI usage reduces learning and expertise -**
  Relying on AI shortcuts limits your ability to think, analyze, and develop real skill. Manual work builds knowledge. AI dependence prevents it.

**What You’ll Actually Do**

* Develop, design, and customize WordPress sites to meet client brand standards
* Oversee website responsiveness and compatibility across devices
* Optimize site performance and load speed for SEO
* Implement and maintain security to protect sites from cyber threats
* Stay up-to-date with WP themes, plugins, trends, and best practices
* Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues
* Write 1–2 high-quality blog posts daily using Perfect Clicks internal frameworks
* Translate complex information into clear, structured, user-focused content
* Conduct SEO keyword research and analysis for client sites
* Continuously refine content based on feedback and performance
* Communicate proactively with a remote team working US hours
* Contribute to long-term content strategy as you grow

**Brands, Topics, & Industries**

You will work across a wide range of brands and industries, including:

* Medical and healthcare services and procedures
* Pain management, regenerative medicine, minimally invasive surgeries
* Construction and local service industries (projects, pricing, materials)
* E-commerce and consumer products (comparisons, positioning, conversion content)
* Forex broker platforms, proprietary trading firms, and wealth management companies
* Financial markets: bonds, commodities, cryptocurrencies, stock CFDs, ETFs, indices, options
* Trading strategies, platform features, and investment analysis
* B2B SaaS platforms, software tools, and product workflows

**Benefits**

* Paid sick time
* Pain vacation time
* Paid holidays
* Flexible unpaid time off

**We are not looking for:**

* Generic SEO writers
* People who want easy, repetitive work
* Candidates who rely on AI tools

**We are looking for:**

**Quality-First Thinkers -**
You get frustrated by generic content, care about doing things properly, and notice when something is off.

**Methodical Learners**
- You ask questions before starting, want to understand why, and take time to do things right.

**High Ownership Individuals**
- You communicate proactively, do not cut corners, and take responsibility for outcomes.

**Long-Term Builders**
- You want to develop real skills, grow into strategy, and are willing to do hard things now for long-term growth.

**Who Should Not Apply**

* You prefer using AI tools for writing
* You prioritize speed over quality
* You struggle with detailed feedback
* You avoid asking questions
* You want quick, low-effort work

**Why This Role Is Different**

Most companies want more content, faster, and use AI to scale output. We are doing the opposite.

We believe the future belongs to people who think first, not people who prompt first.

**Growth and Opportunity**

* Direct mentorship and structured feedback
* Clear path from execution to strategy
* Opportunity to work closely with leadership
* Long-term role for high performers

**Remote Work**

* Fully remote
* Must be comfortable working US hours (8:30 AM – 5 PM EST / 6 PM – 2:30 AM IST)
* Strong communication is required

**Qualifications**

* Excellent English writing, grammar, and communication skills
* 3+ years of experience in content writing, journalism, or a related field
* Ability to break down complex financial or technical topics
* Strong research, analytical, and problem-solving skills
* High attention to detail and commitment to quality
* Ability to work independently and collaborate in a remote environment
* Positive, accountable, and growth-oriented mindset

**Hiring Process**

Our hiring process is designed to identify thinking ability, alignment with our philosophy, and communication and ownership.

You will go through:

1. Large Format Group Introduction Call (30 min)
2. Assessment For Values & Vision Alignment (15 min)
3. Technical Round To Evaluate Content Writing (90 min)

We are highly selective. Most candidates do not pass.

**Keywords**

Business Analyst, SEO Content Writing, Copywriting, Communications, Digital Marketing, Content Strategist, Content Marketing, B2B SaaS Content, Blog Writing, Keyword Research, Content Strategy, Organic Growth, Technical Writing, Content Optimization, Remote Content Jobs, Content Specialist, Marketing Content Writer, Remote Writing Jobs

**How To Apply**

If you have read this entire post carefully, include the word “SEO FIRST” in your application.

Apply with intention.

* This is not an easy role, but for the right person, it is a career-defining opportunity.

title: Programme Coordinator – MEL, Documentation & Donor Relations
description:
**Company Description**
Responsenet, established in 2007, focuses on community-centric interventions to address pressing challenges faced by vulnerable populations across India. The organization designs and implements cross-sector programs that prioritize quality of aid and micro-local impact. By leveraging innovative approaches and strong partnerships, Responsenet aims to create sustainable, transformative change for communities most in need. Over the past 17 years, its development interventions have reached individuals across 22 states and union territories, impacting millions of lives. Responsenet continues to expand its efforts to make everyday impact more effective and inclusive.

**Role Description**
The Programme Coordinator – MEL, Documentation & Donor Relations is a full-time, on-site role based in Delhi, India. This role is responsible for supporting the design and implementation of Monitoring, Evaluation, and Learning (MEL) frameworks across programmes, including data collection, analysis, and reporting. The Programme Coordinator will prepare high-quality documentation such as case studies, progress reports, knowledge products, and presentations that accurately reflect programme outcomes and learnings. The role includes coordinating with donors and partners, managing regular communication, preparing updates, and supporting proposals and grant documentation. Day-to-day tasks also involve coordinating project activities with internal teams, tracking implementation timelines, maintaining programme records, and contributing to continuous improvement of Responsenet’s interventions.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong Program Management and Program Development skills to coordinate interventions and support the design and refinement of community-focused programmes.
* Candidates should possess solid Project Management skills to plan activities, track deliverables, manage timelines, and ensure effective implementation and reporting.
* Candidates should possess excellent Communication and Customer Service skills to engage professionally with donors, partners, and community stakeholders, and to prepare clear, compelling documentation.
* Demonstrated experience in Monitoring, Evaluation, and Learning (MEL), including data collection, analysis, and use of insights for programme improvement, is highly beneficial.
* Strong writing and documentation skills, with the ability to produce reports, case studies, and presentations tailored to diverse audiences.
* Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams and community partners, with strong organizational and time-management skills.
* Proficiency in common office productivity tools (e.g., MS Office or Google Workspace); familiarity with data analysis or MEL software is an advantage.
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in social sciences, development studies, public policy, or a related field, along with experience in the development or nonprofit sector in India.

What you will do

Monitoring, evaluation & learning

* Design and maintain results frameworks, logframes, KPIs and data collection tools for each programme
* Set up and run MIS dashboards; track progress against targets monthly
* Conduct or coordinate baseline, midline and endline studies, and beneficiary feedback
* Turn data into insights for programme teams and leadership

Documentation & reporting

* Write high-quality donor reports (monthly, quarterly, annual), impact reports and case studies
* Develop concept notes, proposals and budgets with the leadership team for CSR and institutional funding
* Maintain programme documentation, photo/video records and audit-ready files
* Produce communication material such as impact stories, presentations and social media inputs

Donor & partner relations

* Act as day-to-day contact for donors and CSR partners: updates, reviews, field visits, queries
* Ensure compliance with grant agreements, reporting timelines and documentation requirements
* Support new partnership development and pitch meetings

Programme coordination

* Coordinate across sectoral project teams, field staff, vendors and partners to keep work on schedule
* Support the launch of new initiatives, including a mobile health unit programme in Delhi NCR
* Travel to project locations as needed

What we’re looking for

* Master’s in Development Studies, Social Work, Public Policy, Economics, Public Health or a related field
* 3–6 years in the development sector, with hands-on MEL and donor reporting experience
* Excellent written English; Hindi preferred
* Strong with Excel/Google Sheets and data visualisation; experience with KoboToolbox, ODK or similar tools is a plus
* Familiarity with CSR (Schedule VII) compliance is an advantage
* Organised, detail-oriented and confident with senior stakeholders
* Comfortable using AI and digital tools to work efficiently

www.responsenet.org

We do not accept resumes from HR consulting agencies and request not to forward any unsolicited resumes of candidates for positions open or closed at Responsenet.

Only short-listed candidates will be contacted.

Please remember to share your resume along with your present location and availability for the application to be considered for the role for consideration to be shortlisted.

title: Senior Business Systems Analyst
description:
**About ETS**
ETS is a global education and talent solutions organization enabling lifelong learners worldwide to be future-ready. For more than 75 years, we've been advancing the science of measurement to build benchmarks for fair and valid skill assessment across cultures and borders. Our worldwide impact extends through our renowned assessments including TOEFL®, TOEIC®, GRE® and Praxis® tests, serving millions of learners in more than 200 countries and territories. Through strategic acquisitions, we've expanded our global capabilities: PSI strengthens our workforce assessment solutions, while Edusoft, Kira Talent, Pipplet, Vericant, and Wheebox enhance our educational technology and assessment platforms across critical markets worldwide.
  
  
Through ETS Research Institute and ETS Solutions, we're partnering with educational institutions, governments, and organizations globally to promote skill proficiency, empower upward mobility, and unlock opportunities for everyone, everywhere. With offices and partners across Asia, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and the Americas, we deliver nearly 50 million tests annually. Join us in our journey of measuring progress to power human progress worldwide.
  
  
The Senior Business Systems Analyst (BSA) functions as a liason between business units thoughout ETS and the IT departments, participates in business process modeling and research efforts and completes business cases in support of IT projects. The incumbent works with the Strategic Business Unit (SBU) proposal team to develop the scope of work necessary to support the requirements of the proposal, identifies delivery solutions and works to develop cost reviews and prepare a technical response to the client that proposes solutions to meet business needs. This role participates in the formulation and definition of project scope and objectives for assigned departmental projects. Additionally, the BSA, Senior participates in requirements gathering and documentation and prepares detailed systems specifications from which programs are written or configured. The Senior Business Systems Analyst communicates with the IT team to ensure proper development, operationalization and delivery of technical solutions that fully adhere to corporate business objectives and meet user specifications for functionality and accuracy.

* Facilitate communication between IT, SBUs and clients

* Prior experience with software testing standards, practices, methods and tools
* Excellent planning, organization and problem identification skills
* Excellent information and data analysis skills
* Prior experience in financial applications preferred
* Demonstrated problem solving ability
* Excellent technical and business terminology to consult with clients, vendors and other internal staff
* Proven ability to work effectively on multiple projects simultaneously (balance workload)
* Ability to work in a collaborative, team-based environment

**Education, Certifications, Or Special Licenses**

* A Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Information Processing, or business-related curricula, or an equivalent combination of education and experience from which comparable knowledge and abilities can be acquired, is necessary.
* 4+ years of experience in defining/developing software products and/or managing software development efforts.

* We are energized by cultivating growth, innovation, and continuous transformation for the next generation of rising professionals as leaders. Â In support of this ETS offers multiple Business Resource Groups (BRG) for you to learn and advance your career growth!

title: Research Analyst
company: Council on Energy, Environment and Water (CEEW)
description:
**Purpose**

The CEEW’s sustainable water programme informs policy-making for the sustainable development of water resources and their effective management through research in the areas of: circular water economy for urban resilience; climate risk-informed water security planning; climate-adaptive water governance; and water accounting-based planning.

For its sustainable water programme, CEEW seeks to hire a Research Analyst with a good understanding of India’s water sector. An ideal candidate should have a thorough understanding of urban water management issues and challenges, especially considering the climate variability and change, and the current policy discourse (supply and demand management, and used water treatment, recycling, and reuse) for addressing them. The candidate should have prior experience working in the used water management and circular economy sectors.

Along with a policy research orientation, the candidate should possess strong data analysis skills and support the organisation in accessing various existing secondary data sets, such as those from the Census of India, Urban Local Bodies, Central and State Pollution Control Boards, Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs, Directorate of Economics and Statistics, Ministry of Jal Shakti, India WRIS or any other data sets available in the public domain. The candidate should have proficiency in using statistical tools. Hands-on experience with geo-spatial tools and experience of working in projects involving the engagement of urban local bodies will be desirable.

**Job Duties and Accountabilities**

**Research:**

* Undertaking policy and data analysis for mainstreaming treated used water (TUW) reuse in local governance.

* Conduct primary surveys, including sampling, design and questionnaire development, and undertake field visits to collect data and information related to water supply and demand across different sectors within the city or specific region.
* Analyse primary and secondary water-related datasets using statistical tools to estimate the city water balance, assess the existing used water management scenario, and identify TUW reuse avenues.
* Conduct a financial assessment using various budget estimation techniques to assess the financial viability of the proposed city-level treated used water reuse plan
* Conduct life cycle cost assessments of used water treatment technologies
* Assist in writing high-quality research reports
* Generate knowledge content – blogs, policy briefs, etc., at regular intervals

**Project Assistance:**

* Assist in preparing presentations, fact sheets, and other research communication material
* Assist team members for important meetings and sessions, prepare notes, and conduct follow-ups, as required
* Assist in coordination with the outreach team, engagement with a wider network of stakeholders, and concerned policymakers
* Travel to project sites, if required, to monitor field surveys, conduct interviews or collect data for different research projects
* Any other assistance that may be required

**Selection Criteria**

**Education and Experience:**

* Master’s degree in environmental sciences/management/planning, water resources management, urban planning/management, hydrology, public policy or a related field
* Prior experience in working with urban local bodies, used water treatment technologies and reuse solutions, and the economics of used water resource management.
* Proven evidence of conducting effective stakeholder engagement.
* 1–2 years of work experience

**Skills:**

* Competent in collecting and analysing data
* Good report writing skills
* Good data visualisation skills
* Competent in using MS Office application suite
* Proficiency in RS/GIS will be an added advantage

**Personality:**

* Willingness to learn new skills in research and project management
* Ability to adapt and deliver work under tight deadlines in a professional environment
* Striving for rigour in research and quality in work output
* Ability to work in an interdisciplinary and multicultural environment

**Compensation**

Competitive compensation – commensurate with the experience and matching the best of standards adopted by industry or other similar organisations for similar roles.

**Application Process**

CEEW is an equal opportunity employer, and the selection process does not discriminate based on age, gender, caste, ethnicity, religion, or sexuality. Female candidates are encouraged to apply.

Interested candidates are requested to send their applications to jobs@ceew.in with ‘Application – Research Analyst –Water’ as the subject line. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, so interested applicants are advised to apply at the earliest possible.

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. We appreciate your interest.

title: Graduate Engineer Trainee
description:
**About the role**
GreyOrange is looking for a Graduate Engineer Trainee – Firmware Quality Assurance to support embedded firmware validation and quality assurance for robotic systems.
  
  
The role involves working closely with Firmware, Electronics, Software, Product Engineering, and Quality teams to identify and resolve firmware issues before Functional Acceptance Testing (FAT) and customer deployment.
  
  
We are looking for a hands-on engineer with a strong interest in embedded systems, robotics, firmware testing, debugging, communication protocols, and quality engineering. The candidate will be involved in validating firmware on robots, controllers, sensors, and VDA systems.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Embedded Firmware Quality & Validation
  
  

* Test and validate embedded firmware releases before FAT and site deployment.
* Perform firmware-level checks on robots, controllers, sensors, and VDA systems.
* Identify firmware defects, reproduce issues, and provide clear debugging information to the Firmware team.
* Validate bug fixes and perform regression testing before firmware releases.
* Review firmware release and change logs and ensure that changes are adequately tested.

Embedded Debugging & Troubleshooting
  
  

* Debug firmware-related issues using logs, diagnostic tools, and communication interfaces.
* Support troubleshooting of CAN, UART, RS-232/RS-485, Ethernet, and other embedded communication protocols.
* Understand communication between controllers, sensors, motor drivers, and other robotic electronics.
* Support root-cause analysis to determine whether issues are related to firmware, electronics, communication, or software.
* Perform remote debugging and embedded-level checks on VDA and robotic systems.

FAT & Robot Validation
  
  

* Support Functional Acceptance Testing (FAT) and internal robot testing from a firmware quality perspective.
* Ensure firmware is adequately validated before robots are released for FAT.
* Create firmware test cases, checklists, and regression test plans.
* Track firmware defects through closure and verify fixes.
* Contribute towards achieving zero firmware-related defects during FAT.

Quality & Engineering Collaboration
  
  

* Work closely with Firmware, Electronics, Software, Product Engineering, and Quality teams.
* Support CAPA and root-cause analysis for firmware-related field issues.
* Analyze recurring firmware failures and recommend preventive actions.
* Maintain defect trackers, test results, logs, and firmware validation reports.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Electronics & Communication Engineering (ECE), Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Embedded Systems, Mechatronics, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline from a recognized institute.
* 0–2 years of relevant experience in embedded systems, firmware testing, quality assurance, or related areas.
* Fresh graduates with strong academic projects or internships in embedded systems may also be considered.
* Good understanding of microcontrollers, embedded systems, and firmware architecture.
* Basic programming knowledge in C/C++.
* Understanding of communication protocols such as CAN, UART, SPI, I2C, RS-232/RS-485, and Ethernet.
* Ability to read basic electronic schematics and understand sensors, controllers, and interfaces.
* Exposure to robotics, AMRs, AGVs, automotive ECUs, or industrial automation is preferred.

**Required Skills & Tools**

* Hands-on approach to embedded firmware testing, troubleshooting, and debugging.
* Ability to analyze logs, firmware versions, communication errors, and test results.
* Familiarity with debugging and testing tools such as:

+ CAN analyzers
+ Serial terminals
+ Debuggers
+ Oscilloscopes
+ Logic analyzers

* Basic understanding of quality and problem-solving methodologies such as 5 Why, Fishbone Analysis, CAPA, root-cause analysis, and validation testing.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Office.
* Familiarity with JIRA or other defect tracking systems is an advantage.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.

Travel & Work Expectations
  
  

* Willingness to travel to supplier locations, GreyOrange facilities, and customer sites based on business requirements.
* Comfortable working with global and cross-functional teams across different time zones.
* Willingness to participate in hands-on robot testing, firmware validation, troubleshooting, and plant activities.

title: Fulfilment Intern
description:
**About Atlys**
Our mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely.
  
  
Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers.
  
  
Atlys is changing that.
  
  
We’re building an AI-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we’ve processed visas for
**1M+ travellers across 127 countries**
. But we’re still early.
  
  
**The Role**
We’re looking for a
**Fulfilment Intern**
to support the end-to-end processing of visa applications and learn how high-quality travel operations work at scale.
  
  
You’ll work closely with our regional operations team to review applications, track cases, coordinate across stakeholders and support customers through the visa process.
  
  
This is a hands-on, on-ground internship where attention to detail, reliability and a willingness to learn matter every day. The role is based in-office and operates on a 6-day work week.

* Coordinate across teams and external stakeholders to help keep applications moving and support communication with consulates and embassies.
* Track application progress closely and help ensure customers receive timely updates on status and required actions.
* Support accurate and reliable execution by maintaining customer data confidentiality and contributing to a smooth experience from start to finish.

**The Ideal Candidate**
**You’ll Likely Thrive In This Role If You**

* Are hungry to learn, take ownership and build real-world experience in a fast-moving environment.
* Are detail-oriented and organised, with the ability to manage multiple tasks without losing accuracy.
* Communicate clearly and confidently, both verbally and in writing.
* Are comfortable using digital tools, learning new systems and figuring things out quickly.
* Are proactive, dependable and willing to get hands-on with whatever it takes to keep things moving.

*We hire exceptional people for their craft, not travel enthusiasts. We solve hard problems that happen to touch global travel and government infrastructure.*
**What You Can Expect**
Atlys is built by a small team with outsized ambition, high ownership, and an obsession with doing great work.
  
  
**Here’s What You Can Expect**

* Competitive compensation and equity so you participate in the value you help create.
* Comprehensive health insurance covering you and your family, plus annual preventive health check-up on us.
* A thoughtful leave policy with paid time off and company holidays, because great work also requires real time off.
* Lunch, high tea and dinner at the office, so the basics are taken care of while we build together.
* Learning & development credits to invest in courses, books, conferences and tools that help you get better at your craft.
* Relocation support to make moving closer to the team as seamless as possible.
* Great tools to do your best work, including high-spec equipment and software.
* An office designed for more than just work, with pickleball, table tennis, PlayStation, an arcade game room, an F1 simulator and even a full flight simulator.

Our values shape how we make decisions, work together and build for travelers. The bar is high, the pace is fast, and the way we work is deliberate. Read them before you apply. If this environment energizes you, you’ll probably thrive here. If it doesn’t, it’s better to know that upfront.
  
  
*Come build the intelligence layer for global travel*

* Zippee is building India’s #1 Quick Commerce Logistics for consumer brands.
* Brands connect their online store to Zippee in just a few clicks & can kickstart 30-Min Delivery/120-Min/Same-Day Delivery for customers through our dark store network across India.
* Our team comprises folks from Reliance Retail, Retention Science, oracle, zomato, & institutions like Hindu College, BITS Pilani, and the University of Southern California.
* Backed by VCs & founders of India's biggest unicorns, including Ashneer Grover (BharatPe), Kunal Shah (CRED), Peyush Bansal (Lenskart), and Prashant Pitti (easemytrip).

**Job Description:**

* We're hiring an Assistant Manager- Supply Chain Design to design credible, scalable supply chain solutions for prospective clients during the sales process — and then own implementation.
* You will work closely with the sales team, engaging directly with SCM Heads, CEOs, and MDs to understand their warehousing, quick commerce, and last-mile challenges and translate them into solutions that Zippee can deliver.
* This is a
  **high-pressure, zero-handholding, unstructured environment,**
  where no task is beneath you if it moves the mission forward. We move fast, we set a high bar, and we’re not for everyone.
* This is an in-person role (M-F office | Saturday remote) at our Gurgaon HQ.

**Responsibilities:**

* Experience in process design, implementation, and continuous improvement across operations.
* Strong knowledge of quality methodologies such as Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen, ISO, and TQM.
* Identified process gaps, conducted root cause analysis, and implemented corrective actions.
* Developed and monitored KPIs, SOPs, process maps, and improvement frameworks.
* Analyzed and optimized supply chain, warehousing, and logistics processes.
* Worked closely with cross-functional teams and business leaders to drive improvement initiatives.
* Strong analytical and data-driven decision-making skills with proficiency in Excel and reporting tools.
* Experience in
  **AutoCAD 2D & 3D design**
  , including warehouse layout planning, space optimization, and process flow design.
* Good understanding of end-to-end supply chain and warehouse operations.

**Qualifications:**

* BE/B.Tech or Graduate with SCM/Project management certification.
* 3–5 years' experience in warehousing & supply chain management.
* We follow a BYOD policy- you must have your own laptop.

**Benefits:**

* Opportunity to be part of a tight-knit rocketship passionate about empowering consumer brands in the quick commerce era.
* Annual company retreat.
* Steep learning curve, high ownership, and the chance to grow fast as we scale.

title: Integrated Logistics Process Engineer
description:
**It's more than a job**
As a member of the Freight Forwarding team Kuehne+Nagel, you will play a key role in transporting goods, optimising processes, and fulfilling our customers' promises. And by transporting medicines, toys and important machine parts, you are not only delivering goods, you are making small and big moments possible for people all around the world. At Kuehne+Nagel, our contribution counts in more ways than we imagine.
  
  
‎
  
  

* To be responsible for identifying and implementing optimized operational processes to improve productivity and efficiency.
* To interact very closely with other departments of LCC, Implementation, Solution Development, Project Management and Business Management to aid the design of Integrated Logistics (IL) solutions.
* To ensure that all processes are properly documented once optimization is approved and implemented.
* To train all relevant staff in new processes in a timely manner including testing to ensure capability.

**How you create impact**

* To deliver and deploy productivity management tools to ensure consistent measurement and monitoring of productivity at process and team level.
* To constantly review all tasks within scope to identify potential opportunities for process improvements/optimization.
* To prepare supporting documents and presentations to customer for approval of process improvement initiatives.
* To ensure that the process is monitored after improvements implemented and track and record results to demonstrate success and/or enable further adjustments.
* To ensure that accurate training records of all new processes/actions are kept accessible.
* To translate operational process designs into applicable process documentation – process flows, Standard Operating Procedures, Working Instructions, etc and ensure that all such process documentation work is maintained and updated as per requirements.
* To achieve project savings via Productivity Improvement Strategy.
* To participate in designing, executing and documentation User Acceptance Testing.
* To be responsible for internal communication processes and presentations related to key performance metrics, program updates and on-going program information providing tasks.

**What we would like you to bring**

* A bachelor's degree in logistics, supply chain management, business administration, or a related field.
* Minimum 7 - 8 years of experience in logistics or supply chain management, preferably within the consultancy industry.
* MUST be a Green Belt Six Sigma Certified or Black Belt Certified.
* Strong automation, analytical, and project management skills, with expertise in process improvement and proficiency in logistics systems and tools.
* Ability to identify issues and implement effective solutions to optimize logistics processes.

**What's in it for you**
At Kuehne+Nagel, you’ll be part of a global logistics leader that believes in creating real impact—on business, on customers, and on careers. Here’s what you can look forward to:
  
  

* Global Exposure: Step into a world of international opportunities with a presence in 100+ countries.
* People-Centric Culture: Join a team where your voice matters and people genuinely care.
* Learning & Development: Grow with us personally and professionally through world-class training and career pathways.
* Innovation & Sustainability: Be part of a future-focused company driving real change in logistics and the planet.
* Rewards & Recognition: Get rewarded for your passion, performance, and potential.
* Stability with Agility: Enjoy the best of both worlds a trusted global brand with a startup spirit.

**Who we are**
Logistics shapes everyday life - from the goods we consume to the healthcare we rely on. At Kuehne+Nagel, your work goes beyond logistics; it enables both ordinary and special moments in the lives of people around the world.
  
  
As a global leader with a strong heritage and a vision to move the world forward, we offer a safe, stable environment where your career can make a real difference. Whether we help deliver life-saving medicines, develop sustainable transportation solutions or support our local communities, your career will contribute to more than you can imagine.

title: Implementation Consultant
description:
**Overview**
**Our Culture and Impact**
Cvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with more than 6,000+ employees and 24,000+ customers worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 500. Founded in 1999, Cvent delivers a comprehensive event marketing and management platform for marketers and event professionals and offers software solutions to hotels, special event venues and destinations to help them grow their group/MICE and corporate travel business. Our technology brings millions of people together at events around the world. In short, we’re transforming the meetings and events industry through innovative technology that powers the human connection.
  
  
Cvent's strength lies in its people, fostering a culture where everyone is encouraged to think like entrepreneurs, taking risks and making decisions confidently. We value diverse perspectives and celebrate differences, working together with colleagues and clients to build strong connections.
  
  
**AI at Cvent: Leading the Future**
Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At Cvent, we’re committed to continuous learning and adaptation—AI isn’t just a tool for us, it’s part of our DNA. We’re looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI-augmented work, you’ll thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation.
  
  
Throughout our interview process, you’ll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact. If you’re excited to be part of a team that’s leading the way in AI-powered collaboration, we’d love to meet you.
  
  
**About The Team**
The Cvent Implementation team configures and deploys Cvent software for new and existing clients. Our mission is to provide expert guidance and hands-on technical execution, so every client successfully launches, adopts, and realizes value from their Cvent products.
  
  
The role blends project management, technical configuration, and client-facing consulting — and increasingly, the smart use of AI tools to move faster, reduce manual work, and give clients a sharper, more consultative experience. This is no longer just a configuration role: it's a role where the best performers use AI as a force multiplier across research, documentation, testing, and client communication.
  
  
**Role Overview**
As a Senior Implementation / Implementation Lead, you will own mid-to-complex client implementations end-to-end — from discovery and process mapping through configuration, testing, training, and go-live. You'll act as a trusted advisor to clients, a hands-on product expert, and a mentor to junior team members, while leveraging AI tools to accelerate delivery and improve quality at every stage of the project lifecycle.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**
**Client Consultation & Strategic Delivery**

* Provide high-level consultation to clients on applying Cvent technology to meet their meetings and events program goals.
* Analyze current-state processes and map future-state workflows to Cvent solutions, identifying opportunities for automation along the way.
* Serve as a product specialist — deeply knowledgeable across Cvent products, able to demonstrate, consult, configure, test, train, and deploy solutions.
* Cultivate strong advisory relationships with key client stakeholders who influence adoption and long-term account health.

**Project & Program Leadership**

* Apply structured project management discipline — scoping, planning, RAID logs, milestone tracking, and change control — to manage simple-to-complex implementations, keeping timelines on track and proactively escalating barriers to success.
* Translate customer goals into objective, measurable success criteria (e.g., adoption rate, time-to-value, process cycle time, cost savings, ROI) rather than relying on subjective or anecdotal measures of progress.
* Define and track KPIs and success metrics with clients at project kick-off, and report progress against them throughout the engagement so success is data-driven, not just directional.
* Oversee and/or configure client accounts, including testing, refining, and directing the contributions of other team members.
* Track time and profitability of implementation projects, providing recommendations on streamlining, automation, or process redesign.
* Coordinate and conduct virtual user training sessions for client teams.

**Technical Configuration & Product Expertise**

* Configure, test, and refine Cvent product instances to match documented client requirements.
* Diagram intermediate-to-complex process flows and identify opportunities to streamline and improve efficiency.
* Interface with the Product Development team to define and convey client feature requests.

**AI-Enabled Delivery & Innovation**
**Role**
*This is where the role has evolved most. AI is now a core part of how implementation work gets done, not an optional add-on:*

* Use generative AI tools (e.g., Claude, Copilot) to draft, summarize, and refine requirements documents, process maps, and configuration workbooks — cutting documentation time and improving consistency across projects.
* Apply AI-assisted meeting summarization and transcription tools during discovery calls and configuration workshops to speed up note-taking, action-item tracking, and follow-up communications.
* Identify and build lightweight automations or AI-agent workflows for repetitive project tasks — status updates, test-case generation, training material drafts, and client FAQs — freeing up time for higher-value consulting.
* Maintain quality and accuracy as a human-in-the-loop reviewer: validating AI-generated configurations, documentation, and communications before they reach the client.
* Model and mentor AI tool adoption to junior team members and peers, helping the broader team adopt AI-first ways of working.
* Use AI-powered analytics on data such as usage patterns, support tickets, or historical project data to proactively flag risk and improve implementation quality.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration & Leadership**

* Partner with Sales and Account Management to support sales activities where implementation expertise is a differentiator.
* Ensure client objectives and requirements are clearly conveyed and tracked throughout the implementation lifecycle.
* Serve as a mentor to new team members, including on best practices for using AI tools responsibly and effectively.
* Present internally as a subject-matter expert on implementation topics, lead conversations in team meetings, and participate in team committees, at times in a leadership capacity.

**Here's What You Need**

* 10 to 14+ years of external work experience in a project or customer management role — preferably in the corporate meetings, software, or broader high-tech industry — or a minimum of 5 years of Cvent experience.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent applicable experience.
* Experience implementing technology or automation, ideally within an organization responsible for managing meetings or events.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a positive, confident, and outgoing presence; strong presentation skills.
* Highly articulate and detail-oriented, with the ability to simplify complex concepts for clients of varying technical fluency.
* Strong project management skills — able to build and manage project plans, timelines, RAID/risk logs, and status reporting across multiple concurrent client engagements.
* Demonstrated ability to translate customer goals into objective, quantifiable outcomes and hold projects accountable to measurable results rather than subjective impressions of progress.
* Ability to comprehend and diagram intermediate process flows, identifying opportunities to streamline and improve efficiency.
* Proficiency in core productivity tools: Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Visio/Draw.io.
* Demonstrable aptitude for learning and applying new technologies, and for applying general and industry-specific business knowledge in a fast-paced, analytical, team-oriented environment.
* Strong time-management and organizational discipline; ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities independently.
* A solutions-first mindset — comfortable proposing fixes rather than simply surfacing problems to management.

**Adaptability & Resilience Under Pressure**

* Ability to pivot quickly on customer situations — reworking scope, timelines, or approach mid-project when client needs, priorities, or constraints shift unexpectedly.
* Comfort operating through significant change management within a project (new stakeholders, revised requirements, shifting priorities) with flexibility rather than resistance to the change.
* Proven ability to multitask and stay effective under pressure — juggling competing deadlines, client escalations, and internal priorities without losing quality or composure.
* Willingness and ability to manage through non-ideal or ambiguous situations — messy data, incomplete requirements, tight timelines — rather than waiting for perfect conditions to make progress.

**AI & Technology Fluency (New)**

* Hands-on, practical experience using generative AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot) to accelerate day-to-day work — documentation, research, communications, or analysis.
* Comfort working in a human-in-the-loop capacity: reviewing, validating, and correcting AI-generated outputs before they go to clients.
* Curiosity and adaptability toward emerging AI-powered workflow and automation tools, with a willingness to experiment and share learnings with the team.
* Basic understanding of how AI agents and automated workflows can be applied to client onboarding, configuration, or reporting tasks (formal AI/ML background not required).

**Preferred, Not Required**

* Experience with AI-assisted meeting transcription/summarization tools (e.g., Azure, Copilot, Glean, Claude).
* Prior exposure to no-code/low-code automation platforms (e.g., Zapier, Power Automate) or agentic workflow builders.
* Project management certification such as PMP, PRINCE2, or Agile/Scrum (CSM, PMI-ACP) good to have, not required.
* Six Sigma (Green Belt or higher) or equivalent process-improvement certification.

title: Technical Writer
description:
**Working Days: Mon-Fri**
**Working Hours: 17:00 IST to 02:00 IST**
The Technical Writer is responsible for creating clear, accurate, and user-friendly documentation that helps users understand complex technical products, systems, or processes. This role collaborates closely with subject matter experts (SMEs), engineers, product managers, and other stakeholders to translate technical information into accessible content for a variety of audiences.
  
  
**Who We Are**
AVI-SPL is a digital enablement solutions provider who transforms how people and technology connect to elevate experiences, create new value, and enable organizations to thrive and grow. We are the largest provider of collaboration technology solutions, which include our award-winning managed services.
  
  
Our highly certified industry experts and innovation leaders share a vision to help people work smarter and live better. Our success starts with our people; and a workplace that champions culture and belonging ensures we grow and thrive together.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
The Technical Writer is responsible for creating clear, accurate, and user-friendly documentation that helps users understand complex technical products, systems, or processes. This role collaborates closely with subject matter experts (SMEs), engineers, product managers, and other stakeholders to translate technical information into accessible content for a variety of audiences.
  
  
**Day-To-Day Responsibilities**

* Create, update, and maintain comprehensive documentation—including user manuals, setup guides, API documentation, online help guides, video tutorials, FAQs, and process documentation—to ensure users can easily learn and effectively use software applications.
* Translate complex technical information into clear, concise, and engaging content for both technical and non-technical audiences
* Collaborate with product managers, developers, and customer support to gather information and ensure accuracy
* Craft clear, exciting release notes that tell users what bugs were fixed and what new features were added.
* Review our software’s buttons, menus, and error messages to make sure they use simple, clear language.
* Create pictures, diagrams, and charts to show users how features work.
* Organize and structure content in a logical, intuitive manner
* Review and revise existing documentation to improve clarity, consistency, and usability
* Ensure documentation adheres to company standards, style guides, and branding guidelines
* Manage documentation projects, timelines, and version control
* Conduct usability testing and incorporate feedback to improve documentation quality
* Maintain documentation repositories and content management systems
* Perform additional tasks, responsibilities, and projects needed to support the team and organization, ensuring flexibility in adapting to evolving priorities and objectives.
* Attend relevant meetings, workshops, and working sessions as required, capturing key discussions, decisions, actions, and outcomes and translating them into clear, structured documentation.
* Leverage AI tools where appropriate to support efficient notetaking, summarisation, and documentation.

**Must-Haves**
**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR**

* Bachelor’s degree in English, Communications, Technical Writing, Computer Science, or a related field
* 2-5 years of experience as a Technical Writer or similar role
* Strong writing, editing, and proofreading skills
* Ability to understand and explain complex technical concepts
* Experience with documentation tools
* Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
* Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Analytical thinking and problem-solving
* Collaboration and cross-functional teamwork
* Time management and prioritization
* Adaptability and continuous learning
* Attention to detail and accuracy

**Nice-To-Haves**

* Experience writing for technical audiences in software, IT, engineering, or related industries
* Familiarity with Agile or Scrum environments
* Basic understanding of programming languages or APIs
* Experience with content management systems (CMS) or documentation platforms
* Knowledge of UX writing principles or information architecture

**WHY YOU’LL LIKE WORKING HERE**

* Medical benefits, including vision and dental
* Paid holidays and PTO
* Enjoyable and dynamic company culture
* Training and professional development opportunities

**More About Us**
AVI-SPL is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran status, disability status, or membership in any other group protected by federal, state, or local law. AVI-SPL is an AA/Disabled/Veteran Protected Employer VEVRAA Federal Contractor.
  
  
AVI-SPL reserves the right to alter work hours and work location as necessary. Work hours may vary based on client requirements and may include travel to various locations in support of the account.

description: Designation: Executive/Senior Executive – Communication & BrandingName of the Institution: University of Design, Innovation & Technology (UDIT)Location: University of Design, Innovation & Technology, Gurugram, Sector 68 – 122101.Working ConditionsTimings: 09.00 am – 06.00 pm (Monday to Friday)10.00 am – 05.00 pm (Saturday), 2 Saturdays offWork Experience: 02+ years of experience in the field of content, marketing, blog & email marketing, social media, etc.Education:Graduate/Post Graduate with good writing and communication skills.Additional diploma/certifications in the field of marketing, SEO, content writing, Adobe Photoshop would be considered a plus.Reporting: Head – Communications Team/COOAbout the RoleWe're looking for someone who can write, shoot, edit, design, think, curate, and move fluidly between storytelling formats and platforms. Someone who understands that communication for a design university isn't just about captions or calendars — it's about cultural literacy, visual fluency, and the ability to craft seamless narratives that reflect what's happening in the world and on campus.You'll wear multiple hats here: writer, photographer, video editor, designer, event coordinator, creative collaborator, trend spotter. If you're deeply curious, perpetually online in the best way, can hold a conversation about everything from Satyajit Ray to street style to semiotics — and know how to frame a shot and cut a story together — keep reading.What you will do● Write and edit across all platforms: social media, website copy, press releases, campaign scripts. Your writing should adapt to the medium and audience — Instagram captions aren't blog intros aren't press releases.● Shoot and edit content: You'll be on the ground capturing moments — events, campus life, student work, faculty interviews. Then you'll edit those into Instagram Stories, Reels, YouTube videos, or whatever format the story demands. You should know composition, lighting basics, and how to make a phone or DSLR work for you.● Design when needed: Create social media posts, story graphics, email headers, or quick visual assets using Canva, Photoshop, or Illustrator. You don't need to be a senior designer, but you should have an eye for layout, typography, and brand consistency.● Curate video and visual narratives: Work with internal and external design and video partners to develop concepts, write briefs, and ensure the final output has both aesthetic integrity and narrative clarity. You should know what a good edit looks like and be able to articulate why.● Manage events with a storytelling lens: From Convocation to campus visits to the Graduate Show — you'll help plan, coordinate, document, and amplify. You're not just logistics support. You're thinking: What's the story here? How do we capture and tell it before, during, and after?● Stay contextually aware: You should know what's trending, what's being talked about, what movements are shaping culture — and how (or whether) IIAD should respond. Pop culture, design discourse, social issues, global and local — all of it informs how we communicate.● Generate ideas, not just execute them: We need someone who can pitch concepts for campaigns, suggest content series, and spot opportunities to insert IIAD into larger cultural conversations. You're not waiting for a brief — you're co-creating it.● Collaborate across departments: Regular touchpoints with faculty, students, admissions, program heads, and external agencies. You're gathering stories, aligning messaging, and ensuring that what we say actually reflects what we do.● Track, analyse, refine: Monitor engagement, performance, and sentiment across platforms. Use insights to evolve our approach — what's resonating, what's not, and why.Who You AreYou're a cultural omnivore.You read books. You watch films (and not just the ones everyone talks about). You notice design in everyday spaces. You have opinions about typography, about casting choices, about how cities are planned. You're curious about history, geography, mythology, subcultures. You connect things that don't obviously connect.You're a natural storyteller across mediums.You can craft a narrative arc across platforms — an Instagram Reel isn't just a video, it's part of a larger conversation. You understand pacing, tone, visual rhythm, and context. You know when to be formal and when to be conversational. You know how a story changes when it's written vs. filmed vs. designed.You're contextually switched on.You know what's happening — culturally, socially, politically. You can spot a meme reference, understand a design movement, explain why something went viral. You're online, but critically so.You're exhaustingly multi-skilled.Writing? Yes. Photography and video? title: Knowledge Analyst - Healthcare Access, Quality, and Outcomes
description:
**Who You'll Work With**
Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.
  
  
In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.
  
  
When you join us, you will have:
  
  

* Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
* A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
* Global community: With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
* World-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.

**Your Impact**
You will work on client engagements, combining clinical knowledge, analytical thinking, and structured problem-solving to address complex healthcare challenges.
  
  
You will identify opportunities for operational improvement, redesign care workflows, and support the development of strategies, transformation initiatives, and implementation of roadmaps that enhance healthcare delivery and organizational performance.
  
  
Your work also involves translating complex medical policies and clinical guidelines for business stakeholders and having the ability to further translate these policies into analytical frameworks that inform decision making. Drawing on these insights, you will identify gaps in care, clinical risks, and opportunities for improvement while designing ideal care journeys across a range of disease areas, including chronic conditions such as diabetes and chronic kidney disease (CKD). This includes defining key interventions, milestones, and care pathways across different stages of disease progression, identifying clinical markers that signal emerging risks or worsening conditions, and leveraging analytics to identify at-risk populations and recommend targeted actions that improve health outcomes and care effectiveness.
  
  
Working closely with clients, McKinsey teams, and practice leaders, you will build tenure-appropriate client relationships, facilitate syndication and problem-solving discussions, and support implementation efforts. You will contribute to workshops, client events, and frontline transformations, applying strong project management and communication skills to help translate recommendations into tangible results.
  
  
You will join our Client Capabilities Network in the Gurugram office as part of the Healthcare Access, Quality, and Outcomes (HALO) domain within the Social, Healthcare and Public Entities (SHaPE) practice.
  
  
HALO brings together clinicians, healthcare experts, consultants, data scientists, and engineers to help healthcare organizations improve affordability, access, quality, and operational effectiveness. The team develops and deploys proprietary analytics, expertise, and transformation capabilities to support payors, healthcare services organizations, provider-led health plans, and other risk-bearing healthcare entities. Together, we aspire to improve healthcare performance and outcomes at scale.
  
  
Beyond client engagements, you will contribute to the development of new knowledge, intellectual property, and capabilities that strengthen HALO's healthcare offerings and extend our impact across clients globally.
  
  
**Your Qualifications and Skills**

* Medical degree, such as MBBS or related qualification, preferred
* 2+ years of experience in healthcare transformation, healthcare operations, payer or provider organizations, clinical operations, healthcare strategy, or management consulting
* Strong understanding of healthcare delivery models, clinical workflows, healthcare operations, and performance improvement methodologies, with the ability to connect clinical knowledge to operational and business outcomes
* Familiarity with SQL and experience querying data from relational databases or cloud-based data environments
* Strong problem-solving, stakeholder management, and influencing skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a team-based, entrepreneurial environment
* Experience facilitating workshops, developing implementation roadmaps, and supporting organizational change initiatives is preferred
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex clinical, operational, and analytical concepts into clear, actionable recommendations for diverse stakeholders
