HONO.ai is a premium HR-Tech Solution and range of HR Services for all your requirements. HONO aims to nurture Human Relationships, propel employees’ pursuit of realizing their true potential and embrace the best of talent through a host of innovative technologies. We at HONO are committed to connect people across cultures, traditions, ideas, beliefs and boundaries. Connecting across multi-channels, platforms and systems.

The Functional Consultant is responsible for understanding client business processes, gathering and analyzing requirements, configuring the HRMS platform, and ensuring successful implementation of HR technology solutions. The role acts as a bridge between clients and the product/technical teams, translating business requirements into system configurations and ensuring the solution aligns with organizational HR, payroll, attendance, leave, performance, and workforce management processes.

The incumbent will lead requirement workshops, prepare solution documentation, conduct system demonstrations, support user acceptance testing (UAT), provide end-user training, and ensure smooth go-live and post-implementation adoption. The role requires strong knowledge of HR processes, excellent stakeholder management skills, and the ability to deliver projects within defined timelines and quality standards.

**Responsibilities**

* Work with our client to perform Fit/Gap Analysis for modules within the product HONO based on their requirements.
* Understand Client requirements and best practices to achieve highly accurate configuration requests in all modules
* Perform functional specification documentation for development requests
* Communicate and collaborate with internal Software teams to formalize application requirements, while supporting the delivery of the solution
* Collaborate with the client to solve problems in managing large dynamic sets of data, and to develop and document new processes
* Review test cases, replicate issues, work with developers to resolve issues
* Provide reports in client templates and formats
* Ensure high-quality data uploads
* Understand and work competently in a virtual environment
* Quickly learn new processes, software and ways of working
* Be part of a dynamic team who works together to help our client succeed
* Meet and advise prospects and clients on possible solutions and win their confidence in best possible manner
* Implement the end to end Solution including configuration
* Post Implementation support and reviews with client for continuous improvement
* Internal Review with Teams and Management for product performance and operations improvement
* Provide inputs to and/or participate in discussions with Technical and Functional Teams on ideas
* Willing to Travel frequently to meet Function Heads of Clients across the Globe
* Willingness to travel

**Required Skills:**

* 2-5 years of experience in implementing HRMS/HRIS/HCM
* Detailed understanding of any HCM Product
* Outstanding communication skills
* Willingness to travel

title: Founder's Office (Intern)
description:
**About the Role**

As an Intern in the Founder’s Office at EaseMyTrip, you will work closely with the Founder and senior leadership team to support strategic initiatives, AI-driven projects, business performance tracking, and cross-functional coordination across the organization. Your role involves assisting in data analysis, preparing presentations, monitoring key business metrics, and contributing to AI-led transformation initiatives. You will gain direct exposure to leadership decision-making, investor communication, new business evaluations, and growth strategy across flights, hotels, buses, holidays, and emerging verticals. This position is ideal for a high-potential individual looking to develop strong strategic, analytical, and AI-driven problem-solving skills in a fast-paced travel-tech environment.

**Role & Responsibilities**

1. Business Performance Tracking: Assist in building and updating dashboards tracking GMV, revenue, margins, CAC, repeat rates, conversion rates, and vertical-wise profitability.
2. Data Analysis & Reporting: Analyze business data, prepare structured reports, and highlight insights to support leadership decision-making.
3. AI & Automation Initiatives: Identify repetitive workflows and support implementation of AI tools and automation solutions to improve productivity and operational efficiency.
4. AI Use Case Research: Research and evaluate practical AI applications in pricing, personalization, customer service automation, fraud detection, and marketing optimization.
5. Presentation & Deck Preparation: Support preparation of investor decks, board materials, AI transformation updates, and internal strategy presentations.
6. Strategic & Competitive Research: Conduct structured research on competitors, industry trends, global travel-tech AI adoption, and new growth opportunities.
7. Financial Modeling Support: Assist in building basic financial models, scenario analysis, and profitability assessments for new initiatives.
8. Cross-Functional Coordination: Work with marketing, product, tech, finance, and operations teams to track progress on key strategic and AI initiatives.
9. Performance Review Support: Prepare monthly and quarterly performance summaries with data-backed insights for leadership discussions.
10. Meeting & Execution Follow-Ups: Document key discussion points from leadership meetings and track action items to ensure timely execution.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

1. Strong Academic Background: Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Economics, Finance, Business, or related fields.
2. Analytical & Quantitative Skills: Strong comfort with Excel and data analysis; familiarity with SQL, Python, or analytics tools is a plus.
3. Interest in AI & Digital Transformation: Curiosity about artificial intelligence, automation tools, and technology-led business optimization.
4. Structured Thinking Ability: Capable of breaking down complex problems into clear, logical frameworks.
5. Business Acumen: Basic understanding of unit economics, digital growth metrics, and financial performance indicators.
6. Presentation Skills: Ability to create clean, structured PowerPoint presentations with clear storytelling.
7. High Ownership & Initiative: Self-driven, proactive, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.
8. Strong Communication Skills: Clear written and verbal communication with the ability to summarize complex information simply.
9. Attention to Detail: Disciplined in tracking numbers, action items, and documentation accuracy.
10. Confidentiality & Integrity: Trusted to handle sensitive business and financial information responsibly.

title: Interoperability Solutions Engineer
description:
Join us in pioneering breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.
  
  
Our inspiring and caring environment forms a global community that celebrates diversity and individuality. We encourage you to step beyond your comfort zone, offering resources and flexibility to foster your professional and personal growth, all while valuing your unique contributions.
  
  
**Together, we can beat cancer.**
At Varian, we bring together the worlds’ best talent to realize our vision of a world without fear of cancer. Together, we work passionately to develop and deliver easy-to-use, efficient oncology solutions. If you want to be part of this important mission, we want to hear from you.
  
  
This role location is Denmark, but we will accept applications from any NRB listed country, please ensure you have the right to work and meet the criteria.
  
  
**Role Responsibilities**

* Consulting & Pre-Sales - Support sales teams and customers in identifying customer specific interoperability solutions. Draft a detailed solution proposal. Ensure feasibility.
* Project Management - Scope, plan and monitor implementation in an international environment. Follow deadlines agreed.
* Developing - Technically develop, implement, test and accept interface solutions following communication standards in health care (e.g. HL7, FHIR, Dicom, API, etc). Where required, develop customer specific software features.
* Support: Maintain and support customers and their interface solutions in production
* Mentoring: Share experience and support other team members

**Skills & Experience Required**

* Solid knowledge and professional experience in information technology.
* Solid scripting skills (e.g. TSQL, Java Script, VB, etc)
* Solid understanding of interoperability in health care including common standard (e.g. HL7, Dicom, FHIR)
* Solid project management skills
* Able to handle difficult internal and external customer situations including troubleshooting
* Associate degree or Bachelor degree in Computer Science or equivalent skills.
* Solid knowledge of technical writing / communication.
* Solid English skills (EU B2)

**Fighting cancer calls for big ideas.**
We envision a world without fear of cancer. Achieving this vision takes dedication and commitment from all of us, every single day. That's why we celebrate and value the distinctly beautiful and intersectional identities of each of our employees. We are a mirror of our patient-base, which allows us to innovate. Big ideas come from everywhere, and the best ideas are fostered by our unique individual experiences. At Varian, we encourage you to bring your whole self to work and believe your bold and authentic perspective will help to power more victories over cancer.
  
  
**Who we are**
: We are a team of more than 72,000 highly dedicated Healthineers in more than 70 countries. As a leader in medical technology, we constantly push the boundaries to create better outcomes and experiences for patients, no matter where they live or what health issues they are facing. Our portfolio is crucial for clinical decision-making and treatment pathways.
  
  
**How we work**
: When you join Siemens Healthineers, you become one in a global team of scientists, clinicians, developers, researchers, professionals, and skilled specialists, who believe in each individual’s potential to contribute with diverse ideas. We are from different backgrounds, cultures, religions, political and/or sexual orientations, and work together, to fight the world’s most threatening diseases and enable access to care, united by one purpose: to pioneer breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.
  
  
To find out more about Healthineers’ specific businesses, please visit our company page here.
  
  
As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applications from individuals with disabilities.
  
  
**Data Privacy**
: We care about your data privacy and take compliance with GDPR as well as other data protection legislation seriously. For this reason, we ask you not to send us your CV or resume by email. We ask instead that you create a profile where you can upload your CV. Setting up a profile also lets us know you are interested in career opportunities with us and makes it easy for us to send you an alert when relevant positions become open. Register here to get started.
  
  
**Beware of Job Scams:**
Please beware of potentially fraudulent job postings or suspicious recruiting activity by persons that are currently posing as Siemens Healthineers recruiters/employees.  These scammers may attempt to collect your confidential personal or financial information.  If you are concerned that an offer of employment with Siemens Healthineers might be a scam or that the recruiter is not legitimate, please verify by searching for the posting on the Siemens Healthineers career site.
  
  
**To all recruitment agencies**
: Siemens Healthineers does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, employees, or any other company location. Siemens Healthineers is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applications from individuals with disabilities.

title: Clinical Systems Analyst
description:
**Clinical Systems Analyst (AI Training)**
**About The Role**
We're looking for experienced Clinical Systems Analysts to bring their healthcare IT knowledge to cutting-edge AI development. At Alignerr, we partner with the world's leading AI research teams to build smarter, more accurate AI models — and your clinical systems expertise is exactly what we need.
  
  
This is a unique opportunity to step beyond traditional healthcare IT support and directly influence how AI understands clinical workflows, medical terminology, and hospital operations.
  
  

* Organization: Alignerr
* Type: Hourly Contract
* Location: Remote
* Commitment: 10–40 hours/week

**What You'll Do**

* Evaluate and provide expert feedback on AI-generated content related to clinical systems, healthcare IT workflows, and hospital operations
* Apply your troubleshooting and system optimization knowledge to assess whether AI outputs reflect real-world clinical environments accurately
* Review and critique AI responses involving EHR systems, clinical applications, and healthcare infrastructure
* Identify gaps, inaccuracies, or unrealistic scenarios in AI-generated clinical IT content
* Translate your hands-on clinical systems experience into structured, actionable feedback that improves AI model quality
* Work independently and asynchronously on your own schedule

**Who You Are**

* Experienced in supporting, administering, or optimizing healthcare IT systems such as EHRs, clinical applications, or hospital infrastructure
* Skilled in technical troubleshooting, system testing, and performance optimization within clinical environments
* Comfortable bridging the gap between clinical workflows and technical systems
* Detail-oriented with strong written communication skills
* Self-motivated and able to deliver quality work independently

**Nice to Have**

* Prior experience with data annotation, data quality assessment, or AI evaluation workflows
* Familiarity with HL7, FHIR, or interoperability standards
* Background working across multiple healthcare settings or system types

**Why Join Us**

* Work on meaningful AI projects alongside top research labs and teams
* Fully remote and flexible — work on your own schedule, from anywhere
* Freelance perks: autonomy, variety, and global collaboration
* Contribute to AI systems that could shape the future of healthcare technology
* Potential for ongoing work and contract extension

title: Field Service Specialist
description:
**Overview**
At QIAGEN, we are driven by a simple but powerful vision: making improvements in life possible.
  
  
We’re dedicated to revolutionizing science and healthcare for the better. From our entrepreneurial roots to our current global presence, we've grown into a force for positive change. With thousands of employees across six continents, collaboration is our greatest strength. We’re always striving to identify talented individuals to join our exceptional teams.
  
  
We have played a pivotal role in shaping modern science and healthcare, and we're just getting started. If you're someone who thrives on new challenges, values diversity and wants to make a tangible difference in people's lives, then QIAGEN is the place for you.
  
  
At QIAGEN, every day is an opportunity to make a real-life impact.
  
  
Join us, grow with us, and together, let's shape the future of biological discovery.
  
  
‎
  
  
Position Description
  
  
**Major Tasks**

* Install, maintain, repair and support equipment on all levels (hardware, software and applications)
* Maintain and develop positive relationships with customers
* Utilize relevant databases to input and provide information that will increase effectiveness
* Utilize all available tools such as Service Reports, Spare Part & Service Manuals, ISI Notes, etc
* Assist in the development and maintenance of reference customers
* Assist in Meeting/exceeding sales targets in relation to maintaining high customer satisfaction
* Actively promote and sell Field Service products
* Give active feedback to Sales, Global Product Support and your team/management
* Manage effective available time and resources
* Provide cross-border/district/region support when required
* Positively represent QIAGEN in front of the customer, be a good example!
* Ability to lift ~50lb or 25kgs

Will require work with hazardous substances such as acids and solvents and to work in biological laboratories up to BSL3.
  
  
Position Requirements
  
  

* Technical degree/education in Electronics and reasonable product knowledge within the Life Science industry /markets preferable, Automation experience added advantage
* Preferable minimum of 3-6 years of service and support experience in a comparable position within the after sales service business in the Life Science industry/markets, or equivalent experience maintaining instrumentation
* Proven work experience in developing customer relationships
* Valid driver’s license and Passport and willingness to travel, national and internationally
* Good written and verbal English language communication skills
* Good interpersonal skills
* Ability to work both independently and in a structured working environment
* Willingness to travel for more than 80%.
* Team Player

Personal Requirements
  
  

* Should have strong analytical, problem solving & customer management skills
* Should be willing to learn and pick up information on one own initiative, self-motivated, quick learner and also willing to dissipate and share knowledge
* Self-organized and motivated with the ability to work independently while under guidance from manager.
* Excellent listening, presentation and communication skills at all business levels in both local language and English.

**What We Offer**

* Bonus/Commission
* Local benefits
* Referral Program
* Volunteer Day
* Internal Academy (QIALearn)
* Employee Assistance Program
* Hybrid work (conditional to your role)

Our people are the heartbeat of everything we do. Passion drives us as we push boundaries to innovate and evolve. We inspire with our leadership and make an impact with our actions. We cultivate a collaborative, supportive environment where each individual and team can flourish. We champion accountability and encourage entrepreneurial thinking.
  
  
QIAGEN is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a veteran, or disability.

The role
  
  
Design and select antennas and RF front ends for command, control, and telemetry links, balancing range, gain, and platform constraints (weight, aerodynamics, mounting) against real mission profiles, not just a spec sheet in a lab.
  
  
Own RF system enhancement across the datalink chain — power amplifiers, filtering, frequency planning, and link budget analysis — to push usable range and reliability under real-world interference, not clean-room conditions.
  
  
Build and integrate anti-jamming and ECCM measures: frequency-hopping spread spectrum, adaptive nulling, and resilient waveform design so the platform keeps flying and reporting when someone is actively trying to break the link.
  
  
Own end-to-end RX/TX testing — bench, anechoic chamber, and live field range — validating link performance, jam resistance, and failure behaviour before a platform is trusted with an operational mission.
  
  
02
  
  
**Requirements**

* 01Four or more years in RF engineering, communications systems, or antenna design, ideally for airborne or defence platforms
* 02Strong grounding in RF fundamentals — link budgets, antenna theory, propagation, and modulation schemes
* 03Practical experience with anti-jamming, frequency-hopping, or spread-spectrum communications design
* 04Comfortable with RF test equipment — spectrum analysers, vector network analysers, signal generators — and structured RX/TX validation
* 05Experience with encrypted or secure datalinks for command and control
* 06Able to debug intermittent, field-only RF issues that never reproduce cleanly on the bench

03
  
  
Nice to have
  
  

* +ECCM (Electronic Counter-Countermeasures) design experience
* +SDR (software-defined radio) platform experience (USRP, GNU Radio, or similar)
* +Prior work on military or paramilitary communications systems
* +Antenna simulation tooling (HFSS, CST, or equivalent)

04
  
  
Education
  
  
Bachelor's in Electronics & Communication Engineering, RF/Microwave Engineering, or related discipline; Master's preferred for anti-jam/ECCM specialisation

title: Hospital Health Data Governance Lead
description:
**Hospital Health Data Governance Lead (AI Training)**
**About The Role**
What if your expertise in hospital data governance could directly shape how AI understands, interprets, and works with healthcare information at scale? We're looking for experienced health data governance leaders to help ensure that the healthcare data used to train cutting-edge AI models is accurate, compliant, and clinically meaningful.
  
  
This is a fully remote, flexible contract role. You'll work at the intersection of healthcare and advanced AI — contributing deep domain knowledge that most people simply don't have.
  
  

* Organization: Alignerr
* Type: Hourly Contract
* Location: Remote
* Commitment: 10–40 hours/week

**What You'll Do**

* Evaluate and provide expert guidance on the quality, accuracy, and consistency of hospital health data used in AI model training
* Identify gaps, inconsistencies, and compliance risks in healthcare datasets and flag them with clear, structured feedback
* Apply your knowledge of healthcare governance frameworks — including HIPAA and clinical data standards — to assess data integrity and regulatory alignment
* Review and critique AI-generated outputs related to health data management, governance policies, and clinical workflows
* Collaborate asynchronously with project teams to define and apply standards that make health data trustworthy and useful
* Complete task-based assignments independently on your own schedule

**Who You Are**

* Experienced in healthcare data governance, clinical data management, or health information operations
* Strong working knowledge of healthcare privacy regulations and compliance frameworks, including HIPAA
* Skilled at working across clinical, technical, and administrative domains — you understand what each stakeholder needs from data
* Detail-oriented and methodical — you catch what others miss and can explain why it matters
* Clear, structured communicator who can document findings and recommendations with precision
* Self-motivated and reliable when working independently without day-to-day oversight

**Nice to Have**

* Prior experience with data annotation, data quality assurance, or evaluation systems
* Familiarity with EHR systems, clinical coding standards (ICD, SNOMED, HL7/FHIR), or health analytics platforms
* Background in health informatics, clinical operations, compliance, or health IT
* Exposure to AI tools, machine learning workflows, or data labeling platforms

**Why Join Us**

* Work on cutting-edge AI projects alongside leading research labs and AI teams
* Fully remote and flexible — work when and where it suits you
* Freelance autonomy with the structure of meaningful, high-impact work
* Apply rare, specialized expertise to one of the most consequential applications of AI — healthcare
* Contribute to AI systems that could ultimately improve how health data supports patient care at scale
* Potential for ongoing work and contract extension as new projects launch

description:
**Chemistry Expert (AI Training)**
**About The Role**
What if your years of chemistry training could directly shape how AI reasons through some of the most complex scientific problems in the world? We're looking for Chemistry experts — Masters and PhDs — to design, solve, and evaluate advanced chemistry problems that push the boundaries of what AI can understand and explain.
  
  
This is a fully remote, flexible contract role built for working scientists, researchers, and academics who want to contribute to cutting-edge AI development on their own schedule. No AI background needed — just deep chemistry expertise and a commitment to scientific rigor.
  
  

* Organization: Alignerr
* Type: Hourly Contract
* Location: Remote
* Commitment: 10–40 hours/week

**What You'll Do**

* Design and develop complex, real-world chemistry problems spanning organic, inorganic, physical, and computational chemistry
* Solve and review advanced problems to ensure scientific accuracy, depth, and clarity
* Apply your domain expertise to challenge and improve AI reasoning in chemistry contexts
* Collaborate asynchronously with AI researchers and fellow domain experts to refine model outputs
* Ensure every deliverable meets a high standard of scientific rigor and precision

**Who You Are**

* Holds a Master's or PhD in Chemistry or a closely related field
* Deep expertise in one or more areas: organic, inorganic, physical, or computational chemistry
* Comfortable working with Python or computational chemistry tools such as Gaussian or VASP
* Exceptionally strong written communicator — you can explain complex chemistry clearly and precisely
* Detail-oriented, self-motivated, and reliable when working independently
* Fluent in English

**Nice to Have**

* Prior experience with data annotation, data quality review, or AI evaluation workflows
* Familiarity with AI-generated scientific content or prompt engineering
* Broad cross-disciplinary chemistry knowledge spanning multiple subfields
* Experience publishing or peer-reviewing scientific work

**Why Join Us**

* Work on cutting-edge AI projects alongside leading research labs
* Fully remote and flexible — work when and where it suits you
* Freelance autonomy with the structure of meaningful, task-based work
* Contribute to AI that will meaningfully improve how science is understood and communicated at scale
* Potential for ongoing work and contract extension as new projects launch

title: AI Benchmark & Red-Teaming Specialist
description:
**About Turing:**
Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.

**Role Overview:**

We are seeking an analytical researcher and red-teaming specialist to build evidence-based web-research benchmark tasks that reliably expose weaknesses in state-of-the-art (SOTA) AI models (e.g., Claude Opus 5 Max). In this role, you will discover hard-to-surface facts, build precise research tasks around them, test them directly against leading LLMs, and diagnose the exact failure mechanisms in the model's search and reasoning paths.

Your work will directly shape AI evaluation frameworks, ensuring next-generation frontier models are tested against rigorous, non-trivial real-world research scenarios.

**Job Requirements:**

* **Core Experience:**
  1+ years in investigative research, fact-checking, AI benchmark task authoring, red-teaming, or technical QA review.
* **Benchmark Familiarity:**
  Proven experience authoring, testing, or reviewing tasks for AI benchmarks such as
  **GAIA, BrowseComp, SimpleQA, SWE-bench, Terminal-Bench, or Humanity’s Last Exam (HLE)**
  .
* **Analytical & OSINT Skills:**
  Intermediate-to-advanced web search and Open Source Intelligence (OSINT) skills; ability to navigate academic archives, local records, or obscure databases.
* **Model Trajectory Debugging:**
  Strong analytical capability to inspect model reasoning chains, search logs, and source selection to diagnose root causes of failure.
* **Precision Writing:**
  Ability to author clear, unambiguous benchmark prompts with bulletproof, primary-sourced answer keys.

**Job Responsibilities:**

* **Obscure Fact Discovery:**
  Deeply research niche topics to identify factual ground truths that cannot be surfaced via simple, direct search queries.
* **Source Verification:**
  Rigorously verify facts against primary or highly credible sources, cross-check for contradictory evidence, and document exact source URLs.
* **Task Construction:**
  Draft clear, answerable benchmark tasks designed specifically to expose structural weaknesses in model research strategies.
* **Red-Teaming & Model Testing:**
  Execute tasks against designated SOTA models to confirm they reliably trigger intended model failures.
* **Failure Diagnosis & Debugging:**
  Trace model run logs, search trajectories, and intermediate outputs to pinpoint exactly where and why the model failed (distinguishing genuine model limitations from ambiguous prompts).
* **Pattern Scaling & Review:**
  Apply validated "model-breaking" research patterns across new domains and, for strong performers, review tasks authored by peer trainers.
  **Strong Plus (Preferred Qualifications)**
* Bachelor or higher degree from relevant engineering domain is a must for this position.
* Prior experience specifically designing prompt-injection or reasoning-trap tasks that break SOTA models.
* Advanced OSINT capabilities or published investigative/academic research demonstrating deep source verification.
* Niche domain expertise in areas rich with hard-to-find records (e.g., local government filings, regional sports history, legal archives, historical patents).
* Experience serving as a lead reviewer, benchmark auditor, or quality owner on AI evaluation projects.

**Offer Details:**

* Commitments Required: Upto 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST.
* Engagement type: Contractor
* Engagement Length: upto 4 weeks

**Evaluation Process:**

* Candidates will be require to submit a
  **Job Interest Form & assessment**
  .
* Talents finalized in assessment will go through assessment, review & will proceed further accordingly.

title: IV Fluids Manufacturing Plant – Technical Project Consultant
description:
We are looking for an experienced
**Technical Project Engineer / Consultant specializing in Intravenous (IV) Fluids Manufacturing Plants**
to support the planning, designing, establishment, installation, and commissioning of IV fluids manufacturing facilities in India or abroad. The candidate should have practical knowledge of large-volume parenterals (LVP), sterile liquid manufacturing, aseptic processing, filling and sealing systems, terminal sterilization, and pharmaceutical plant utilities.

The role involves providing technical expertise throughout the project lifecycle, ensuring compliance with applicable pharmaceutical manufacturing standards, revised Schedule M, WHO-GMP requirements, and other relevant regulatory guidelines.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Plan and coordinate the establishment of IV fluids manufacturing plants for products such as Normal Saline (0.9% Sodium Chloride), Dextrose Solutions, Ringer’s Lactate, and other intravenous infusion solutions.
* Develop and review plant layouts, manufacturing process flow diagrams, equipment specifications, and production capacity requirements.
* Select and coordinate the procurement of IV fluids manufacturing machinery, including solution preparation tanks, mixing vessels, filtration systems, bottle or bag filling lines, sealing systems, and packaging equipment.
* Supervise machinery installation, erection, commissioning, trial runs, and production line integration.
* Coordinate the setup of sterile manufacturing areas, cleanrooms, HVAC systems, purified water systems, Water for Injection (WFI), and other critical pharmaceutical utilities.
* Provide technical guidance on IV solution preparation, filtration, filling, container closure integrity, terminal sterilization, and applicable in-process controls.
* Coordinate with machinery manufacturers, EPC contractors, architects, utility system suppliers, and pharmaceutical regulatory consultants.
* Support equipment qualification, process validation, cleaning validation, sterilization validation, and preparation of technical documentation, as applicable.
* Assist in establishing quality control and microbiological testing facilities for IV fluids manufacturing.
* Ensure compliance with applicable GMP requirements, revised Schedule M, WHO-GMP guidelines, and relevant Indian pharmaceutical regulations.
* Troubleshoot technical issues during installation, commissioning, validation, and initial commercial production.
* Support project planning, cost estimation, machinery selection, implementation schedules, and budget control.

**Required Qualifications and Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Chemical, Mechanical, Pharmaceutical, or related Engineering, or another relevant pharmaceutical qualification.
* 3–8 years of relevant experience in
  **IV fluids, large-volume parenterals (LVP), sterile injectable manufacturing, or pharmaceutical plant project execution**
  .
* Practical experience in IV fluids manufacturing processes, solution preparation, filling, sealing, sterilization, and packaging.
* Knowledge of cleanroom design, HVAC systems, purified water, WFI systems, and other pharmaceutical utilities.
* Familiarity with revised Schedule M, WHO-GMP, GMP documentation, equipment qualification, and process validation.
* Experience in machinery installation, plant commissioning, production troubleshooting, and technical project coordination.
* Previous involvement in setting up or expanding an IV fluids manufacturing plant will be highly preferred.
* Experience with pharmaceutical EPC projects, plant engineering, or technical consultancy will be an added advantage.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in the
**design, installation, commissioning, or operation of an IV fluids manufacturing plant**
, rather than only general pharmaceutical production experience. Candidates who have successfully executed IV fluids or LVP plant projects will receive preference.

**How to Apply**

Interested candidates and consultants with relevant IV fluids manufacturing or plant commissioning experience are requested to share their updated resume and contact details.

* Support periodic data quality assessments and ensure compliance with prescribed reporting formats and organizational standards.

* Guide field teams on data entry, evidence uploads, documentation protocols, and reporting procedures.
* Develop simple user guides, training materials, and standard operating procedures wherever required.
* Provide ongoing technical and operational support to field teams to improve data quality and reporting efficiency.

**5. Field Visits and Stakeholder Coordination**

* Undertake extensive travel to project locations to understand implementation progress, verify field-level information, and strengthen documentation practices.
* Interact with beneficiaries, field teams, government officials, and other stakeholders to collect relevant project information and document outcomes.
* Conduct field-level verification of project activities, supporting evidence, and success stories.
* Perform other documentation, reporting, and data management responsibilities as assigned by the reporting manager.

Eligibility and Desired Qualifications

* A bachelor’s degree in Social Sciences, Development Studies, Rural Development, Management, Journalism, Mass Communication, Statistics, or a related discipline.
* Fresh graduates are welcome to apply. Prior experience is not mandatory.
* Good written and verbal communication skills in English and Hindi.
* Working knowledge of MS Excel, MS Word, PowerPoint, and Google Sheets.
* Strong attention to detail and the ability to work with data, reports, and supporting documents.
* Willingness to travel extensively to project locations, including rural and remote areas.
* A proactive attitude, willingness to learn, and ability to coordinate effectively with diverse teams.

Key Competencies

* Strong documentation, report-writing, and analytical skills.
* High levels of accuracy, ownership, and attention to detail.
* Effective communication and coordination skills.
* Ability to manage multiple assignments and meet reporting deadlines.
* Comfort with digital tools, MIS platforms, and data validation processes.
* Adaptability and willingness to work in dynamic field environments.

What We Offer

  for the right candidate.

* Hands-on exposure to large-scale social development projects, MIS, data quality assurance, and donor reporting.
* Opportunities to work with field teams, government stakeholders, and development partners.

* A collaborative work environment with opportunities for professional growth.

* Ensure alignment between quality, environmental, and safety documentation.

  .
* 5–7 years of experience in quality systems, audits, and compliance in recycling, e‑waste, ITAD, electronics, automotive, or manufacturing.

* Strong organisational & analytical skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, detailed oriented environment and work independently or in a team.

* 4+ years hands-on with Endur as a consultant, business analyst, functional specialist, QA specialist or IT support specialist with working knowledge of V19 and above.
* At least 4+ years of industry work experience.
* Good working understanding of various functional areas and relevant modules of Endur.

You work directly with the founder and the Founder's Office as an apprentice operator. Not a coffee-and-decks internship. You will run real pieces of live systems, own small mandates end to end, and sit in rooms interns rarely enter: pipeline reviews, launch planning, hiring conversations. All editorial and creative deliverables will be produced in English for global audiences.
  
  
This role is primarily focused on editing and adapting approved source content rather than writing technical narratives from scratch. The ideal candidate can improve clarity, structure and tone without diluting technical meaning, introducing inaccuracies or oversimplifying the subject matter.
  
  
An interest in AI, emerging technology and new approaches to creative production is essential.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Edit and refine technical editorial and marketing content for clarity, accuracy, flow and audience relevance.

* Document approved language, recurring feedback and editorial decisions for future use.

* Use approved AI and editorial tools to support research, comparison, versioning and efficiency while maintaining human editorial judgment.
* Maintain discretion when working with confidential and highly sensitive information.

**Experience You Bring**

* 5+ years of experience in technical editing, technical writing, technology journalism, digital publishing or editorial marketing.
* Demonstrated ability to edit complex technology content without losing accuracy or nuance.
* Experience writing for technically fluent consumer, professional or business audiences.

* Experience collaborating across regions, time zones and shift-based teams.
* Ability to work an assigned nontraditional shift and participate in scheduled weekend and holiday rotations.
* Interest in AI, emerging technology and production innovation.

This is a hybrid, shift-based role supporting a global production model. title: Junior Engineer (JE) – Drone Integration & Testing
description:
**Company Description**
ASP Aerotech Private Limited is an Indian aerospace technology company specializing in the design, development, and manufacturing of unmanned aerial systems (UAS), drones, aerospace electronics, and embedded technologies. The organization focuses on advancing indigenous aerospace capabilities and contributing to India’s self-reliance in unmanned systems through mission-oriented innovation and reliable engineering. ASP Aerotech views unmanned systems as integrated platforms, combining airframes, flight computers, power and propulsion, payload integration, navigation, and secure data communication. Its technology spans from compact micro-drones to long-endurance fixed-wing systems for applications such as surveillance, inspection, mapping, and emergency response. The company emphasizes research, development, and practical mission requirements to deliver dependable, purpose-built solutions designed in India and engineered for the mission.

**ROLE OVERVIEW**

We are looking for a hands-on Junior Engineer to build, integrate and test multirotor and fixed-wing drones. Working with our senior engineers, you will assemble airframes, configure flight controllers and ESCs, integrate sensors, create SolidWorks parts and support flight trials. This role suits an engineer who has already built and flown drones and wants to grow into full platform design.

**Position**

Junior Engineer (JE) – Drone Integration & Testing

**Department**

Engineering / Production & R&D

**Location**

Greater Noida – on-site, with field trials as required

**Employment type**

Full-time

**Experience**

0–2 years (freshers with strong hands-on drone projects are encouraged to apply)

**Salary**

As per industry standards

**Reports to**

Senior / Mid-Level Drone Engineer

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Build and integration**

•      Assemble, wire and integrate multirotor and fixed-wing drones on the production line and in R&D, following build standards and checklists.

•      Install and configure flight controllers, ESCs, motors, GNSS, telemetry radios and power systems.

•      Integrate payloads and sensors such as gimbal cameras, LiDAR and companion computers under senior guidance.

•      Solder, crimp and build harnesses to a production-quality standard; follow ESD practices.

**Design support**

•      Create and modify 3D parts, mounts and enclosures in SolidWorks; prepare drawings for 3D printing and CNC cutting.

•      Support propulsion and battery selection by running bench and thrust tests and recording results.

**Software and configuration**

•      Set up and tune ArduPilot parameters; use Mission Planner / QGroundControl for calibration, mission planning and log review.

•      Write and maintain Python scripts for testing, MAVLink communication and data logging.

•      Assist with companion-computer setup for edge-AI detection and tracking applications.

**Testing, QC and documentation**

•      Carry out pre-flight checks, hover-cage tests and field flight trials; analyse flight logs and report issues.

•      Perform quality checks on finished drones and maintain build, test and configuration records.

•      Troubleshoot and repair drones returned from the field.

**REQUIRED SKILLS**

**Hardware**

1.    Hands-on experience building and flying at least one multirotor drone.

2.    Working knowledge of flight controller, ESC, motor and battery (LiPo / Li-ion) setup.

3.    Good soldering, wiring and electronics fault-finding skills; ability to use a multimeter and power supply.

4.    Basic understanding of sensors (GNSS, IMU, camera) and RF telemetry links.

**Software and design**

1.    Hands-on experience with ArduPilot (or PX4) and Mission Planner / QGroundControl.

2.    Programming in Python (mandatory); basic C/C++.

3.    SolidWorks (mandatory) and AutoCAD for parts and drawings.

4.    Basic understanding of MAVLink.

**Good to have**

•      Fixed-wing or VTOL build experience.

•      Lua scripting in ArduPilot.

•      Edge-AI experience on Jetson / Raspberry Pi (e.g., YOLO-based detection).

•      Basic PCB design (KiCad / Altium / Eagle) or embedded projects on STM32 / ESP32.

•      Drone pilot certificate (DGCA RPC) or competition experience (e.g., SAE, IIT techfests).

**QUALIFICATIONS**

**Education:**
B.E./B.Tech or Diploma in Aerospace, Aeronautical, Electronics, Electrical, Mechanical, Mechatronics or a related field.

**Experience:**
0–2 years. Freshers are welcome if they can show drones they have built and flown, through projects, internships or competitions.

**Personal attributes**

•      Hands-on, careful and eager to learn.

•      Follows safety, ESD and battery-handling procedures.

•      Willing to travel for field trials and deployments.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

•      Hands-on work across multirotor, fixed-wing and autonomy projects from day one.

•      Mentoring by experienced drone engineers and a clear path to a Drone Engineer role.

•      An in-house facility with assembly, fabrication, 3D printing and hover-test infrastructure.

•      Salary as per industry standards.

**HOW TO APPLY**

Email your CV and project portfolio (photos, videos, flight logs or GitHub links) to
**admin@aspaerotech.com**
with the subject line
**“Application – Junior Engineer (Drones)”**
.

0–2 Years

Ojaswi Kumar (Founders Office)

About PREWAL Studio :

PREWAL Studio Private Limited is a garment manufacturing and export company based in Gurugram, India.

**Manufacturing Execution System (MES)**
across our organisation.

We are looking for a smart, technically capable, and proactive individual to help us successfully implement, manage, and optimise this system.

We are hiring an
**MES Executive – Implementation & Operations**
who will be responsible for coordinating the implementation, daily management, monitoring, and effective utilisation of our Manufacturing Execution System across different departments.

The selected candidate will work closely with the Founder's Office, department heads, production teams, and external technology partners to ensure the system functions smoothly and is effectively adopted across the organisation.

This is a hands-on role combining
**technology, manufacturing operations, data analysis, troubleshooting, and cross-departmental coordination**
.

**We are not looking for someone who merely enters data into software. We are looking for someone who takes ownership, understands how systems work, identifies problems, and ensures that technology is being used effectively.**

Key Responsibilities:-
  

**1. MES Implementation & System Management**

* Coordinate the implementation and rollout of the company's Manufacturing Execution System.
* Work closely with external technology partners to support system configuration, testing, troubleshooting, and deployment.
* Understand existing manufacturing workflows and help integrate them into the MES.
* Assist in maintaining system master data, user accounts, access permissions, and configuration settings.
* Act as the primary internal point of contact for MES-related coordination and operational issues.

**2. Daily System Operations & Monitoring**

* Oversee the day-to-day functioning of the MES across relevant departments.
* Monitor whether employees are correctly and consistently using the system.
* Identify missing entries, incorrect data, process gaps, and operational discrepancies.
* Coordinate with department heads to ensure timely updates and accurate information.

* Provide first-level technical support to employees using the MES.

* Identify recurring technical problems and coordinate with external support teams for resolution.
* Maintain records of system issues, their status, and corrective actions.

**4. Data Management, Analysis & Reporting**

* Monitor system dashboards, production data, and operational reports.
* Analyse information to identify discrepancies, delays, and potential operational bottlenecks.
* Prepare regular MIS reports and operational summaries for management.
* Use Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets for data verification, reconciliation, and analysis.

**5. Training & Cross-Departmental Coordination**

* Assist in training employees on the correct usage of the MES.
* Coordinate with teams across production, cutting, sewing, finishing, quality, stores, merchandising, and other relevant departments.
* Ensure employees understand their respective responsibilities within the system.
* Support the adoption of standardised digital workflows.
* Work with department heads to resolve issues affecting system usage and data accuracy.

**6. Process Improvement & System Optimisation**

* Identify opportunities to improve system utilisation and operational workflows.
* Suggest improvements in data collection, reporting, and process efficiency.
* Help develop simple guidelines and documentation for employees.
* Monitor system adoption and recommend corrective actions wherever necessary.
* Support the company's broader digital transformation initiatives.

* **0–2 years of professional experience.**
  Smart fresh graduates with strong technical aptitude are encouraged to apply.

* Strong computer proficiency and ability to quickly understand unfamiliar software applications.
* Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets, including formulas, filters, lookups, and basic data analysis.
* Strong logical reasoning, analytical thinking, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to troubleshoot basic software-related issues independently.
* Good communication, coordination, and follow-up skills.
* Strong attention to detail, organisational ability, and sense of ownership.
* Willingness to work in a manufacturing environment and coordinate regularly with factory-floor employees.

Preferred Qualifications :-
  

The following will be considered significant advantages but are
**not mandatory**
:

* Previous experience or internship exposure in garment manufacturing, apparel exports, textiles, or factory operations.
* Familiarity with Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), or other business management software.

* Experience preparing MIS reports, dashboards, or analysing operational data.

title: Senior Lead Technical Analyst
description:
**Overview**
**WELCOME TO**
**SITA**
We're the team that keeps airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our tech and communication innovations are the secret behind the success of the world’s air travel industry.
  
  
You'll find us at 95% of international hubs. We partner closely with over 2,500 transportation and government clients, each with their own unique needs and challenges. Our goal is to find fresh solutions and cutting-edge tech to make their operations run like clockwork. Want to be a part of something big?
  
  
Are you ready to love your job? The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA.
  
  
**About The Role & Team**
We are seeking a highly experienced
**Senior Lead Technical Analyst**
to drive the strategic evolution of our ServiceNow platform, with a particular focus on
**Customer Service Management (CSM)**
and
**Sales & Order Management (SOM)**
capabilities.
  
  
This role will play a critical part in building internal expertise across newly adopted ServiceNow modules, driving platform governance, shaping the roadmap, and ensuring successful business adoption across the organization. The successful candidate will act as a trusted advisor to business and technology stakeholders, translating business objectives into scalable ServiceNow solutions while championing innovation through AI-enabled capabilities.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines deep ServiceNow expertise with strong business process transformation experience and a proven ability to influence senior stakeholders, drive organizational change, and lead enterprise-wide initiatives.
  
  
Experience within telecommunications, technology, or global enterprise environments is highly desirable.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
**Platform Strategy & Leadership**

* Define and drive the strategic roadmap for ServiceNow CSM and SOM capabilities.
* Provide technical leadership and guidance across ServiceNow implementation and enhancement initiatives.
* Establish governance frameworks, standards, and best practices for platform development and administration.
* Partner with architects, business leaders, and product teams to ensure platform investments align with organizational objectives.
* Evaluate emerging ServiceNow capabilities and recommend opportunities for innovation and optimization.

**ServiceNow CSM & SOM Transformation**

* Lead the implementation, configuration, and continuous improvement of ServiceNow Customer Service Management (CSM) and Sales & Order Management (SOM).
* Design scalable business processes and operating models that maximize value from ServiceNow investments.
* Support business stakeholders through transformation initiatives, ensuring adoption of new ways of working.
* Identify process improvement opportunities and drive automation across customer-facing and order management workflows.
* Ensure alignment between business requirements and technical solution design.

**AI & Innovation**

* Lead assessment, evaluation, and implementation of AI-powered capabilities within the ServiceNow ecosystem.
* Identify opportunities to leverage AI for customer experience improvements, workflow automation, and operational efficiency.
* Contribute to AI governance, risk management, compliance, and adoption frameworks.
* Stay informed on industry trends, emerging technologies, and ServiceNow AI developments.

**Stakeholder Engagement & Change Management**

* Build strong relationships with executive stakeholders and business leaders.
* Facilitate workshops and strategy sessions to define future-state processes and platform capabilities.
* Lead organizational change initiatives associated with technology transformation.
* Influence stakeholders to secure buy-in and adoption of new solutions and operating models.
* Mentor and develop internal teams, helping build long-term ServiceNow expertise within the organization.

**Governance & Continuous Improvement**

* Define and maintain platform architecture principles and governance processes.
* Ensure alignment with enterprise architecture standards and technology strategy.
* Monitor platform performance and recommend enhancements to improve user experience and business outcomes.
* Support vendor management, licensing optimization, and strategic technology partnerships.
* Maintain architecture documentation, standards, and technical roadmaps.

**Qualifications**
**ABOUT YOUR SKILLS**




+ Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Information Systems, or a related discipline.
+ Extensive experience working with the ServiceNow platform in enterprise environments.
+ Demonstrated experience implementing and/or supporting ServiceNow Customer Service Management (CSM) and/or Sales & Order Management (SOM).
+ Strong understanding of service management, customer operations, and order management processes.
+ Proven experience leading large-scale digital transformation initiatives.
+ Experience defining platform strategies, governance models, and architectural standards.
+ Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills.
+ Ability to translate complex business requirements into technical solutions and roadmaps.
+ Experience driving organizational change and business adoption of new technologies.
+ Experience working in Agile delivery environments.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**


* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA).
* ServiceNow CSM Implementation Specialist certification.
* ServiceNow SOM implementation experience.
* ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD).
* Experience with ServiceNow AI, GenAI, Predictive Intelligence, Virtual Agent, or similar capabilities.
* Telecommunications industry experience.
* Experience leading global or geographically distributed teams.
* Knowledge of enterprise architecture frameworks and governance practices.

**Nice to Have**

* ITSM and ITOM experience.
* Experience with telecom service delivery and customer operations.
* ServiceNow Integration Hub and Workflow Automation.
* Enterprise architecture and operating model design.
* Vendor management and contract negotiations.
* Data analytics, reporting, and KPI framework development.

**What We Offer**
We’re all about diversity. We operate in 200 countries and speak 60 different languages and cultures. We’re really proud of our inclusive environment. Our offices are comfortable and fun places to work, and we make sure you get to work from home too. Find out what it's like to join our team and take a step closer to your best life ever.

Make your workday suit your life and plans.

Take up to 30 days a year to work from any location in the world.

We’ve got you covered with our Employee Assistance Program (EAP), for you and your dependents 24/7, 365 days/year. We also offer Champion Health – a personalized platform that supports a range of wellbeing needs.

title: Application Specialist - SAP PP, QM, Digital Manufacturing
description:
As an Application Specialist, you will help run, maintain and develop SAP-supported production processes across Production Planning (PP), Quality Management (QM) and Digital Manufacturing. You’ll focus on SAP S/4HANA and SAP Digital Manufacturing, helping ensure our production operations are robust, efficient and aligned with business needs.
  
  
You’ll work at the intersection of technology and business, collaborating with teams in India and internationally. You’ll also support the transition of activities from Denmark to India, sharing knowledge and helping build strong, sustainable ways of working.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Run, maintain and develop SAP-supported production processes using SAP S/4HANA and SAP Digital Manufacturing.
* Provide hands-on configuration and support for SAP PP, QM and Digital Manufacturing, taking a service-minded approach and maintaining clear solution documentation.
* Deliver and stabilise Topsoe’s production-supported processes, working with Global Process Owners (GPOs) to support alignment with global business processes.
* Manage minor projects and change requests independently, and contribute as a functional lead on larger initiatives.
* Support knowledge transfer and the transition of activities from Denmark to India.
* Develop deep expertise in the SAP production area, share knowledge with colleagues and drive continuous improvement in our SAP solutions.
* Keep stakeholders informed about solutions, progress and issues through clear verbal and written communication.

**What You’ll Bring**

* 5–7 years of relevant SAP experience in Production Planning, Quality Management and/or Digital Manufacturing.
* Hands-on experience as an SAP functional consultant, including practical experience with SAP S/4HANA. Experience with SAP Digital Manufacturing is an advantage.
* Experience working as an SAP consultant, including direct client interaction and project implementation. Experience supporting clients or delivering implementations in the European Union is an advantage.
* Strong SAP functional skills. Experience with middleware such as SAP PCo or SAP Cloud Platform Integration (CPI), and technical skills in Java or JavaScript, will be an advantage.
* The ability to work collaboratively, share knowledge and contribute proactively to high-quality SAP consulting and support.
* Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to explain solutions, progress and issues clearly to different audiences.

You’ll bring a self-driven, proactive approach and a commitment to making Topsoe’s SAP solutions as effective and reliable as possible. This is an opportunity to contribute to important production processes while working with diverse teams across locations.
  
  
**Why Join Us**
At Topsoe, you will join a team of passionate problem solvers dedicated to shaping a more sustainable future. Collaboration and respect are at the heart of our culture, where every idea is valued and can drive real change. As a global leader in advanced technology for the energy transition, we offer you the chance to make a direct impact, work on exciting international projects, and develop your leadership skills in a supportive and innovative environment. You will be part of a workplace that values high standards, continuous improvement, and professional growth. Your expertise will help us deliver meaningful solutions and drive progress together, while you enjoy opportunities for personal and professional development in a truly global setting.
  
  
**Your New Team**
You will join Global IT, Corporate Applications department, and sub-team of: Global Supply (GS) IT Services. The department is responsible for running and maintaining support for IT systems supporting Topsoe GS related processes across: Procurement, Production Planning, Manufacturing. Quality, Maintenance, Warehouse, Logistics, and HSE.
  
  
The IT system support is largely based on SAP technology. The target for the unit is to continuously serve Topsoe GS mission including supporting business productivity targets by offering secure and stable solutions, as well as continuously introduction new technology including AI, while adhering to the SAP roadmap. The SAP organization consists of ~20 deeply skilled SAP colleagues who are experts in functional and technical areas. The team is based in Denmark and India supporting the global organization.
  
  
**How You Can Apply**
If you would like to be part of a team of skilled and professional colleagues in an informal organization, please submit your documents in English.
  
  
**Application deadline:**
08-11-2026.
  
  
You do not need to attach a cover letter to your application – just include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are applying. Please also avoid the use of photos in your CV. Both of these measures are to ensure a fair and unbiased process
  
  
We welcome applications from all qualified candidates, irrespective of their gender, age, religion, disability, ethnic background, and geographical location. We encourage individuals from diverse cultures and countries to apply and contribute to our global team.
  
  
To ensure a secure and trustworthy work environment, our recruitment process may include background checks, requests for criminal records, and contact with references.
  
  
*To headhunters: Thank you for your interest in our company. However, we would like to inform you that we have a dedicated internal team managing our recruitment process. We kindly request that you refrain from reaching out to us regarding potential candidates. Thank you for your understanding.*
As part of our recruitment activities, we engage an external recruitment agency located in Poland. In connection with its support of the recruitment process, the agency may process applicants’ personal data on our behalf and in compliance with applicable data protection laws, including GDPR where relevant.
  
  
**About Us**
Topsoe is a leading global provider of advanced technology and solutions for the energy transition.
  
  
Built on decades of scientific research and innovation, we are working with customers and partners to drive energy resiliency and to achieve their sustainability goals.
  
  
We offer world-leading solutions for transforming renewable resources into fuels and chemicals, and we provide technologies needed to produce low-carbon and conventional fuels and chemicals as well as ensuring clean air.
  
  
We were founded in 1940 and are headquartered in Denmark, with around 2,500 employees serving customers all around the globe. To learn more, visit www.topsoe.com.

description:

* Bachelor of Technology in Computer Science
* Bachelor of Commerce
* Master of Commerce

You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.

Fuelled by the brilliance of our people, EY has emerged as the strongest brand and the most attractive employer in our field, with market-leading growth over competitors. Our people work side-by-side with market-leading entrepreneurs, game-changers, disruptors, and visionaries. At EY, you will have a personalized Career Journey and also the chance to tap into the resources of our career frameworks to better know about your roles, skills, and opportunities.

Join us in shaping the future with confidence. Apply Now

Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) is a global professional services firm known for entrepreneurial, action-oriented professionals who take a hands-on approach to solving complex client problems. Its culture is guided by Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity. In 2023, A&M established a Global Capability Center in India to expand specialized talent, accelerate delivery, enable automation, and support global business units across the Americas, EMEA, and APAC. The Gurgaon-based center partners with consulting case teams on end-to-end delivery and thought leadership rather than operating as a traditional back-office function. It brings together consulting and industry professionals across sectors including Consumer & Retail, Healthcare, Software & Technology, Automotive & Industrials, Hospitality & Leisure, Energy & Natural Resources, and Financial Services. The center is growing rapidly and already has more than 900 team members.

**About the Role**

Own the quality, usability, and adoption of knowledge management content and SharePoint Online solutions supporting A&M’s consulting business. You will work within the Global AI and Knowledge Innovation Organization alongside KM Business Partners to translate business needs into structured sites, pages, lists, workflows, and user-facing documentation. The role combines SharePoint Online creation, development, and administration with content governance, document tagging, document sanitization, testing, rollout, and hypercare support. You will coordinate with stakeholders across business units, maintain clear action tracking, and ensure knowledge products remain accurate, discoverable, and aligned with evolving processes and platform capabilities. This is a hands-on role for a polished communicator who can work independently, manage competing priorities, and improve the way practitioners access knowledge and AI-enabled tools. Candidates must bring relevant experience from an MBB firm, Big Four organization, or another professional services environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own SharePoint Online site, page, and list creation, development, administration, and maintenance, applying consistent information architecture, navigation, permissions, usability, and visual standards.
* Govern knowledge content through accurate document tagging, sanitization, organization, metadata maintenance, and quality checks that improve discoverability, reuse, compliance, and practitioner confidence.
* Coordinate user acceptance testing for new KM tools and platform features by preparing test plans, tracking defects, consolidating feedback, and driving issues toward resolution.
* Enable successful rollouts through clear user guides, process documentation, stakeholder communications, and responsive hypercare support that increases adoption and reduces operational friction.
* Support KM Business Partners with stakeholder meetings by managing schedules, preparing materials, recording decisions, tracking actions, and maintaining transparent follow-through across initiatives.
* Build trusted relationships with consulting business units, senior stakeholders, and KM colleagues, translating requirements into practical solutions while keeping delivery risks, dependencies, and priorities visible.
* Contribute beyond immediate responsibilities when needed, adapting quickly to shifting timelines and helping the wider KM team deliver consistent, high-quality outcomes.

**Essential Skills & Technologies**

* Advanced hands-on capability in SharePoint Online creation, development, and administration is mandatory, including site and page design, list maintenance, navigation, structure, and content management.
* Practical experience with document tagging, metadata, document sanitization, content organization, quality assurance, user acceptance testing, process documentation, and rollout or hypercare support is required.
* Strong Microsoft 365 capability and polished English communication are essential, with the ability to explain information clearly to technical and non-technical audiences and engage senior stakeholders.
* Professional services experience from an MBB firm, Big Four organization, or comparable professional services employer is mandatory for this role.
* Strong organization, attention to detail, judgment, problem-solving, prioritization, and follow-through are required to manage multiple knowledge initiatives independently.
* Salesforce exposure and additional languages such as Portuguese, Mandarin, Cantonese, Japanese, or Korean would be beneficial but are not required.

**Additional Plus**

* Experience supporting AI-enabled knowledge tools, digital workplace platforms, or enterprise content initiatives would strengthen your ability to contribute to GAIKO’s innovation agenda.
* SharePoint information architecture, governance, permissions, workflow, or adoption-focused experience would help improve the consistency and scalability of KM solutions.
* Exposure to consulting case delivery, thought leadership, or cross-geography stakeholder environments would be useful when translating business needs into practical knowledge products.

**What You'll Bring**

* You bring three to five years of experience in knowledge management, content management, digital workplace administration, or a related professional services environment, ideally from an MBB firm, Big Four organization, or comparable professional services organization. SharePoint Online is a non-negotiable capability: you should be able to create, develop, administer, and maintain sites, pages, and lists rather than only update existing content.
* You have practical experience with document tagging, document sanitization, content organization, metadata, and quality assurance, and you understand how disciplined governance improves searchability, reuse, and trust. You are comfortable facilitating UAT, consolidating feedback, documenting processes, supporting launches, and providing structured hypercare.
* Your communication is polished, concise, and confident across technical and non-technical audiences, including senior stakeholders. You organize work rigorously, close actions reliably, surface risks early, and remain adaptable when priorities or timelines shift.
* A bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Management, Technology, Library Science, or a related field supports your ability to connect business requirements with practical platform solutions. You work independently while keeping collaborators informed and contributing positively beyond your immediate remit.

**Why Join Us**

* Join a growing global capability center where knowledge management directly supports consulting case delivery, thought leadership, AI enablement, and practitioner productivity across major markets.
* Work alongside KM Business Partners and global stakeholders on visible initiatives that combine SharePoint administration, content governance, adoption, and emerging knowledge technologies.
* Build a broader consulting-services career through formal training, on-the-job learning, performance development, and exposure to diverse industries, geographies, and business units.

**What We Offer**

* A collaborative, entrepreneurial environment that values independent thinking, practical problem-solving, inclusive diversity, and measurable impact on clients and internal practitioners.
* Structured performance development, formal training, on-the-job learning, and opportunities to build technical and professional capabilities while progressing your career.
* Well-being benefits and personal support resources designed to help employees thrive professionally and personally within a high-growth global organization.

description:
Job Title – Workday Technical Product Lead – HCM
  
  
Preferred Location – Hyderabad & Gurgaon India
  
  
Full time/Part Time - Full Time
  
  
Build a career with confidence Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions is committed to creating solutions that matter for people and our planet for generations to come. From the beginning, we've led in inventing new technologies and entirely new industries. Today, we continue to lead because we have a world-class, diverse workforce that puts the customer at the center of everything we do.
  
  
**Summary**
Seeking a Workday Technical Product Lead – HCM to analyze, design, transform and implement activities globally. Additional responsibilities include supporting the delivered Workday HCM solutions. The work involves close partnership with the HR Technology team members globally as well as stakeholders in the HR business COEs, Digital/IT, External Vendor organizations. Key objectives include delivery of best-in-class HR technology solutions that support business needs and objectives.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
As a Workday Technical Product Lead – HCM you’ll be responsible for:
  
  
Be a subject matter expert to business stakeholders while gathering requirements and consulting on Core HCM capabilities and configurations.
  
  
Design, test, and implement scalable, flexible, and maintainable business processes and solutions to meet identified business needs
  
  
Translate business strategy and stakeholder needs into documented business & technical requirements.
  
  
Provide Workday support including analysis and troubleshooting of issues related to design, configurations, business processes, integrations, and data.
  
  
Coordinate testing to ensure that the product functionality and all upstream/downstream integrations are working as designed. Ensure that the required specifications are met with efficient, accurate, and quality information.
  
  
Familiar with Application Management Services (AMS) teams in Core HCM to understand the operational activities in detailed manner.
  
  
Stay current with Workday, other leading HCM technologies, Gen AI relevant to the product Core HCM.
  
  
Develop trusted relationships with the business stakeholders and Digital (DT) teams.
  
  
Assist the Product Managers and the Product Leaders with the development of strategic roadmap for Core HCM.
  
  
Ownership of the half yearly WD release cycle for Core HCM, which includes the analysis, reviewing, impacts and adoption of new features.
  
  
**Minimum Requirements**
5+ years of experience in HR technology, with at least 3 years of experience in Workday HCM Modules.
  
  
Strong knowledge of HR processes and practices.
  
  
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  
  
Ability to work independently across different time zones in a fast-paced environment.
  
  
Ability to work collaboratively across multiple departments and levels within the organization.
  
  
Comfortable with SDLC and Agile product delivery frameworks and tools such as JIRA.
  
  
**Education**
Bachelor's degree in information systems, Computer Science, Human Resources or related field.
  
  
**Benefits**
We are committed to offering competitive benefits programs for all of our employees, and enhancing our programs when necessary.
  
  
Have peace of mind and body with our health insurance
  
  
Make yourself a priority with flexible schedules and leave Policy
  
  
Drive forward your career through professional development opportunities Achieve your personal goals with our Employee Assistance Program.
  
  
Our commitment to you Our greatest assets are the expertise, creativity and passion of our employees. We strive to provide a great place to work that attracts, develops and retains the best talent, promotes employee engagement, fosters teamwork and ultimately drives innovation for the benefit of our customers. We strive to create an environment where you feel that you belong, with diversity and inclusion as the engine to growth and innovation. We develop and deploy best-in-class programs and practices, providing enriching career opportunities, listening to employee feedback and always challenging ourselves to do better. This is The Carrier Way.
