description: PRINTProject Officer Group I in the Delegation’s Cooperation Section16.06.2026 ExpiredTeaserWe areThe European Union (EU) is an economic and political partnership between 27 European countries. It plays an important role in international affairs through diplomacy, trade, development aid and working with global organizations. Abroad, the EU is represented through more than 140 diplomatic representations, known also as EU Delegations, which have a similar function to those of an embassy.The EU Delegation to India, New Delhi works in close coordination with the Embassies and Consulates of the 27 EU Member States. We are a fully-fledged diplomatic mission and represent the European Union in dealings with the Indian government in areas that are part of the EU’s remit.We offerThe post of Project Officer Group I in the Delegation’s Cooperation Section, under a fixed-term employment contract of 2 years, with a possibility of renewal under reserve of budgetary availabilities and operational considerations. For internal candidates holding an indefinite-term contract, alternative contractual arrangements may apply in accordance with institutional policies. The team consists of 12 people and there are occasional atypical working hours.Under this post, the recruited person will be attributed functions depending on the needs of the Delegation, and on the changes of these needs. The successful candidate will serve under the supervision and responsibility of the Head of Cooperation Section, providing support, expertise and assistance in coordinating, monitoring and reporting the implementation of projects funded under budget lines dedicated to Human Rights and Democracy (HR&D) as well Migration and Mobility and will provide support and back-up to the section as a whole on related matters. The jobholder will participate in ensuring coordination on cross cutting-matters concerning Human Rights -including Business and Human Rights-, Migration and the Sustainable Development Goals. The jobholder will also undertake similar responsibilities as above, for additional thematic areas, as assigned from time to time by Head of Cooperation. Currently these include: Disability, Youth, Employment, Labour & Decent work, Stability, Peace building & Conflict Prevention.Following Main Tasks And Duties Are Currently RequiredTask 1: Policy developmentTo participate in conceptual reflections and assist in elaborating work programmes, strategic documents and new approaches to cooperation activities.To provide economic, statistical and analytical inputs for European Commission drafts, directives or communications concerning cooperation activities within related fields of expertise.Task 2: Project/programme-managementTo assist in management of all phases of the project cycle, from preparation and launch of Call for Proposals Guidelines, to identification and selection of projects, to contracting, to monitoring and evaluation of project implementation.Under the authority of the HoC to represent the EU in meetings and events organised by projects and in other official meetings between the EU and programme partners, International Organisations etc.To undertake field visits and to monitor and report on progress, both operational and financial.To review and approve Annual Work Plans & Budgets, Progress reports, invoices, expenditure statements, requests for advance and reimbursement prior to submission to the Finance & Contracts Section. To maintain regular operational and financial-monitoring information on EU assisted projects and programmes through relevant contract management applications). To participate in tendering procedures and preparation of contracts, follow up of auditing requirements and other financial agreements with projects and programs.To initiate and ensure adherence to procedures of the European Commission in all matters of project implementation.To advise and assist the project implementing organisations, monitoring the performance of consultants, where relevant, and preparing terms of reference, contract addendas etc.To contribute to, develop and launch Terms of Reference as required, for the organisation of studies, policy briefs and events on thematic areas of competence.To follow up on Human Rights Defenders (HRDs) issues and provide support as HRD focal point.Task 3: Inter service Coordination and InformationTo coordinate with EU Headquarters and, where required, with Indian authorities, and other relevant Departments/Organisations on program and policy aspects of EU-India cooperation, in thematic areas of competence identified above. To provide briefings and information on projects, within and outside the Delegation as appropriate.To liaise with EU Delegations in the region, where relevant matters to do with development cooperation in the fields of Human Rights and Democracy, Migration and Mobility, and SDGs.To contribute to the work of other sections, on matters related to human rights, migration, youth, labour and SDGs, particularly in the preparation of briefs for the Political section for human rights dialogue, HR country strategy paper, HRD support, visits etc.To contribute to preparation of terms of reference for launching studies, policy briefs.Task 4: Other tasksTo contribute to strategic communication within the section and the EU Delegation as a wholeTo ensure EU Visibility is appropriately done by partnersTo support to HQ or Head of Delegation visits/missionsTo represent the EU at relevant workshops/conferences/meetingsThe starting salary step for this position is INR 231,790, however the final salary will be determined based on candidate's relevant and verifiable professional experience and is subject to approval by Headquarters. There is a competitive benefits package, subject to certain conditions, including personal leave days and public holidays, health insurances and a retirement savings plan.The expected start date will be 01/10/2026.Minimum requirements / eligibility criteria (necessary for the application to be considered)Minimum of Master’s level in International Law, Human Rights, Economic and Social Sciences, Political economy, Political science or equivalent;Minimum of 10 years of relevant experience. The professional experience must be acquired after the date on which the qualification allowing access to the post was obtained. Work experience in India or Asia is an asset;Excellent knowledge (C2) of English. Knowledge of Indian languages is considered an asset.Digital literacy, good knowledge of Microsoft Office;Right to residence and work in India;Judicial Extract for good conduct;Pre-recruitment medical fitness certificate to carry out the tasks assigned.Assets/selection criteria (basis for awarding points to select the best applicant)Asset relevant to Task 2 and 3: level of skills of time management, and interpersonal skills; capacity of organizing and coordinating meetings and agendas;Asset relevant to Tasks 2 and 3:, e.g] team work fluency, high flexibility, and capacity to work under pressure;Asset relevant to Task 2:, e.g] work history ) in the area of relations with external stakeholders, events and public relations;Asset relevant to Task 1: knowledge/experience of EU policies, of international relations and of India’s social policies, media environment and economy.How To ApplyThe applicant must apply by sendinga cover letter, signed a Curriculum Vitæ (to include, at the minimum, exact job titles, employers’ names and detailed tasks descriptions) using one of the Europass templates available at:https://europass.europa.eu/enAll Documents To The Following Email Addresseeasjobs-058@eeas.europa,euAnd Mention In The Email’ Subject“Ref: 144191 –: Project Officer: Cooperation Section ”no later than 17:00 hrs. (IST) on 03/07/2026. Caution: The applicant must verify that he/she fulfils all the conditions. **About Corporate Banking**
Corporate Banking provides integrated banking solutions, specialist advice, products and services to businesses of all sizes, multi-national companies, financial institutions and multinationals in non-UK markets.
  
  
**About Deal Support Team**
The Deal Support Team (DST) was setup in May 2008 with an objective to provide support to the Corporate and Business Banking origination teams through research and analysis. It provides end to end support in the deal value chain, right from prospect generation to pitchbook and engagement books to support initial client meeting or annual discussions with the existing customers.­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­ Also supporting with ancillary services through the Coverage Support Hub.

Working within a Coverage Support Hub to provide first class operational support to frontline Corporate Banking UK Coverage colleagues through the completion of defined tasks including but not limited to Annual Review Process and KYC review, Transaction Monitoring, Pricing Review etc. creating capacity for Associate Bankers and Relationship Directors to focus on the key business objectives.
  
  
  

* Working within Coverage Support Hub (Deal Support Team), to provide first class operational support to UK Corporate Banking frontline colleagues (RDs/ABs) through the completion of defined activities, thereby creating capacity for them to focus on the key business objectives
* Collaborating with frontline colleagues for successful execution of essential, business critical procedures and templates within dedicated area of work, which provide significant value to the whole of UK Corporate Coverage
* Key responsibilities: BAU deliveries (70%); Training & quality management (10%); Workflow management, Reporting, Creating dashboards and presentations (10%); Simplification & Automation (10%)

**Key Skills Required for this role (Basic/ Essential Qualifications):**

* Experience of working in a MNC Bank/Financial Services organisation in backend/operational processes such as Annual Review Process, KYC Refresh, Pricing & Billing, Transaction Monitoring, Payments etc.
* Precision in undertaking critical administrative activities and ensuring all information is accurate and aligned with standard operating procedures at all times
* Leading the training and learning agenda for colleagues - Ability to guide and mentor team members and embed a Consistently Excellent mindset across the team
* Conducting quality checks to ensure high standards of work for self and the team
* Preparing reports, presentations, and leadership dashboards to depict performance and improvement initiatives to management & stakeholders
* Experience in Workflow Management to ensure smooth and efficient allocation within the team
* Stay up-to date on industry best practices & trends in operations management
* Understand the importance of risk and control in line with the ambitions of the Bank- Identify and mitigate process risks to ensure business continuity
* Drive continuous improvement to review & streamline processes. Develop and implement improvement initiatives to enhance efficiency & productivity

description:

**Supply Chain AI Strategy & Use Case Development**

* Complete assigned AI literacy and continuous-learning modules, contributing to a culture of applied innovation within the team.

title: Field Application Scientist
description:
Overview
  

Medispec is seeking a 
**Field Application Scientist (FAS)**
 based in Delhi NCR to provide scientific training, technical support, and application optimization across our portfolio of advanced life science instrumentation and consumables.

Our portfolio includes 
**Flow Cytometry, Seahorse XF Analyzers, Imaging and Multimode Microplate Readers, and Mabtech multiplexing solutions and consumables**
.

This role is ideal for professionals passionate about scientific instrumentation, cell-based assay development, immunology, and multiplex immunoassays. The candidate will work closely with researchers, scientists, and internal sales teams to support customers, develop applications, and drive adoption of our solutions across India.

Role and Responsibilities

* Conduct on-site and remote customer training, instrument demonstrations, and application optimization.
* Provide scientific and technical support to customers, sales teams, and product management.
* Develop strong proficiency in instrument software, assay protocols, and emerging scientific applications.
* Lead customer demonstrations, optimize experimental workflows, and troubleshoot instrument and assay-related issues.
* Support customers in cell-based assay design and optimization, including cellular, metabolic, and immunological applications.
* Provide application support for 
  **Mabtech multiplexing solutions, including the EYRA platform, multiplex immunoassays, and associated consumables**
  .
* Assist customers with immunoassay workflows, including assay setup, protocol optimization, data acquisition, and interpretation of results.
* Support the adoption of consumables by helping customers select appropriate products, optimize assay performance, and establish reproducible workflows.
* Generate application data and contribute to the development of application notes, technical documents, and scientific presentations.
* Collaborate with sales and product management teams to identify new application opportunities, support key accounts, and drive product adoption.
* Participate in customer workshops, scientific seminars, conferences, and industry events.
* Maintain accurate CRM records of customer interactions, training sessions, demonstrations, and field activities.
* Travel across India to support customer requirements, demonstrations, and application development initiatives.

Qualifications and ExperienceEducation

* M.Sc. or Ph.D. in Molecular Biology, Biochemistry, Cell Biology, Immunology, Biotechnology, or a related life science discipline.

Experience

* Minimum 
  **2 years of hands-on laboratory experience**
   in one or more of the following areas: flow cytometry, immunoassays, cell culture, microscopy and imaging, multiplexing, or high-content screening.
* Experience with cell culture techniques, including adherent and suspension cells, and cell-based assay development is desirable.
* Exposure to immunology-based assays such as ELISA, ELISpot, flow-based immunophenotyping, cytokine analysis, or other antibody-based assays is a strong advantage.
* Experience with multiplex immunoassay platforms, bead-based assays, or immunoassay consumables will be an added advantage.
* Experience in a core facility, research laboratory, biotechnology company, CRO, or life sciences instrumentation environment is desirable.

Technical Skills

* Knowledge of flow cytometry, microscopy, imaging, and high-content screening instrumentation.
* Experience with fluorescence- and luminescence-based assays, including TRF, FRET, AlphaScreen, and fluorescence polarization.
* Understanding of immunoassay principles, antibody-based detection, cytokine analysis, and multiplex assay workflows.
* Experience with multiplexing platforms, instrument operation, assay optimization, and data analysis is desirable.
* Proficiency in image analysis software such as ImageJ, CellProfiler, or similar tools, where applicable.
* Strong troubleshooting, scientific communication, and data interpretation skills.
* Good presentation skills and the ability to communicate complex scientific concepts clearly to researchers and customers.
* Proficiency in MS Office; experience with LIMS or CRM systems is preferred.

Key Competencies

* Strong scientific aptitude and a practical, hands-on approach to problem-solving.
* Customer-oriented mindset with a willingness to learn new technologies and applications.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with sales and product management teams.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple customer engagements.
* Willingness to travel extensively across India.

NITS Engineering is a biomedical technology company building the next generation of biomedical devices, in vitro disease models, and engineering systems for drug discovery, regenerative medicine, and diagnostics. We combine precision hardware engineering with biomedical research to build the tools that take science from the lab bench to real world application.

**About the Role**

We are looking for an Embedded and Electronics Intern to contribute to the development of electronics, firmware, and software for our 3D bioprinters. The role involves hands-on work across motion control, dispensing systems, sensors, embedded systems, and machine-control software.

title: Application Engineering, Principal Engineer
description:
We Are
  
  
At Synopsys, we drive the innovations that shape the way we live and connect. Our technology is central to the Era of Pervasive Intelligence, from self-driving cars to learning machines. We lead in chip design, verification, and IP integration, empowering the creation of high-performance silicon chips and software content. Join us to transform the future through continuous technological innovation.
  
  
You Are
  
  
You are a DDR/LPDDR Controller System Architecture Specialist who can work directly with customer architects to close real system-level memory subsystem design decisions.
  
  
You are comfortable discussing SoC integration, memory subsystem architecture, controller configuration, performance optimization, power management, validation, and interoperability topics. You can help customers evaluate technical trade-offs and guide them toward practical architecture decisions.
  
  
This is a customer-facing technical role. You will help customers integrate DDR/LPDDR controller IP into complex SoCs, identify key requirements or gaps, and translate customer feedback into actionable input for Synopsys Product Management, R&D, and roadmap planning.
  
  
What You’ll Be Doing
  
  

* Own the technical architecture engagement for DDR/LPDDR controller IP with strategic customers, from early platform requirements through architecture closure and initial deployment readiness.
* Work with customer architects and engineering teams to define suitable DDR/LPDDR memory subsystem configurations for advanced SoC platforms.
* Analyze system-level trade-offs related to memory bandwidth, latency, power efficiency, quality of service, reliability, validation, and scalability.
* Translate customer platform requirements and integration constraints into clear feedback for Synopsys Product Management, R&D, and roadmap planning.
* Support technical closure of design wins by providing architecture guidance, configuration recommendations and competitive positioning.
* Develop reusable technical material, application notes, and customer-facing guidance based on real engagement experience.
* Train FAEs and customer teams on DDR/LPDDR architecture, memory subsystem integration, performance tuning, validation expectations, and deployment best practices.

The Impact You Will Have
  
  

* Improve the quality of DDR/LPDDR design wins by ensuring customer memory architectures are technically sound before commitment.
* Strengthen Synopsys DDR/LPDDR roadmap by feeding real customer memory subsystem requirements into product planning and R&D execution.
* Reduce customer integration risk by identifying architecture, performance, power, validation, and bring-up issues early.
* Help establish Synopsys as a trusted technical partner for next-generation AI, HPC, mobile, automotive, networking, and edge computing platforms.

What You’ll Need
  
  

* Bachelors and/or Masters Degree in Electrical and/or Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering or Computer Science
* 5+ years of experience in DDR/LPDDR architecture, memory subsystem design, SoC integration, silicon validation, systems engineering, applications engineering, or customer-facing technical leadership.
* Solid understanding of DDR and/or LPDDR controller IP, including memory architecture concepts, controller configuration, scheduling, quality of service, power management, training, validation, or system integration.
* Good system-level understanding of SoC integration and ability to reason through memory bandwidth, latency, power efficiency, quality of service, reliability, validation, and software/firmware trade-offs.
* Experience engaging directly with customer architects, design teams, validation teams, and technical decision-makers.
* Ability to translate ambiguous customer requirements into clear technical recommendations, product feedback, and closure plans.
* Strong technical communication skills, including clear written analysis, structured trade-off explanation, and ability to align customer, sales, product, and engineering teams.

Nice to Have
  
  

* Experience with Linux, firmware bring-up, or software-driven debug of DDR/LPDDR subsystems.
* Familiarity with advanced SoC architectures used in AI, HPC, automotive, mobile, networking, or compute platforms.
* Experience with memory performance analysis, traffic modeling, quality-of-service management, memory hierarchy optimization, or system-level benchmarking.
* Knowledge of advanced topics such as DDR5, LPDDR5X, LPDDR6, memory training algorithms, RAS features, chiplet-based memory architectures, or AI memory bandwidth optimization.

The Team You’ll be a Part Of
  
  
You will be part of our IP high-performance computing applications engineering team, a group of dedicated professionals who are passionate about technology and innovation. The team focuses on helping customers integrate more capabilities into SoCs faster, working collaboratively across geographic and organizational boundaries to drive revenue growth and accelerate business closure.
  
  
Rewards and Benefits
  
  
We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.
  
  
Inclusion and Diversity
  
  
Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, military veteran status, or disability.

description:

**IMPORTANT NOTICE:**

**Area of expertise**
Roster of International consultant – Strategic planning, costing, monitoring, and evaluation for antimicrobial resistance (AMR).
  
  
**Purpose of consultancy**
The WHO South-East Asia Regional Office (SEARO) seeks to establish a roster of qualified consultants to provide technical support to Member States in the development, implementation, costing, monitoring, evaluation, review, and strengthening of National Action Plans (NAPs) on Antimicrobial Resistance (AMR).
  
  
Selected consultants may be engaged to support regional and country-level activities aligned with the Global Action Plan on Antimicrobial Resistance, the WHO SEARO Regional Roadmap on AMR 2025-2030, and the One Health approach.
  
  
**Background**
Antimicrobial resistance (AMR) remains a major threat to public health, food security, economic development, and health system resilience. Countries in the WHO South-East Asia Region have developed and are implementing National Action Plans on AMR; however, varying levels of capacity, financing, governance, monitoring systems, and multisectoral coordination continue to challenge effective implementation.
  
  
To support Member States in strengthening AMR national programmes and advancing implementation of the WHO SEARO Regional Roadmap on AMR 2025-2030, WHO requires a roster of technical experts capable of providing specialized support across strategic planning, costing, resource mobilization, monitoring and evaluation, programme review, governance strengthening, and One Health coordination.
  
  
The roster will enable WHO to rapidly mobilize qualified experts to support national and regional priorities as needs arise.
  
  
**Deliverables**
Under The Overall Guidance Of WHO Technical Unit, Consultants May Be Requested To Perform One Or More Of The Following Assignments (a More Specific Terms Of Reference (TORs), Including The Exact Deliverables, Duration Of Assignment And Place Of Assignment Will Be Shared With The Selected Candidate At The Time Of Hiring For a Specific Assignment)
  
  
**Deliverable 1: National Action Plan Development and Revision**

* Conduct situational and strategic analyses.
* Facilitate stakeholder consultations and multisectoral engagement.
* Develop or update AMR National Action Plans.
* Prepare implementation frameworks and operational plans.
* Support national validation and endorsement processes.

**Deliverable 2: Costing, Budgeting and Financing**

* Develop costed implementation plans.
* Conduct budget and financing analyses.
* Estimate resource requirements and investment needs.
* Develop financing scenarios and sustainability plans.
* Prepare resource mobilization strategies and investment cases.
* Assess cost-saving potential, cost-effectiveness and return on investment for AMR interventions and implementation options.

**Deliverable 3: Monitoring, Evaluation and Accountability Frameworks**

* Develop theories of change and results frameworks.
* Design logical frameworks and performance indicators.
* Establish monitoring and reporting mechanisms.
* Develop accountability and learning frameworks.
* Design data collection and review tools

**Deliverable 4: Mid-Term and End-Term Reviews**

* Develop review methodologies and assessment tools.
* Conduct programme performance reviews.
* Facilitate stakeholder consultations and review workshops.
* Analyse implementation progress and bottlenecks.
* Produce review reports and recommendations.

**Deliverable 5: Capacity Development**

* Develop training materials and guidance documents.
* Deliver workshops and technical training sessions.
* Provide mentoring and coaching to national teams.
* Strengthen national capacity in planning, costing, monitoring and evaluation.

**Deliverable 6: Reporting and Policy Products**

* Prepare technical reports and progress reports.
* Develop policy briefs and evidence summaries.
* Produce national and regional assessment reports.
* Develop strategic planning and investment documents.

**Educational Qualifications**
**Qualifications, experience, skills and languages**
**Essential**

: A first university degree or medical degree in one or more of the following fields: Public Health, Health Policy and Management, Health Economics, Epidemiology, Monitoring and Evaluation, International Development, Health Systems Strengthening, One Health, Veterinary Public Health, Environmental Health, Public Administration, and/or Business Administration.

: An advanced university degree or medical degree with postgraduate specialization in one of the fields listed above or another field relevant to the assignment.

* Demonstrated experience supporting programme planning, monitoring, evaluation, policy development, or health systems strengthening

**Purpose of consultancy**
The WHO Regional Office for South-East Asia is establishing a roster of qualified consultants who may be engaged for specific assignments to strengthen national and regional AMR surveillance, clinical microbiology services and laboratory systems. Assignments may cover surveillance design and assessment; implementation and reporting through the Global Antimicrobial Resistance and Use Surveillance System (GLASS); bacteriology and mycology capacity; diagnostic stewardship; laboratory networks and quality systems; data quality, analysis, interpretation and visualization; One Health and genomic surveillance; capacity development; operational research; and translation of surveillance evidence into policy and programme action.
  
  
Depending on the individual Terms of Reference, consultants will provide technical assistance for planning, implementation, analysis and reporting using WHO tools, standards and recommendations. They may also contribute to evidence-based technical guidance, protocols, standard operating procedures, training packages and implementation tools.
  
  
**Background**
Antimicrobial resistance is a major public health and development challenge in the WHO South-East Asia Region. Member States need timely, representative and quality-assured data on resistance patterns and antimicrobial use to guide national action plans, clinical and public health interventions, laboratory strategies, stewardship, infection prevention and control, and resource allocation.
  
  
Reliable laboratory systems are essential for effective AMR surveillance, including accurate bacterial and fungal identification, antimicrobial susceptibility testing, diagnostic stewardship, specimen referral, quality management and standardized data flows. WHO supports Member States, country offices and partners to strengthen sustainable surveillance and laboratory systems aligned with WHO standards and GLASS. This roster will help WHO SEARO identify specialists for time-bound regional or country assignments based on emerging needs.

Conduct desk or country assessment of AMR surveillance systems, data flows, governance arrangements, indicators, data quality, bacteriology and mycology capacity, laboratory networks, diagnostic stewardship and reporting processes, with prioritized and feasible recommendations
  
  
****Deliverable 2: Technical products and implementation tools.****
Design assignment-specific protocols, standard operating procedures, data dictionaries, validation checklists, surveillance tools, indicator frameworks, laboratory-strengthening plans, survey materials, diagnostic-stewardship tools, guidance documents or One Health implementation products
  
  
****Deliverable 3: Data and analytical outputs.****
Develop cleaned or validated datasets; statistical, microbiological or genomic analyses; reproducible code or pipelines; tables, figures, maps, dashboards or visualization specifications; interpretation notes; and quality documentation, as applicable
  
  
****Deliverable 4: Laboratory and diagnostic products.****
Adapt guidance documents, training packages and tools for clinical bacteriology and mycology; laboratory quality management; antimicrobial susceptibility testing; external quality assurance; specimen referral; laboratory networks; and diagnostic stewardship.
  
  
****Deliverable 5: Capacity-development package.****
Develop training needs findings, curricula, presentations, exercises, job aids, workshop or webinar facilitation, mentoring records and a brief evaluation of learning and follow-up needs.
  
  
****Deliverable 6: Reporting and knowledge products.****
Prepare GLASS submission-related outputs, national or regional surveillance reports, laboratory-capacity reports, policy briefs, technical reports, manuscripts, systematic reviews, presentations or other communication products.

title: Senior Analyst, PPK Operations
description:
**Company Overview**
Bain & Company is the management consulting firm that the world's business leaders come to when they want results. Bain advises clients on strategy, operations, information technology, organization, private equity, digital transformation and strategy, and mergers and acquisitions, developing practical insights that clients act on and transferring skills that make change stick. The firm aligns its incentives with clients by linking its fees to their results. Bain clients have outperformed the stock market 4 to 1. Founded in 1973, Bain has 58 offices in 37 countries, and its deep expertise and client roster cross every industry and economic sector.
  
  
**Department Overview**
Bain's Product, Practice & Knowledge (PPK) department has played a vital role in harnessing the best of our consulting staffs' individual and collective expertise for over 20 years. Within PPK, each practice supports teams across the globe with deep expertise and knowledge. Our practices play a critical role in Bain's commercial success and are a key strategic priority.
  
  
PPK is continually focused on creating a stronger, more scalable, efficient and effective PPK organization. The PPK Operations team will help achieve this by developing and improving processes, tools, and communications to better support our PPK teams.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
The Senior Analyst is a technical builder on the PPK Operations team. Where the Analyst supports defined analytical workstreams and the Operations Manager owns the simplification agenda end to end, this role sits between the two: it takes ownership of complete solutions from problem definition through build and adoption, working with limited supervision, and is expected to bring the technical depth that makes automation and AI-enabled delivery real.
  
  
The distinguishing expectation of this role is speed of build. We are looking for someone who uses AI tools and low-code platforms to deliver dashboards, automations and analyses in a fraction of the time traditional approaches require, and who can explain and defend the logic behind what they build.
  
  
**Automation and AI-enabled solution build (~40%)**

* Designs and builds automated solutions that remove manual effort from recurring PPK processes, using Power Automate, SharePoint, Excel and scripting as appropriate
* Uses AI tools such as Claude and ChatGPT as a core part of the build workflow to accelerate development, generate and debug code and formulas, structure unfamiliar data, and prototype solutions quickly
* Prototypes and deploys AI agents and assistants for defined PPK use cases; identifies where an agentic approach outperforms a conventional one
* Translates business requirements into working logic: data flows, conditional rules, error handling and validation, so solutions hold up in production and not only in demo
* Documents what is built so solutions can be maintained, handed over and reused across practices
* Maintains a healthy skepticism about AI output, validating results before they inform decisions or reach stakeholders

**Operations project delivery (~30%)**

* Owns discrete PPK Operations workstreams from scoping through delivery, with the Operations Manager as thought partner rather than reviewer of every step
* Contributes to the PPK Operations project backlog by identifying candidates, sizing effort and impact, and recommending sequencing
* Engages internal stakeholders directly to gather requirements, clarify scope, secure inputs and drive adoption of what is delivered
* Runs test and learn pilots, captures what worked and what did not, and folds those lessons into the next build
* Proactively flags gaps, dependencies and tradeoffs rather than waiting to be asked

**Analytics and reporting (~20%)**

* Builds and owns Power BI dashboards end to end, covering data modelling, DAX, Power Query and visual design, applying Bain visual standards
* Rebuilds and streamlines existing reporting so recurring outputs run with minimal manual intervention
* Performs quantitative analysis on PPK operational data and derives insights that stand on their own rather than only presenting the numbers
* Triangulates data across multiple systems and stakeholders, resolving inconsistencies and flagging data quality issues at source
* Produces insight-driven output in the right format for the audience, whether a dashboard, a deck, a model or a written recommendation

**Teaming and apprenticeship (10%)**

* Coaches junior analysts on technical craft, including tool selection, prompt design, dashboard structure and automation hygiene
* Reviews the technical quality of work produced by others on the team and raises the standard through direct, constructive feedback
* Shares reusable assets, templates and best practices across PPK so solutions built once are used many times
* Evangelizes the art of the possible to other teams and builds credibility for new ways of working through demonstrated results
* Contributes as a member of the broader PPK community through projects, training and experience sharing

**About You**
**Technical skills: required**

* Practical, daily working fluency with AI tools such as Claude and ChatGPT, used to build and ship real deliverables rather than to draft text; you can point to work that was materially faster or better because of how you used them
* Strong Power BI capability including data modelling, DAX and Power Query, with the ability to take a dashboard from raw data to a stakeholder-ready product without handoffs
* Working knowledge of programming, in any language, sufficient that logic building is second nature: you understand data structures, control flow, functions and debugging, and can read, adapt and reason about code even where you do not write production software
* Advanced Excel, including complex formulas, structured data handling and comfort with large or messy datasets
* Strong PowerPoint skills with the ability to structure a clear argument, not only format slides

**Technical skills: preferred**

* Experience across the Microsoft ecosystem, particularly Power Automate, SharePoint lists and libraries, and Power Apps
* Experience building AI agents or assistants, including prompt engineering, tool and API integration, and evaluating agent output
* Process automation experience of any kind, whether scripted, low-code or RPA based, with a track record of removing recurring manual work
* Python or a comparable scripting language for data manipulation, API work and automation
* Familiarity with APIs and how systems exchange data; comfort reading documentation and working out an integration independently
* Exposure to Alteryx, Tableau or comparable analytics and data preparation tools

**Experience And Mindset**

* 4 to 6 years of experience in a professional services, consulting, analytics, knowledge management or operations environment
* Demonstrated ownership of solutions end to end, from ambiguous problem statement through to a working, adopted product
* A self-learner with a genuine desire to figure it out; you pick up new tools quickly and without being taught
* A passion for changing how work gets done by adopting new approaches and new technology, paired with the judgement to know when the traditional approach is still the right one
* Structured problem-solving: you break ambiguous questions into clear hypotheses, analyses and implications
* Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain technical choices to a non-technical audience and establish credibility with senior stakeholders
* The maturity and integrity to handle confidential information and to use technology, including AI, responsibly
* Ability to operate independently, comfortable with a remote supervisor and wider team, managing competing priorities with minimal supervision
* Known for high-quality work, attentive to detail and well-organized
* Bachelor of Arts, Engineering, Science or equivalent undergraduate degree with strong academic credentials; Statistics, Business, Economics, Computer Science or Analytics concentrations also applicable

title: Head - Policy, Systems & Program Architecture
description:
**Competency**
: Policy analysis, systems thinking, program architecture, government process literacy, documentation.

**Job Mode:**
Onsite

**Reports To:**
Founder & CEO / Board of Directors

**Location:**
New Delhi (HQ) · Multi-state travel

**ROLE PURPOSE**

RightWalk's core identity is as a policy-to-outcomes institution builder. This role is the intellectual and architectural engine of that identity. The Head – Policy, Systems & Program Architecture owns the 'R' and 'I' of the RIGHT model: Redesign (policy co-shaping) and Institutionalize (systems design). Everything that becomes RightWalk standard must pass through this function. This role ensures that what works in one state becomes codified, transferable, and replicable — not tribal knowledge locked in people's heads.

This role owns the institutional architecture of RightWalk’s work: policy reform logic, system design, program models, SOPs, quality thresholds, PMU blueprints, exit criteria and codification of what works across states. It protects the organisation’s identity as a systems-change institution.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1. Policy reform logic and standards**

* Own the policy reform logic across RightWalk's domains — Education (RTE), Livelihood (Apprenticeship), and Health — including policy interpretation, rights-based reasoning, and advocacy positioning.
* Define non-negotiable standards for program design and implementation fidelity.
* Support government-facing policy/process improvements through evidence and design.
* Set non-negotiable program standards: define quality thresholds, entry/exit criteria, and program fidelity benchmarks across all states.
* Lead policy domain heads (Education, Livelihood, Health) and guide specialist analysts.
* Engage with government counterparts, NITI Aayog, and central ministries on policy refinement.

**2. Systems and process architecture**

* Design institutional systems: SOPs, process flows, governance structures, government-technology interface specifications, and central-state system alignment.
* Translate policy intent into implementable system designs.
* Develop templates for process mapping, bottleneck analysis and system redesign.
* Work with technology and data teams to ensure digital tools reflect real administrative workflows.

**3. Program architecture and playbooks**

* Own the codification of 'what works' — convert state-level learning into replicable playbooks, training curricula, and toolkits.
* Translate policy intent into executable program architecture — the bridge between reform logic and PMU operations.
* Define what must be standardised centrally and what can be adapted by states.
* Develop exit and transition criteria for government ownership.
* Ensure each program has clear logic from policy intent to beneficiary outcome.

**4. Codification and replication**

* Capture state innovations and convert them into RightWalk standards.
* Sign off on any new program design or modification before state rollout — the 'fidelity gate' for all RightWalk programs.
* Build knowledge products that support scale, training, donor communication and government adoption.

**5. Cross-functional alignment**

* Partner with the Data/M&E function on KPI definitions, indicator frameworks, and learning loops.
* Work with Programs to test architecture in real state contexts.
* Work with Tech/Product to translate workflows into digital requirements.
* Work with Communications to ensure public narrative reflects real systems work.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE — SIX MONTHS**

* RightWalk has a clear, documented policy and program architecture for each of its three domains — living documents that are used, not just filed.
* Every PMU in every state is working from a consistent playbook — not inventing their own approach.
* SOP and playbook structure created for major programs.
* The 'RightWalk Standard' exists — a codified set of quality thresholds and fidelity benchmarks that any state PMU can be assessed against.

**WHAT THIS ROLE DOES NOT DO**

* Running state execution or managing PMU field teams.
* Owning donor relationships or fundraising proposals.
* Communications and media strategy.
* Data collection or field M&E.

**CANDIDATE PROFILE**

* **Experience:**
  12–18 years. Prior experience at the intersection of policy and systems — could be government, a policy think-tank, a development consulting firm, or a senior implementation NGO role.
* **Domain:**
  Deep familiarity with at least one of RightWalk's domains: education (RTE), labour/apprenticeship, or public health systems.
* **Government literacy:**
  Ability to work with government drafting — GOs, policy circulars, SOP design — not just analysis.
* **Writing:**
  Exceptional writing and documentation discipline — can produce policy briefs, system blueprints, and playbooks independently.
* **Mindset:**
  Architecture mindset: thinks in systems, process flows, and standards — not just programmes.
* **Backbone:**
  Comfortable holding the line on quality and fidelity even under pressure from execution teams.



**Success traits**
: Architecture mindset, clarity, strong writing, humility to learn from the field, courage to define standards, ability to hold complexity without drowning everyone in it.

**Area of expertise**
Roster of International consultant – Antimicrobial Use (AMU), Access and/or Stewardship
  
  
**Purpose of consultancy**
The WHO South-East Asia Regional Office (SEARO) seeks to establish a roster of qualified consultants to provide technical support to Member States in strengthening antimicrobial stewardship, improving access to quality-assured antimicrobials, optimizing antimicrobial use, strengthening pharmaceutical governance and regulatory systems, monitoring antimicrobial consumption, and implementing One Health approaches to address antimicrobial resistance.
  
  
Selected consultants may be engaged to support regional and country-level activities aligned with the Global Action Plan on Antimicrobial Resistance, the 2024 United Nations General Assembly Political Declaration on AMR, the WHO SEARO Regional Roadmap on AMR 2025-2030, WHO AWaRe guidance, Universal Health Coverage goals, national AMR action plans, and relevant WHO guidance, standards and toolkits on antimicrobial use surveillance, antimicrobial stewardship, equitable access to quality-assured antimicrobials, and responsible antimicrobial use across human health and One Health contexts.
  
  
**Background**
AMR continues to threaten public health and health system resilience across the WHO South-East Asia Region. Despite progress in implementing national action plans, countries continue to face challenges in responsible antimicrobial use, equitable access to quality-assured antimicrobials, stewardship capacity, AMU surveillance, regulatory oversight and pharmaceutical governance. Strengthening AWaRe implementation, stewardship programmes, surveillance systems and One Health collaboration remains a regional priority under the WHO SEARO Regional Roadmap on AMR 2025–2030. A roster of technical experts will help WHO rapidly support Member States with specialized expertise as needs arise.
  
  
**Deliverables**
Under the overall guidance of the WHO technical unit, consultants may be requested to perform one or more of the following assignments. A more specific Terms of Reference, including exact deliverables, duration, and place of assignment, will be issued at the time of contracting.
  
  
**Deliverable 1: Antimicrobial Use (AMU) Surveillance and Analytics**
Establish or strengthen AMU surveillance systems, including methods, protocols, data collection, analysis, reporting, dashboards, multisectoral integration, and technical recommendations.
  
  
**Deliverable 2: Antimicrobial Stewardship Programme Development and Implementation**
Develop and implement AMS strategies, programmes, tools and quality-improvement measures, including AWaRe implementation and interventions to improve prescribing practices.
  
  
**Deliverable 3: Access to Antimicrobials and Shortage Management**
Assess antimicrobial availability, affordability, accessibility, quality, shortages, procurement and supply-chain systems, and develop strategies to improve access, prevent stockouts, strengthen supply security, and ensure equitable access to essential antibiotics.
  
  
**Deliverable 4: Regulatory Systems and Pharmaceutical Governance**
Review antimicrobial regulatory and policy frameworks, assess prescribing, dispensing, sales and marketing practices, and support stronger regulations, quality assurance, licensing, prescription-only policies and implementation recommendations.
  
  
**Deliverable 5: One Health Antimicrobial Use Optimization**
Support One Health approaches to optimize antimicrobial use across human, animal, food production and environmental sectors, including multisectoral coordination, integrated monitoring, consultations, and implementation of responsible-use strategies and action plans.
  
  
**Deliverable 6: Capacity Development**
Develop and deliver AMS/AMU training, mentoring, awareness and behaviour-change activities, and strengthen institutional capacity for stewardship, surveillance, regulation and access programmes.
  
  
**Deliverable 7: Monitoring, Evaluation and Programme Performance Assessment**
Monitor and evaluate AMS, AMU, access and governance programmes, including indicators, reporting systems, performance reviews, lessons learned and recommendations for strengthening and sustainability.
  
  
**Deliverable 8: Technical Guidance, Research and Knowledge Products**
Develop technical guidance, reports, evidence summaries, research and knowledge products to support policy, investment, implementation and dissemination.
  
  
**Educational Qualifications**
**Qualifications, experience, skills and languages**
**Essential**
**For Band level B**
**:**
A first university degree or medical degree in one or more of the following fields: Medicine, Pharmacy, Public Health, Infectious Diseases, Clinical and/or Infectious Disease Pharmacology, Epidemiology, Veterinary Medicine, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Health Policy and Management, Health Systems Strengthening, One Health, and Related disciplines.
  
  
**For Band level C:**
An advanced university degree or medical degree with postgraduate specialization in one of the fields listed above or another field relevant to the assignment.
  
  
Desirable
  
  

* Doctoral degree
* Board certification or postgraduate specialization relevant to the technical profile
* Professional certification related to AMS, public health, epidemiology, health systems, medicines regulation, pharmaceutical policy, or monitoring and evaluation.

**Experience**
Essential
  
  
**For Band Level B**

* At least five years of of progressively responsible experience in one or more of the advertised technical profiles.
* Experience supporting AMS programmes, antimicrobial use monitoring, pharmaceutical systems, policy development, surveillance, or public health programmes.

**For Band Level C**

* At least ten years of progressively responsible experience in one or more of the advertised technical profiles.
* Demonstrated expertise in antimicrobial stewardship, antimicrobial use surveillance, pharmaceutical governance, access to medicines, regulatory strengthening, policy development, or One Health implementation.

Desirable
  
  

* Experience supporting programmes in low- and middle-income countries.
* Experience in WHO South-East Asia Region Member States.
* Experience working with WHO, UN agencies, governments, development partners, professional societies, academic institutions, or medicines regulatory authorities.
* Experience facilitating multidisciplinary and multisectoral initiatives.
* Publication record in peer-reviewed journals or technical guidance documents.

**Skills/Knowledge**
Essential
  
  

* Expertise in one or more of the advertised technical profiles.
* Knowledge of WHO AWaRe classification and implementation approaches.
* Knowledge of antimicrobial stewardship and rational use of medicines.
* Knowledge of pharmaceutical systems and medicines regulation.
* Experience with antimicrobial use and consumption monitoring.
* Ability to apply WHO standards, methods, and tools.
* Strong analytical, technical writing, and communication skills.
* Ability to analyse complex information and develop practical recommendations.
* Experience facilitating stakeholder consultations and technical discussions.

Desirable
  
  

* Experience in behavioural science and behaviour change interventions.
* Knowledge of digital health solutions and data analytics.
* Knowledge of forecasting, quantification, and supply chain management.
* Experience in training, facilitation, mentoring, and adult learning approaches.

**Languages And Level Required**
Essential: Expert knowledge of English.
  
  
Desirable: Intermediate or expert knowledge of another official United Nations language or a language used in a WHO South-East Asia Region Member State, where relevant to the assignment.
  
  
**Location**

* Consultancies may be: Home-based, Country-based, Regional Office-based,, or a combination of remote and in-country support.
* The duty arrangement for each consultancy will be specified in the individual Terms of Reference.

**Travel**
The consultant may be expected to travel to one or more WHO South-East Asia Region Member States for country assessments, technical consultations, training or other assignment-related activities. Travel dates, locations and purpose will be specified in the individual Terms of Reference and arranged in accordance with applicable WHO policies.

Band level B and/or Band level C, as applicable to the assignment. The daily or monthly rate will be established in accordance with the applicable WHO consultant remuneration guidance and stated in the individual Terms of Reference.

**Expected duration of contract:**
Roster assignments may range from short inputs to several months, up to a maximum of 11 months per calendar year. Each individual Terms of Reference will specify the contract duration, number of working days and, for part-time assignments, the expected percentage or level of effort.

title: Product Associate - Apprentice
description:

**Description**
**About the Program**
The Eptura Apprenticeship Program is designed to provide recent graduates and early-career professionals with meaningful, hands-on experience within a global SaaS organization. Throughout this 12-month program, apprentices will receive mentoring, structured learning opportunities, and exposure to commercial operations and sales processes.
  
  
**Eligibility**
**To Be Considered For This Apprenticeship, Candidates Must**

* Have completed a Bachelor's degree within the past two years, OR
* Be in the final year of their degree program and eligible for apprenticeship participation
* Have no more than two years of professional work experience
* Be legally eligible to participate in an apprenticeship program in India

**Shape the Future of Work with Eptura**
At Eptura, we're not just another tech company—we're a global leader transforming the way people, workplaces, and assets connect. Our innovative worktech solutions empower 25 million users across 115 countries to thrive in a digitally connected world. Trusted by 45% of Fortune 500 companies, we're redefining workplace innovation and driving success for organizations around the globe.
  
  
**Role Overview**
As a Product Associate, you will work directly within our Gurugram engineering team, helping to shepherd product enhancements and customer-reported issues through Eptura's AI Development Lifecycle (AIDLC). You'll connect product priorities and engineering execution, keeping work organized, clearly specified, and moving forward on our Jira kanban boards.
  
  
This is a role for someone who is curious, organized, and eager to learn how great software products are built. You don't need prior experience in product management. You do need strong attention to detail, clear communication, demonstrated capabilities in using AI, and a genuine interest in how technology solves real-world problems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Manage and maintain the Jira kanban board: keeping tickets well-organized, clearly described, and appropriately prioritized in collaboration with engineering leads.
* Help triage incoming product enhancement requests and customer-reported defects, gathering the context engineers need to act on them.
* Work with AI to write clear, structured user stories and acceptance criteria that translate business needs into actionable engineering tasks.
* Coordinate with engineers to track progress, surface blockers, and ensure items move efficiently through the AIDLC stages.
* Participate in requirement-gathering conversations with product managers and stakeholders, capturing key decisions and open questions.
* Assist in drafting functional specifications and supporting documentation for new or enhanced product features, also working with AI.
* Support basic testing activities: reviewing completed work against acceptance criteria and flagging discrepancies.
* Contribute to ongoing improvement of our AIDLC processes and team ways of working.

**About You**
We're looking for a motivated self-starter who is keen to build a career in product or technology. The following will set you up for success in this role:
  
  

* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English: you'll be writing tickets, specs, and summaries that engineers and stakeholders rely on.
* High attention to detail and a methodical approach to organizing information.
* Comfort working in a structured, process-driven environment: you like things to be clear, tracked, and accounted for.
* Curiosity about how software products are built and a willingness to ask questions.
* Familiarity with project or task management tools (Jira experience is a plus).
* A proactive mindset: you spot gaps, follow up, and take ownership of your work.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to assess AI outputs, identify limitations or risks, and recommend improvements to enhance product value.
* AI-related experience:
* Understanding of AI fundamentals, including large language models (LLMs), prompt engineering, automation workflows, and responsible AI principles.
* Experience using AI tools to improve productivity: research, data analysis, content creation, or workflow automation, either through academic, personal, or professional projects. Ability to build and demonstrate an AI agent.
* Ability to evaluate Ai-driven product opportunities, gathering feedback and translating it into feature recommendations.

**Nice to Have**

* Exposure to agile or kanban workflows (even in an academic or personal project context).
* Basic understanding of software development concepts: you don't need to code, but knowing what engineers do helps.
* Prior internship, project, or coursework related to business analysis, product management, or software delivery.

**Benefits**

* Monthly stipend
* Health Insurance fully paid – Self
* 13 Public Holidays
* Hyrid working policy
* Exposure to the latest trends and technologies in the SaaS industry.
* Mentorship from global experienced professionals in the sales, renewals and customer success fields.
* Potential for career advancement based on performance and dedication.

**Eptura Information**

* At Eptura, we believe strong teams are built through collaboration, flexibility, and a range of perspectives grounded in skill and experience. We strive to create an environment where people can do their best work, contribute meaningfully, and grow alongside our business.

title: Associate, AI Model Validation, RQA
description:
**About This Role**
**Business Overview**
The Risk & Quantitative Analysis (RQA) group provides independent oversight of BlackRock’s fiduciary and enterprise risks.  RQA’s principal objectives are to advance the firm’s risk management practices and to deliver independent risk expertise and constructive challenge to drive better business and investment outcomes.
  
  
RQA is committed to investing in our people to increase individual enablement and ultimately build a stronger team. Our goal is to create a culture of inclusion which encourages collaboration, innovation, diversity and the development our future leaders.  We actively engage in discussions on career growth and work with team members to understand how personal passions and strength connect with our purpose.
  
  
**Role Description**
The Enterprise Risk team within RQA oversees those risks which directly impact the corporate entity (i.e. BlackRock, Inc., or one of its subsidiaries), rather than the fiduciary risks assumed by funds/clients, such as investment risks and counterparty risks. The team’s focus includes but is not limited to operational risk, technology, vendor, model and market risk, stress testing for market risk and the quantitative estimation of capital adequacy requirements.
  
  
The
**AI Validation**
Associate will perform independent reviews of AI tools and agents used across BlackRock, including agentic systems, RAG applications and other business workflows. This role requires strong technical expertise combined with risk management skills to challenge system design, data integrity, and performance monitoring. The role will be based onsite in our GGN office.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Conduct independent validation of AI usage in workflows, including testing for accuracy, efficiency of guardrails, orchestration, memory management and token usage.
* Design and implement comprehensive validation strategies and test plans tailored to each AI use case. Define clear success criteria and quality benchmarks to measure whether the AI solution meets all requirements and standards.
* Understand tool architecture, potential vulnerabilities and weaknesses.
* Assess conceptual soundness, methodology, and alignment with intended business use.
* Review data quality, preprocessing steps and engineering decisions for AI use cases.
* Execute functional and performance tests.
* Evaluate performance metrics, robustness, and limitations under various scenarios.
* Document validation findings, provide recommendations
* Stay current on emerging AI technologies, validation techniques, and regulatory developments.
* Communicate validation conclusions to relevant stakeholders, including escalating identified findings, risks or gaps to senior leadership and approval committees
* Collaborate with AI Engineering, Data Science, and Risk teams to enhance AI transparency and trustworthiness.

**Experience, Skills And Qualification**

* With 3-7 years’ works experience in the IT or financial industry.
* Degree or Advanced degree (MS, PhD) in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, or related field.
* Strong understanding of generative AI technologies, including large language models (LLMs), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agentic systems, prompt engineering, tool use, and modern AI application architectures.
* Experience with Python and common AI development libraries and frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow or similar).
* Excellent analytical, communication, and documentation skills.
* Ability to work independently and challenge stakeholders constructively.
* Experience with one or more of the following:
* Validating usage of large language models (LLMs) in business context
* Evaluation methodologies, benchmark development, ground-truth creation, and AI quality assessment
* AI observability, monitoring, performance measurement, and operational controls
* AI orchestration frameworks, agent architectures, prompt engineering, memory management, and context optimization
* Exposure to cloud-based AI platforms and scalable model deployment
* MCP, APIs, connectors and integrations of AI solutions with enterprise systems and data sources
* Responsible AI practices, including fairness, explainability, bias assessment, transparency, and model governance
* Fine-tuning or model customization techniques
* Security testing and risk assessment of AI systems, including prompt injection, jailbreak, and data leakage testing

**Our Benefits**
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
  
  
**Our hybrid work model**
BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
  
  
**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
**guidance**
on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
  
  
**About BlackRock**
At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
  
  
This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
  
  
To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.
  
  
BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.
