title: Specialist - Commercial Standards Claims & Contract
description:
**Job Description**
**Specialist — Commercial Standards, Claims & Contracts is a Business Analyst and SME on the Customer Operations Transformation programme.**
The outcome is a clear, governed set of commercial policies — credit, claims, pricing and trade terms — and customer agreements that are standard, compliant and correctly executed in the systems; fewer and cleaner customer claims; lower invalid deductions and trade-spend leakage; and <1 Day Resolution wherever the process allows: fewer claims arising in the first place, and faster, controlled settlement for those that remain. Everything this role does serves that outcome.
  
  
The scope spans Commercial Standards, Claims and Contracts end to end — formulation and governance of credit, claims, pricing and trade-terms policies, policy exceptions and delegation of authority, the customer agreement and contract lifecycle (drafting, approval, activation, amendment and renewal), pricing, rebate, discount and promotion setup, accruals, claims intake, validation and settlement, proof of performance, and the controls that link agreed terms to what is invoiced and paid. The role designs across this scope as one process rather than as separate contract, promotion and claims solutions. It works with market Commercial, Revenue Growth Management, Sales Finance, Credit, Legal, Internal Control, Customer Service and Collections teams, GBO, D&T, the SAP and Control Tower (Claims and Deduction platform) teams and third-party vendors.
  
  
The role combines 5 capabilities in one person. As an SME, they formulate, document the global commercial policies — credit policy (credit limits, payment terms, risk categories, blocks and releases), claims policy (eligibility, evidence, time limits, approval and write-off thresholds), and pricing governance (price-setting and approval, discount and rebate guardrails, price-change control) — and the standards and controls that make them work in practice. As a business analyst, they interrogate contract, trade-terms, accrual, claims and deduction data, document current and target process, and write requirements to standard. As a subject matter expert, they bring the functional depth to act as design authority for the fragment and to challenge solutions that would not work in the markets. As a sprint or project owner, they take a scope fragment through design, test and deployment on a two to four week value drop cadence. As a process and technology expert, they translate commercial policy, contract terms and controls into working design on SAP pricing, condition contracts and settlement management, Control Tower claims and deduction capability, and the contract and trade promotion management toolset.
  
  
**The defining discipline of this role is designing claims out at source, not processing them faster.**
A quicker claim approval is a smaller prize than a contract term clear enough never to be disputed; a faster settlement is a smaller prize than a promotion set up correctly in the system so the customer never needs to claim. The postholder is expected to use the data to find where in the commercial process claims are created — an ambiguous contract clause, a non-standard trade term, a late or incorrect pricing or promotion setup, an accrual gap, a weak approval control — and design the fix upstream into commercial policy, standards, contract templates, deal approval and master data, as well as into the claims and settlement design.
  
  
**Understanding of markets and of upstream and downstream impact is central to the role.**
A claim usually starts life as a commercial negotiation; a contract term becomes a pricing condition, an accrual, an invoice and, if anything is misaligned, a deduction in Collections. The postholder is expected to know what happens on either side of their own process — from deal negotiation through to cash and the P&L — and to design accordingly.
  
  
**This is a transformation design and delivery role, not an operational one.**
The postholder does not negotiate customer deals, draft or approve individual contracts, validate or settle individual claims, or manage customer relationships; that stays with market Commercial, Legal, GBO and BPO run teams. The role changes how that work is done — including the commercial policies, standards, contract templates, reason codes, analytics and controls that let run teams find and remove causes in BAU. The role formulates and recommends policy; final approval sits with the relevant policy owners and governance forums.
  
  
The role works independently within an agreed frame set by the workstream lead, gathers its own data, forms its own view and brings recommendations rather than questions. Where a Senior Specialist is assigned on the same fragment, it works under their design direction. Decisions are expected to be based on evidence rather than opinion, and every artefact is expected to meet the programme documentation, taxonomy and quality standards, including BPQMS.
  
  
**Analyse commercial terms, contracts and claims performance and baseline the problem — 25%.**
Document current-state credit, claims and pricing policies, commercial standards, contract lifecycle and claims processes across markets and identify variation from the global standard. Build the process, trade-terms and claim-type taxonomy and interrogate the data directly at portfolio level — customer agreements and terms, pricing and promotion conditions, accruals versus actuals, claims volume, value, ageing and rejection rates, invalid deductions, write-offs and trade-spend leakage — to baseline the problem per market and size the opportunity. Perform gap analysis between current process, commercial policy, contract terms, platform capability, controls and the target operating model, separating structural design issues from operational backlog. Support business-rule validation, master-data requirements and policy analysis. Aim for validated current-state documentation and a defensible baseline that will stand up to audit.
  
  
**Formulate commercial policies and standards, and design claims out at source — 25%.**
Support future-state design aligned to the global standard, always designing for the cause rather than the symptom. Formulate, document and maintain the global commercial policies the design depends on — credit policy (credit limits and risk categorisation, payment terms, credit blocks and release authority), claims policy (claim eligibility, evidence and proof-of-performance requirements, submission time limits, validation, approval and write-off thresholds) and pricing governance (price-setting and approval, discount, rebate and promotion guardrails, price-change control and margin protection) — with a clear policy-exception and delegation-of-authority framework, and take them through the governance forums for approval. Translate policy into the standards that operationalise it: standard trade-terms structures, contract and agreement templates, clause libraries, deal approval and delegation-of-authority rules, and the minimum data a contract must carry to be executed correctly in the systems. Use the baseline to show where claims are created — contract ambiguity, non-standard terms, pricing and promotion setup, accruals, proof of performance, master data — and design the fix upstream. Design the interventions: standard contract-to-condition setup, automated accruals and settlement, validated claim intake, reason-code frameworks and claims workflow. Prepare business requirements, functional specifications, process flows, business rules and user stories. Facilitate design workshops and document outcomes and decisions. Assess process, policy, financial and control impacts, and define how policy compliance will be monitored.
  
  
Deliver the outcome: standard contracts, fewer claims and <1 Day Resolution — 20%. Design for, and evidence, policy adoption and compliance across markets, an increase in contracts on standard terms and templates, fewer policy exceptions, a reduction in claims volume, aged claims, invalid deductions and trade-spend leakage, and movement toward <1 Day Resolution for appropriate claims and queries. Shape the build-out of SAP pricing, condition contracts and settlement management, Control Tower claims and deduction functionality, and contract and trade promotion management tooling as the primary levers on the outcome. Define the measures with the business owner, monitor post-go-live performance against the baseline, and recommend and, where owned, implement continuous improvements to the design. This is the accountability every other accountability serves.
  
  
**Own testing, deployment and adoption through the value drops — 20%.**
Translate requirements into working design on SAP, Control Tower and the contract and trade promotion management toolset with D&T, system integrators and vendors. Define and review test scenarios, support SIT and UAT, and manage defect resolution with business users. Break the work into fragments that can be delivered on the value drop cadence, and own the backlog, dependencies and risks for the fragment. Support deployment, hypercare and business readiness, and hand over up-to-date commercial standards, contract templates, process documentation, SOPs, controls and training materials to the run teams. Aim for SIT and UAT completed with minimal post-go-live defects and a clean handover into run.
  
  
**Manage delivery discipline and enable across the programme — 10%.**
Track requirements, risks, assumptions, dependencies and decisions throughout the lifecycle, and escalate early and precisely when the frame is wrong. Act as a trusted partner to market Commercial, Revenue Growth Management, Sales Finance, Credit, Legal, Internal Control, Customer Service, GBO, D&T and vendors, and coach business users through testing, deployment and adoption. Enable the adjacent workstreams — Order-to-Invoice, Collections, Claims & Receivables, Customer Service and Supply — by surfacing cross-boundary impact before it becomes a deployment defect, and by handing design-level root causes to the workstream that owns them.
  
  

* Commercial Standards, Claims & Contracts domain depth and business analysis, on a broad Customer Operations base. Real SME depth in commercial policy and customer contracts — credit policy and credit risk, claims policy, pricing governance, trade-terms structures, rebates, discounts and promotions, contract lifecycle management, accruals, and claims validation and settlement — sufficient to act as design authority and to write policy that is clear, enforceable and auditable, combined with strong business-analysis craft: process mapping, requirements gathering, gap analysis, functional-specification writing, user stories and workshop facilitation. Understands how claims and deductions are created across the commercial and Order to Cash process, and how contract wording, deal approval, pricing and promotion setup, master data and accruals drive them. Built on a general understanding of Customer Operations end-to-end (Order to Cash, Commercial and Supply) and of how markets actually work, including upstream and downstream impact. Knows Consumer Products industry standards and the realities of Beer, Wine & Spirits — distributor and wholesaler concentration, complex customer agreements, promotional and trade-spend claims, and route-to-market and regulatory constraints on trade terms. Working knowledge of Diageo BPQMS standards.
* Data, technology and delivery discipline. Comfortable interrogating contract, trade-terms, accrual, claims and deduction data directly, and translating requirements into working design on SAP pricing, condition contracts and settlement management, the Control Tower claims and deduction platform, and the supporting contract and trade promotion management toolset. Understands the platform, the data model, the business rules, workflow and approval logic, and the operating model — retained, GBO and BPO — beneath the process. Strong on test planning and defect management (SIT / UAT), business readiness and hypercare, and on risk, issue and dependency management. Data-driven by instinct — baselines the problem, quantifies the opportunity and lets the evidence settle the argument. Able to prioritise across concurrent workstreams and deadlines.
* Design-for-prevention rigour, stakeholder influence and adaptability. Relentless about cause over symptom in design — not satisfied with automating a workaround when the claim could be designed out through a clearer standard, contract or setup. Strong stakeholder management and influencing across a global and local matrix, including senior Commercial, Finance and Legal stakeholders and policy governance forums, and consultative by default: frames the problem before prescribing and drives stakeholders toward aligned design decisions. Clear communicator, and able to manage conflict to a resolution rather than let it stall a decision. Comfortable being redeployed: arrives in an unfamiliar market or process, orients fast, and adds value quickly. Resilient, collaborative, and a visible role model for Diageo’s values.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience in Finance, Business, Commercial, Law, Operations, IT or a related discipline.
* Working knowledge of Diageo BPQMS standards. Business-analysis, Agile / Scrum or Lean Six Sigma credentials are an advantage; familiarity with SAP pricing, condition contracts or settlement management, Control Tower or similar claims and deduction platforms, or contract lifecycle or trade promotion management tools is a plus.

**Experience — Essential**

* Overall. 10+ years spanning transformation, business analysis and consultative experience, with a strong core of business analysis and SME design work in large-scale process transformation.
* Subject matter expertise. Deep functional understanding of credit, claims and pricing policy, commercial terms, customer contracts and agreements, trade promotions and claims within a Commercial and Order-to-Cash environment — someone who knows how claims and deductions are created by contract terms and commercial setup, and how standards and process should be designed to prevent them, not only the tooling. Operational exposure is useful context; the requirement is designing the process, not running it.
* Transformation. Experience in business process transformation, including current-state assessment and future-state operating model design, across the full lifecycle from design through testing, deployment and post-go-live stabilisation. Evidence of reducing claims, deductions, trade-spend leakage, cycle time or manual effort against a defensible baseline.

title: Product Stewardship & Regulatory System Specialist
description:
**Reports To:**
Product Stewardship and Regulatory Supervisor
  
  
**Department:**
Product Stewardship and Regulatory Affairs
  
  
**Location:**
Gurugram, India
  
  
General Description
  
  
The Product Stewardship & Regulatory Affairs (PSRA) Specialist supports the company's compliance with global, regional, and local chemical control, product safety, and environmental regulations applicable to paints, coatings, and related raw materials. This role is responsible for the day-to-day execution of PSRA work assignments related to customer service, regulatory operations, data governance, and system administration activities, following established procedures and work instructions in a timely manner. The specialist is responsible for maintaining regulatory and product information within designated PSRA systems, processing requests related to raw material regulatory data, reviewing vendor SDSs and raw material information changes, supporting customer compliance inquiries, and ensuring data accuracy across regulatory databases and enterprise systems. The position plays a key role in promoting product safety, regulatory compliance, responsible product stewardship, and continuous improvement of PSRA digital processes while supporting business objectives and innovation initiatives. In addition, the specialist serves as a subject matter resource for PSRA-related information systems, including Sphera Intelligent Authoring (IA), SAP, LPI, web-based SDS authoring and distribution platforms, and associated regulatory databases, helping to ensure data integrity, system effectiveness, and process efficiency.
  
  
PSRA Systems and Data Management 6Support
  
  

* Maintain and update regulatory, product, substance, and raw material information within PSRA-related information systems, including Sphera Intelligent Authoring (IA), SAP, LPI, web-based SDS management systems, and other designated databases.
* Support SDS authoring, revision, publishing, and distribution activities utilizing Sphera IA and other approved SDS authoring platforms.
* Ensure data consistency and integrity across interconnected systems through routine reviews, validation checks, and adherence to established governance procedures.
* Investigate and resolve system-related data issues impacting product stewardship, regulatory compliance, SDS generation, customer requests, and reporting activities.
* Collaborate with IT, Digital, Master Data, Supply Chain, and PSRA teams to support system enhancements, process improvements, and implementation of new regulatory tools.
* Participate in system upgrades, validation activities, and data migration projects related to PSRA systems.
* Develop and maintain system documentation, training materials, work instructions, and standard operating procedures related to regulatory data management processes.
* Support the creation of dashboards, reports, and automated workflows to improve efficiency, visibility, and accuracy of regulatory information.
* Provide end-user support and training on PSRA systems and processes as required.
* Support internal users of Salesforce (SFDC), Sphera IA, SAP, LPI, web-based SDS systems, reporting tools, data workflows, and the implementation of new digital solutions that improve service levels, data quality, compliance, and operational effectiveness.

**Professional Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or higher in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Environmental Sciences, Regulatory Affairs, Information Systems, or a related field.
* 3+ years of experience in Product Stewardship, Regulatory Affairs, Chemical Compliance, or related functions, preferably within a multinational organization.
* Practical experience interpreting regulatory requirements for chemical products.
* Knowledge and experience assigning GHS classifications.
* Knowledge and experience in SDS and label authoring/preparation.
* Experience working with regulatory information management systems and enterprise software platforms.
* Working knowledge of Sphera Intelligent Authoring (IA), SAP, LPI, web-based SDS authoring/distribution systems, and Salesforce (SFDC) preferred.
* Experience maintaining product, substance, and raw material regulatory databases and supporting data governance processes.
* Familiarity with system integrations, master data management, workflow automation, and reporting tools is highly desirable.
* Ability to understand complex regulations pertaining to chemical substances.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and data management skills.
* Excellent English communication and presentation skills.
* Customer-focused, results-oriented, and able to work under pressure.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, Power BI, and related reporting tools.
* Experience collaborating with IT, Digital, and business stakeholders to improve regulatory processes and systems is preferred.

**Our Company**
Axalta has remained at the forefront of the coatings industry by continually investing in innovative solutions. We engineer technologies that protect customers’ products – whether they are battling heat, light, corrosion, abrasion, moisture, or chemicals – and add dimension and beauty with colorful finishes. We have a vast and ever-evolving portfolio of brands primed to play an important part in everything from modernizing infrastructure around the world to enabling the next generation of electric and autonomous vehicles.
  
  
Axalta operates its business in two segments: Performance Coatings and Mobility Coatings, which serve four end markets, including Refinish, Industrial, Light Vehicle and Commercial Vehicle, across North America, EMEA, Latin America and Asia-Pacific. Our diverse global footprint allows us to deliver solutions in over 140+ countries and coat 30 million vehicles per year. We’ve recently set an exciting 2040 carbon neutrality goal, in addition to 10 other sustainability initiatives, and we take pride in working with our customers to optimize their businesses and achieve their goals.

title: Senior Manager - IT Business Analysis
description:
We are seeking a talented individual to join Marsh People & Investment at Marsh Tech. This role will be based in Noida/Gurgaon. This is a hybrid role that has a requirement of working at least three days a week in the office.
  
  
Senior Manager - IT Business Analysis - AI
  
  
**Role Overview**
The Senior Systems Analyst is a role in our scaled agile framework POD and Squad model. As part of a POD team the Senior System Analyst will support one or more cross-functional squads comprised of a Squad Lead, Developers, a System Analyst, and Quality Assurance Engineers committed to ensuring the successful design and delivery of complex application solutions centered on the strategic roadmap for one or more key technology capabilities within MMC. The Senior System Analyst will be primarily responsible for directing the cross-functional elicitation and elaboration of requirements across squads in an Agile Team setting.
  
  
As part of your daily activities, you will collaborate with the Product Owner and teams to manage tactical aspects of iteration planning such as the squads’ backlog, backlog grooming, user story refinement, user story estimation, facilitating Sprint Reviews, and participating in Agile Ceremonies. As a trusted part of a team, you will coordinate activities with up to four System Analysts across squads to ensure just-in-time development of the story.
  
  
You will also assist the Product Owner in the development of personas, customer journey maps, story maps and release planning to foster insights and understanding of vision for the team.
  
  
**We will count on you to:**

* Be a highly motivated team player working within MMC Agile culture, within a specified agile framework of Scrum or KANBAN and maintain a willingness for continuously improving your agile mindset.
* Direct analysis on critical initiatives requiring significant strategic change across multiple platforms and products.
* Ensure that teams are consistently converting the business requirements to solutions, consisting of epics and features, considering technical constraints and existing technical architecture/functionality.
* Work with the Product Owner to communicate the product vision, roadmap, value, and MVP to the agile teams to enable empathy and a shared understanding thereby helping the team to formulate an appropriate solution.
* Collaborate with the Pod Leadership, Product Owner, and stakeholders to create Persona’s, Story Maps, and a Release Plan for the project.
* Work in partnership with the Product Owner and agile teams in the creation and maintenance of Product Backlog Items ensuring that Epics and User Stories are continuously prioritized and aligned to the Product Roadmap and MVP.
* Facilitate refinement sessions with the Agile Teams and Business to sufficiently detail out User Stories, to include dependencies.
* Facilitate the Sprint Review ceremony by working with the agile teams, Product Owner, Business and Customer to review, assess and adapt the latest product increment by incorporating customer insights and feedback into the Product Backlog.
* Actively work with Pod Leadership by running assessments processes for the POD and provide constructive feedback towards continuously improving the Systems Analyst function, standards and processes in Global Technology.
* Lead workshops and work collaboratively with data engineers, data architects, technical experts, and AI engineers to integrate AI solutions into a POD.
* Demonstrate an awareness of MMC and Mercer Technical, Security and Process Standards and work with the team to incorporate them in product delivery through the software development life cycle.

**What you need to have:**

* Highly motivated candidate who is an inquisitive rapid learner that is comfortable working as part of a remote team.
* Possess strong communication skills with the capability of working collaboratively within the organization, regardless of boundaries.
* An effective communicator for both technical and business-oriented audience.
* Demonstrated requirements gathering skills showcasing the capture of customer needs and business drivers using a variety of techniques into product backlog items such as Epics and User Stories.
* Proven quantitative, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Skilled in providing process improvement and integration opportunities with other process automation tools.
* Self-motivated and ability to learn through research and self-training.
* Ability to remove impediments for squads by providing timely responses and solutions as required.
* Ability to find resolutions regarding own work methods requiring minimal direction.
* Be willing to respond to emergent changes rather than focused on existing plans.
* Familiarity with AI concepts and technologies, including machine learning, natural language processing, and data analytics, while ensuring compliance with AI governance frameworks. Leverage these technologies to enhance user experiences and improve decision-making processes within applications.

**What makes you stand out?**

* Ability to craft effective prompts that optimize AI responses, enhancing the functionality of AI-driven applications for problem-solving, analysis, and content generation.
* Capability to work within a POD/ cross-functional squads to develop and implement an AI strategy that aligns with business needs.
* Commitment to staying updated on the latest AI trends, technologies, and best practices to continuously improve AI capabilities within the organization.
* An Agile Mindset with an in-depth understanding of Agile Principles.
* Must have prior experience as an IT Systems Analyst or IT Business Analyst working as part of an agile team using an Agile Workflow tool such as JIRA or TFS.
* Agile Certification, such as CSM, PSM, CSPO, PSPO, PMI-ACP, Certified SAFe Practitioner, Azure AI Fundamentals is desirable.

**Why join our team:**

* We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.
* We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have impact for colleagues, clients and communities.
* Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well-being.

title: Intern, Evaluation
company: International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies - IFRC
description:
Organizational Context
  
  
The International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies (IFRC) is the world’s largest humanitarian organization, with a network of 191-member National Societies (NSs). The overall aim of IFRC is “to inspire, encourage, facilitate, and promote at all times all forms of humanitarian activities by NSs with a view to preventing and alleviating human suffering and thereby contributing to the maintenance and promotion of human dignity and peace in the world.” IFRC works to meet the needs and improve the lives of vulnerable people before, during and after disasters, health emergencies and other crises.
  
  
IFRC is part of the International Red Cross and Red Crescent Movement (Movement), together with its member National Societies and the International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC). The work of IFRC is guided by the following fundamental principles: humanity, impartiality, neutrality, independence, voluntary service, unity, and universality.
  
  
IFRC is led by its Secretary General, and has its Headquarters in Geneva, Switzerland. The Headquarters are organized into four main Divisions: (i) National Society Development and Coordination; (ii) Humanitarian Diplomacy and Digitalization; (iii) Legal, Governance Support and Accountability; and (iv) People and Strategy.
  
  
IFRC has five regional offices in Africa, Asia Pacific, Middle East and North Africa, Europe, and the Americas. IFRC also has country cluster delegations and country delegations throughout the world. Together, the Geneva Headquarters and the field structure (regional, cluster and country) comprise the IFRC Secretariat.
  
  
IFRC has a zero-tolerance policy on conduct that is incompatible with the aims and objectives of the Red Cross and Red Crescent Movement, including sexual exploitation and abuse, sexual harassment and other forms of harassment, abuse of authority, discrimination, and lack of integrity (including but not limited to financial misconduct). IFRC also adheres to strict child safeguarding principles.
  
  
The Evaluation function is part of the Executive Office within the People and Strategy Division. It strengthens organizational accountability and learning by coordinating the IFRC Evaluation Framework and annual evaluation plan, promoting quality standards, maintaining evaluation knowledge systems, and supporting follow-up on evaluation recommendations and management responses.
  
  
Based in New Delhi, the Intern, Evaluations – Strategic Planning and Communications supports the global Evaluation Unit across headquarters, regional offices, delegations, and National Societies. The internship combines evaluation support with data management, evidence synthesis, digital innovation, knowledge management, and strategic communication.
  
  
**Job Purpose**

title: Intern, Founder's Office
description:
**About us**

BrightSense is building technology for the AI age. Its first product is Branly, an AI visibility platform.

How people discover brands has changed. More and more, they ask ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude and Google's AI answers what to buy, and those answers name only a handful of brands. Branly shows a brand how often it appears in those answers, how it is described and which sources the engines rely on. Then it turns every gap into a specific fix the brand can act on.

Three things shape how we work:

* **Grounded in research.**
  AI search changes every week. We study how each engine finds, trusts and cites its sources, and we keep our methods in step with what the engines do today.
* **Signal over noise.**
  We start from the real questions buyers ask, in their own words. We run them repeatedly across every major engine and read the answers over time, so what we show is a pattern, not a one-off.
* **Customer first.**
  Our customers sit at the centre of everything we build. We learn their category, competitors and goals, then stay alongside them until the work shows up as growth.

**The role**

We are hiring an Intern in the Founder's Office to work directly with the founding team across growth, product, research and operations.

You will run projects end to end: launch campaigns, read user data, speak to customers, test product releases, research competitors and keep day-to-day work moving. Some projects will be planned. Others will come up because something needs fixing that day.

We are an AI-first team. AI is how we research, write, analyse and build, not an add-on. You will be expected to work the same way: hand the first pass to AI, check it properly, and spend your own time on judgement and the parts that need a human.

You will learn how the business works by working across it. We are looking for someone who asks good questions, figures things out and takes a task through to completion.

Full-time internship, 6 months. On-site, Gurgaon. Stipend: ₹30,000 to ₹50,000 a month. You will report to the founding team.

**What you will do**

* **AI-first execution.**
  Use AI tools as your default way of working across research, writing, analysis and reporting. Build simple, repeatable workflows the team can reuse, check every output before it goes anywhere, and share what saves time.
* **Growth and go-to-market.**
  Run outbound and paid experiments end to end: list building, copywriting, campaign execution and performance analysis. Track what works, recommend what to change and stop what does not.
* **User funnel.**
  Track the journey from sign-up to activation and paid conversion. Find where users drop off, investigate why and work with the team to close the gaps.
* **User communication and channels.**
  Write and send the messages that move users forward: onboarding emails, follow-ups, reminders, community posts and content. Own each piece from first draft to publishing, and measure how users respond.
* **Cohort and segment analysis.**
  Use tools such as PostHog, Mixpanel or similar to understand how different user groups behave. Spot patterns, explain what they mean and recommend what to do next.
* **Direct user feedback.**
  Call and message users to understand what is and is not working. Capture feedback in their own words and bring clear findings back to the founding team.
* **Product testing and improvement.**
  Test upcoming releases, catch bugs before customers do and document issues the team can act on. Turn user feedback and funnel gaps into specific product ideas.
* **Competitor and market research.**
  Research competitors and relevant tools. Understand their pricing, strengths and differentiators, and identify where Branly can do better.
* **Operations and urgent priorities.**
  Take ownership of work across vendors, spreadsheets, hiring pipelines, launches and other operational needs. Keep information organised, follow up with the right people and close open tasks.
* **Learn the product inside out.**
  Use Branly the way our customers do. Understand how brands show up in AI answers, so your work in growth, research and support is grounded in the product.

**Who you are**

* A student or recent graduate who wants hands-on experience building and running a business.
* You have taken ownership of something and finished it. This could be an internship project, a campus initiative, a side project or something you built yourself.
* AI-first by habit. You already use tools like ChatGPT, Claude or Perplexity every day, you have used them to get real work done, and you know when an answer needs checking.
* Comfortable with spreadsheets and numbers. You can spot a pattern, investigate a drop-off and suggest a concrete fix.
* A clear writer who can put together an email, campaign message or research note that gets to the point.
* Comfortable calling or messaging users, customers and vendors directly to get feedback or move work forward.
* Curious about startups, B2B software and marketing. You take an interest in how products find users and turn them into customers.
* Organised enough to manage several tasks, keep people updated and follow through without repeated reminders.

**Bonus points**

* You have built something with AI: an automation, a custom GPT or Claude project, or a workflow that replaced manual work.
* Hands-on experience with PostHog, Mixpanel, Google Analytics or similar tools.
* You have run an email campaign, built an online community, created content or tested a paid campaign.
* Experience testing a product and documenting bugs clearly.
* You have built a side project, worked at a startup or helped run an online business.

**What it is like working with us**

* **Build in one of marketing's most in-demand categories.**
  More brands want to understand how AI talks about them. You will help build a product that answers that question.
* **Learn to work the AI-first way.**
  You will see how a small team uses AI to do the work of a much larger one, and you will leave with workflows and habits most teams are still figuring out.
* **High ownership, high visibility.**
  You will work side by side with the founders. Your work ships fast, and you will see what it changes.
* **A seat close to the decisions.**
  You will see how growth, product and operations connect, and help shape what the team does next.
* **Learn from founders who have scaled before.**
  You will work closely with a team that has led and grown operations across industries, and you will pick up how it is done.
* **Grow as fast as you learn.**
  As you show what you can handle, you will take on larger projects and more responsibility.

description:

title: Associate Consultant - Technology Strategy
description:
**What makes Gartner Consulting a GREAT fit for you?**
Gartner Consulting is an extension of Gartner’s world-renowned Research. We partner directly with CxOs across industry and government, helping organisations make smarter and faster decisions to achieve their mission-critical priorities.
  
  
Our Consulting team is made up of strategists, innovators, consultants, digital experts, former practitioners, and technologists, delivering 2,100+ strategic consulting engagements annually. We deliver unbiased and independent solutions, helping change conventional thinking and accomplish ground-breaking results for our clients.
  
  
We are a diverse team of strategic thought leaders. As we continue to grow we look for great people to join us on that journey, and grow with us.
  
  
**About Role:**
Gartner Consulting is looking for an Associate Consultant who will work with some of the world’s largest enterprises on their mission-critical priorities. The Associate Consultant will support consulting teams through structured research, quantitative and qualitative analysis, development of insights, and creation of high-quality client deliverables across digital strategy, technology strategy, operating model and enterprise transformation engagements.
  
  
**What you’ll do:**

* Work as a collaborative member of consulting teams serving some of the world’s largest enterprises, supporting engagements focused on digital strategy, technology strategy, operating model, enterprise transformation and other mission-critical priorities.
* Develop broad consulting experience across industries and practice areas, while building foundational capabilities in research, analytics, problem solving, client communication and engagement delivery.
* Develop an understanding of client objectives, industry context and potential obstacles; structure assigned work to support engagement priorities and client deliverables.
* Execute primary research and information-gathering activities, including collecting, organizing and validating client data, conducting market research and using Gartner research and benchmarks.
* Perform clearly structured quantitative, qualitative and technical analyses with guidance, applying relevant Gartner methodologies, frameworks and best practices.
* Test hypotheses using available evidence, identify patterns and anomalies, and translate research and analysis into straightforward insights, conclusions and recommendations with guidance.
* Summarize analyses and observations for specific client deliverables or broader teamwork, clearly distinguishing facts, assumptions and areas requiring further validation.
* Prepare high-quality client outputs, including executive presentations, assessment findings, workshop materials, roadmaps, business cases and written recommendations, using clear storylines and effective data visualization.
* Participate in client interviews, workshops and working sessions; listen actively, ask relevant clarifying questions, document requirements and decisions, and support agreed follow-up actions.
* Manage and prioritize assigned activities effectively, deliver work products within agreed timelines, and proactively communicate progress, dependencies, issues and risks to the engagement team.
* Take ownership of the accuracy and quality of facts, data and analyses presented; conduct self and peer review, flag anomalies or concerns, and incorporate feedback before work is shared.
* Invest in self-development, seek and apply coaching, participate in Gartner learning communities, and contribute to internal knowledge and intellectual capital development when requested.

**What you’ll need:**

* 2–4 years of professional experience in consulting, strategy, research, technology, business transformation or a related field. At least 2 years of Technology strategy consulting experience is highly preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to gather, organize and analyze qualitative and quantitative information and convert it into clear observations or insights.
* Strong structured problem-solving skills, including the ability to break down ambiguous questions, test hypotheses, apply strategy consulting frameworks and draw evidence-based conclusions with guidance.
* Strong written, verbal and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate general and technical messages clearly and in plain language.
* Experience developing high-quality presentations, analytical outputs or written deliverables, with strong attention to accuracy, consistency and detail.
* Curiosity about business and technology trends and an interest in how digital, data, cloud, automation and emerging technologies can improve business outcomes.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft PowerPoint and Excel; familiarity with data analysis, visualization, research or AI-enabled productivity tools is an advantage.
* Strong collaboration and interpersonal skills, including the ability to work effectively with globally distributed and cross-border teams.
* A curious and inquisitive mindset, openness to feedback and new experiences, and the ability to learn quickly and work effectively in ambiguous environments.
* Bachelor’s degree required in engineering, technology, computer science, mathematics, statistics or a related discipline; an advanced degree in management is preferred.

**Who you are:**

* Self-starter and quick learner who takes ownership of assigned work and demonstrates intellectual curiosity and a commitment to client impact.
* Analytical thinker who approaches problems logically, asks relevant questions and uses evidence to develop sound conclusions.
* Clear communicator who can synthesize complex information into concise, audience-appropriate messages and high-quality deliverables.
* Collaborative team member who builds effective working relationships, responds well to coaching and actively incorporates feedback.
* Organized and dependable, with the ability to manage priorities, meet agreed timelines and proactively raise issues or concerns.
* Client-focused professional who listens actively, understands how assigned work connects to client objectives and takes responsibility for accuracy and quality.
* Committed to continuous learning, including developing awareness of Gartner methodologies, consulting best practices, business trends and the responsible use of approved AI-enabled productivity tools.

**What Gartner Consulting will offer you?**

* A world-class consulting environment.
* The opportunity to work on high-impact digital, technology strategy and enterprise transformation engagements with a tier one client portfolio.
* A competitive salary.
* Structured bonus based on individual and corporate performance.
* Opportunities for promotion with a clearly defined career development structure.
* Opportunity to participate actively in the development and future of Gartner Consulting.
* A dynamic but relaxed and supportive working environment that encourages personal development.

**About Gartner:**
Gartner, Inc. (NYSE: IT) is the world’s leading information technology research and advisory company. We deliver the technology-related insight necessary for our clients to make the right decisions, every day. We work with every client to research, analyze and interpret the business of IT within the context of their individual role. Founded in 1979, Gartner is headquartered in Stamford, Connecticut, U.S.A. – Visit gartner.com to discover more.
  
  
**Who are we?**
At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.
  
  
Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.
  
  
Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.
  
  
**What makes Gartner a great place to work?**
Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.
  
  
We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.
  
  
Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.
  
  
We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.
  
  
**Gartner is the world authority on AI**
At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.
  
  
It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.
  
  
**What do we offer?**
Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.
  
  
In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.
  
  
Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us.

title: Mechanical Engineering
description:
**Mechanical Engineering – AI Trainer**
**About The Role**
We're partnering with the world's leading AI research labs to build smarter, more technically rigorous AI models — and we need mechanical engineers to make it happen. As an AI Trainer, you'll use your deep domain knowledge to challenge, test, and refine how AI reasons through complex engineering problems.
  
  
This is a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of engineering and artificial intelligence, contributing directly to the next generation of technical AI systems — all on a flexible, remote contract basis.
  
  

* Organization: Alignerr
* Type: Hourly Contract
* Location: Fully Remote
* Commitment: 10–40 hours/week

**What You'll Do**

* Design Complex Engineering Problems — Craft advanced, multi-step problems spanning fluid dynamics, thermodynamics, structural mechanics, FEA, heat transfer, kinematics, and materials science to rigorously stress-test AI capabilities
* Author Ground-Truth Solutions — Develop precise, step-by-step technical solutions that serve as gold-standard benchmarks for AI learning and evaluation
* Audit AI Reasoning — Review and evaluate AI-generated outputs — including CAD logic, thermodynamic proofs, and material specifications — for technical accuracy, physical validity, and adherence to engineering standards (e.g., ASME, ISO)
* Identify & Correct Reasoning Failures — Spot logical errors such as incorrect force distributions, energy conservation violations, or flawed unit analysis, and provide structured feedback to improve how the model thinks
* Document Failure Modes — Systematically record model weaknesses to help research teams harden AI reasoning across mechanical engineering domains

**Who You Are**

* Advanced Degree — Master's (pursuing or completed) or PhD in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a closely related field
* Strong Domain Expertise — Deep knowledge in one or more core areas: solid mechanics, fluid mechanics, thermodynamics, CAD/CAM, or manufacturing processes
* Clear Technical Communicator — Able to explain complex physical phenomena and mathematical derivations in precise, well-structured written form
* Detail-Oriented — High level of precision when reviewing mathematical derivations, unit conversions, dimensional analysis, and physical system constraints
* No prior AI experience required — we'll get you up to speed

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with data annotation, technical writing, or quality evaluation
* Proficiency in engineering software such as SolidWorks, MATLAB, ANSYS, or similar tools
* Familiarity with FEA workflows, CFD simulation, or mechatronics systems

**Why Join Us**

* Work on genuinely cutting-edge AI projects alongside world-class research teams
* Fully remote and flexible — work independently on your own schedule
* Apply your engineering expertise in a novel, intellectually stimulating way
* Gain rare, hands-on exposure to how advanced large language models are trained and evaluated
* Freelance perks: autonomy, variety, and global collaboration
* Potential for ongoing work and contract extension

title: Associated Product Development Engineer
description:
Long Description
  
  
As our new Associated Product Development Engineer, you will be driving product verification and testing of controllers, PCB assemblies, and electronic systems within our Water Utility Controls team — from building prototypes and designing test setups to analyzing results that shape engineering decisions. You'll be part of a diverse, supportive and inclusive culture, that celebrates our differences and puts people first by fostering growth, well-being, and a sense of belonging.
  
  
**What You Will Be Doing**
As a key part of the WU Product Development Controls team, you'll create impact by Ensuring the quality, safety, and compliance of next-generation pump controllers and electronics through rigorous testing and innovative problem-solving..
  
  
**Your main responsibilities include:**

* Design and build test setups for electrical testing of controls, PCBs, and electronic assemblies, and execute test cases with the highest quality standards
* Facilitate and coordinate prototype building — modifying parts, swapping components, integrating sensors, and assembling controllers, motors, and pumps
* Analyze and evaluate test results, providing clear technical recommendations to the Engineering and Development teams
* Conduct and coordinate compliance testing per global standards (UL, CE, EMI, EMC, Radio) and manage third-party lab testing when required
* Deliver high-quality test documentation and reporting in SharePoint and TVS for all project stakeholders
* Support DP and PLM projects by planning test activities, providing technical solutions, and ensuring prototyping costs meet requirements

**What Makes You a Great Fit**
Above all, you are a hands-on engineer with strong electrical testing expertise, a keen eye for quality, and the ability to bridge the gap between lab work and product development decisions. We would also imagine that you have:
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, or a related field
* 3+ years of experience in electrical/hardware testing, including PCB-level testing and test setup design
* Working knowledge of global compliance standards such as UL, CE, EMI, EMC, and safety testing
* Understanding of communication protocols (e.g., Modbus) and basic electrical board functionality

**It is a plus if you also:**

* Experience with agile product development processes and PLM tools
* Familiarity with pump, motor, or controller product development environments
* Ability to provide cost-conscious test planning and coordinate with third-party testing laboratories

**Why you will love working here**
We care! Day to day, you can look forward to:
  
  

* A working environment built around your needs, with flexible hours, home working opportunities and parental support.
* Annual bonuses, health insurance and a strong focus on well-being activities.

* Access to on-demand training and learning sessions and carefully structured programmes to pursue personal and professional development opportunities.

title: Associate, Lead Exposure
description:
WJCF is an Indian non-profit organisation committed to saving lives by reducing the burden of disease and strengthening government-owned, high-quality health systems. Since 2007, WJCF has combined data-driven approaches and deep public health expertise with strong government partnerships to design, implement, and scale solutions across India’s national and state health programmes. We work for and at the service of governments — supporting the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare and State Departments of Health to build systems that are strong, sustainable, and led by Indian institutions.
  
  
As an Indian organisation, WJCF brings an unmatched depth of contextual understanding of India’s health system architecture, policy landscape, and implementation realities across diverse geographies and population groups. This local institutional credibility, combined with global technical rigour, is central to WJCF’s effectiveness as a partner to governments and donors.
  
  
Our work is built around four complementary roles as a Trusted Government Partner, co-designing programmes and strengthening health system architecture; as an Operational Partner, translating strategies into effective on-the-ground delivery; as a Market Shaper, improving the availability and affordability of health commodities; and as an Ecosystem Catalyst, convening governments, development partners, academia, and the private sector to drive solutions at scale.
  
  
WJCF’s programme portfolio spans thematic areas like hepatitis, HIV/AIDS, tuberculosis, vector-borne diseases), syphilis, cervical cancer, diabetes, maternal and childhood anaemia, immunisation, under-5 diarrhoea and pneumonia, sexual and reproductive health, Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri - Jan Arogya Yojana (AB PM-JAY), Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM), hypoxemia and oxygen, safe drinking water, sickle cell disease, presbyopia, lead poisoning, and cross cutting thematic areas like AI and Health, integrated disease surveillance, and climate and health.
  
  
We currently support programmes across 19 states and union territories, with teams working at national, state, district, and sub-district levels.
  
  
Our people are our greatest asset. WJCF brings together a talented, diverse team of professionals from public health, analytics, consulting, healthcare, the development sector, and academia, all united by a shared commitment to improving health outcomes for the people of India. We are entrepreneurial, action-oriented, and deeply grounded in the communities and systems we work in. Our field teams collectively bring hundreds of years of experience managing public health programmes across the country.
  
  
WJCF collaborates with a range of international and domestic partners and donors to advance its mission, including an affiliation with the Clinton Health Access Initiative (CHAI), a global health organisation with which WJCF shares a common mission and values.
  
  
Programme Overview
  
  
Lead poisoning is one of India's most significant and most solvable public health challenges. India bears the world's highest burden of childhood lead poisoning, with over 275 million children carry blood lead levels above 5 µg/dL; the national average is 6.2 µg/dL and 23 States exceed the threshold (NITI Aayog and CSIR review, 2022). Lead exposure causes irreversible neurological damage in children, contributes to an estimated one million cardiovascular deaths annually in adults (Larsen et al., 2023), and generates compounding intergenerational risks.
  
  
National Center for Disease Control, as the designated national focal agency under MoHFW, is establishing the National Biomonitoring Programme for Chemical Toxicants (NBPCT). WJCF is embedding a Technical Support Unit (TSU) to serve as the coordination backbone for India's lead mitigation response. This embedded model builds directly on WJCF's track record of high-impact TSU engagements across TB, vector-borne diseases, oxygen, surveillance, and health insurance.
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
We are seeking a motivated and analytically rigorous individual to serve as a core member of WJCF's embedded TSU. The incumbent will provide day-to-day technical, coordination, and secretariat support to government counterparts translating high-level intent into structured operational workplans, facilitating inter-ministerial coordination, and helping anchor governance architecture that outlasts individual donor cycles.
  
  
The role demands both policy acumen to navigate a complex multi-stakeholder environment and operational discipline to ensure consistent follow-through. The incumbent will report to the TSU Lead and will function under the programmatic guidance of NCDC for TSU activities.
  
  
**Location**
New Delhi (embedded at NCDC / MoHFW)
  
  
**Travel**
Domestic travel to programme states as required
  
  
TSU Secretariat and Programme Operations
  
  

* Provide day-to-day secretariat support to NCDC for the NBPCT, including preparation of meeting agendas, data-backed workplans, activity plans, and meeting charters across surveillance, capacity building, and enforcement priorities.
* Support NCDC's National Lead Technical Working Group through data synthesis, expert inputs, documentation, and follow-up mechanisms that convert deliberations into actionable outcomes.
* Support integration of state and laboratory surveillance data into the Integrated Health Information Platform (IHIP) and contribute to dashboard and visualisation design for NCDC decision-making.
* Strengthen NCDC's capacity for data-backed decision-making in hotspot identification, laboratory and referral infrastructure mapping, and partner coordination.
* Consolidate and disseminate learnings from state-level engagement through regional and national workshops.
* Support the Programme in convening and facilitating inter-ministerial consultations on lead and chemical toxicants across environment, industry, labour, food safety, water, and mines ministries.
* Prepare technical inputs, briefing materials, and correspondence for senior decision-making within the ministry.

title: Impact Manager (Full-time / Remote)
description:
**About Generation:**

At Generation, we believe in the power of employment to change lives. We are a global nonprofit organization that supports adults to achieve economic mobility through employment. Generation trains and places adult learners of all ages into careers that are otherwise inaccessible, working in partnership with governments, employers, and other system actors. We also conduct original research and share data insights on high-priority global workforce transition topics to inform decision-making by workforce system stakeholders. Launched in 2015, Generation comprises a global hub (Generation You Employed, or GYE) and a network of in-country affiliates. To date, the network has 150,000+ graduates and 23,000+ employers across 50 professions and 17 countries.

When learners join Generation, 91% are unemployed, of which nearly half are long-term unemployed. Three months after completing our program, graduates have an 78% job placement rate, rising to 88% within six months. Of our employed graduates, 79% are hired by repeat employers who have previously hired Generation graduates, and 89% are in jobs directly related to the profession for which we have trained them. Employed graduates immediately earn an average of 3-4X their previous earnings. Two to five years after graduation, 77% of our alumni from upper-middle income countries continue to meet their daily financial needs and 63% can save for the future. To date, Generation’s global graduates have earned more than $1.9 billion in wages. Generation graduates typically have a secondary school background, 52% are female, 28% have dependents, and the majority identify with underrepresented communities in their country.

**JOB OBJECTIVES:**

The Impact Manager will strengthen Generation’s ability to measure, evaluate, and communicate durable impact across the global network. Reporting to the Lead, Impact Evaluation & Data Advocacy, this role will lead durability measurement and evaluation workstreams, deliver instruction and content for the Durability Academy, and serve as global D&I’s day-to-day counterpart on APAC and SAMEA.

This role combines research rigor, structured problem-solving, and the ability to teach and coach. The Impact Manager will independently own defined evaluation, research, and insight workstreams, manage vendor and research partner relationships, coach Durability Academy partner organizations, and produce high-quality materials for Generation leadership, country CEOs, and funders.

This is a remote position, based in the SAMEA region (India preferred).

**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Durability & Impact Evaluation**

* Lead defined cross-country durability analyses (employment, earnings, job quality, financial health, and related metrics), from framing through final outputs
* Shape evaluation framing, research design, and methodological comparability across countries and program models
* Manage evaluations and research partnerships end to end, including scoping, vendor procurement, contracting support, data-sharing processes, and quality of deliverables
* Own evaluation briefs, synthesis memos, and funder-ready materials
* Ensure durability insights are grounded in consistent and reliable underlying data

**Durability Academy Instruction & Content**

* Co-facilitate cohort-wide Durability Academy sessions, taking ownership of selected modules over time
* Serve as a 1:1 coach for a portfolio of cohort partner organizations, guiding them through their theory of change, durability logframe, and measurement plans
* Maintain and improve Academy content between cohorts, including module materials, milestone documents, logframe templates, and facilitation guides
* Turn cohort work into reusable examples, case material, and practical guidance for future cohorts and the wider Durability Collective

**APAC & India Impact Priorities**

* Act as global D&I's day-to-day counterpart to Generation India and other APAC teams on evaluation, data, and impact priorities
* Coordinate regional evaluations and research partnerships, ensuring alignment with global methodology and standards
* Support regional teams on outcomes data, cost-per-learner and ROI inputs, and funder reporting
* Support onboarding and alignment of regional impact leads with global D&I tools and ways of working
* Surface regional insights and needs to D&I leadership to inform priorities and planning

**Structured Analysis & Insight Communication**

* Translate ambiguous leadership and funder questions into structured analytical approaches, and lead the resulting analyses
* Develop high-quality slide decks, workshop materials, and written summaries for Generation leadership, country CEOs, and funders
* Shape coherent impact narratives across decks, reports, and external-facing materials
* Contribute evidence, data, and methodology inputs to grant proposals and funder engagement

**Cross-Functional Delivery & Team Support**

* Manage timelines, deliverables, and dependencies across D&I workstreams, proactively flagging risks and reporting progress
* Partner with Impact Operations and Analytics colleagues to improve the clarity and consistency of core metrics (e.g., placement, durability indicators, income, living wage, ROI)
* Provide guidance and quality review for analyst-level work as needed
* Support D&I team operations such as recruitment and onboarding

**ATTRIBUTES (e.g. qualifications, knowledge, skills, and experience):**

***Required experience and skills:***

* 5+ years of experience in impact evaluation, monitoring & evaluation, research, analytics, consulting, policy, or related fields
* Track record of independently owning evaluation, research, or analytical workstreams from framing to delivery
* Experience managing external vendors, research partners, or academic collaborators
* Experience facilitating workshops, training, or coaching for professional audiences
* Strong structured thinking and the ability to synthesize complex information into clear insights
* Strong written communication and slide development skills, including materials for senior leadership or funders
* Comfort working with data (Excel required; SQL preferred)
* Ability to operate independently with significant ambiguity and manage multiple workstreams

***Preferred experience and skills:***

* Experience in workforce development, economic mobility, education, or related social sector work
* Experience working with teams in India or the wider SAMEA/APAC region
* Hands-on experience with survey design, research design, and impact evaluation methodologies, including quasi-experimental approaches
* Familiarity with adult learning principles or curriculum development
* Experience working with dashboards (e.g., Power BI) and interpreting metrics
* Fluency in additional languages beyond English

***Mindset:***

* Structured thinker who breaks down ambiguous questions into clear components and approaches, and helps others do the same
* Intellectually curious and motivated to understand the “why” behind outcomes, not just produce analysis
* Rigorous and practical, holding a high bar on evidence while keeping measurement useful for partners and programs
* Takes ownership, proactively flagging risks and proposing solutions
* Collaborative and low-ego, able to work across technical and non-technical stakeholders, cultures, and time zones
* Self-reflective and open to giving and receiving frequent feedback

title: SEO Content Writer
description:
**Company Description**
Lean Hippo Marketers is a data-informed, content-led boutique digital marketing agency that uses social media, search engines, and the web to drive measurable business results for clients. The team brings together marketers, technologists, designers, and storytellers who collaborate to deliver innovative, performance-focused campaigns. The agency emphasizes quantifiable outcomes, aligning creative content with data insights to maximize impact. By optimizing resources effectively, Lean Hippo Marketers aims to deliver “hippo-size” results while maintaining agility and efficiency.

**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Content Writer role based in Gurugram. The Content Writer will create clear, engaging, and brand-aligned content for websites, blogs, social media, and other digital channels. Responsibilities include conducting research on industry topics, developing content outlines, writing and revising copy, and ensuring accuracy and consistency in tone and messaging. The role involves collaborating with marketing, design, and strategy teams to support campaigns and content calendars, as well as optimizing content for search and audience engagement. The Content Writer will also proofread and edit materials to maintain high editorial standards and meet project deadlines.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Write engaging, original, and SEO-optimized content for websites, blogs, landing pages, and articles.
* Develop persuasive copy for social media posts, digital advertisements, email campaigns, and marketing collateral.
* Optimize existing content to enhance readability and search engine rankings.
* Proofread and edit content to ensure clarity, accuracy, consistency, and grammatical correctness.
* Collaborate with designers, SEO specialists, and client servicing teams to deliver high-quality content aligned with client objectives.
* Maintain consistency in brand tone and messaging across multiple client accounts.
* Research industry trends and create content tailored to different business domains.
* Manage multiple content projects while meeting deadlines in a fast-paced agency environment.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* **Minimum 6 months**
  of professional experience in SEO content writing and copywriting.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Strong understanding of SEO fundamentals, keyword research, and content optimization.
* Ability to write for different industries, audiences, and digital platforms.
* Strong proofreading, editing, and research skills.
* Basic knowledge of WordPress or other Content Management Systems (CMS) is an added advantage.
* Familiarity with AI-assisted content tools and digital marketing trends is a plus.
* Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team.

title: Executive Presentations Lead
description:
**Who We Are**
Inovalon was founded in 1998 on the belief that technology, and data specifically, would empower the transformation of the entire healthcare ecosystem for the better, improving both outcomes and economics. At Inovalon, we believe that when our customers are successful in their missions, healthcare improves. Therefore, we focus on empowering them with data-driven solutions. And the momentum is building. Together, as ONE Inovalon, we are a united force delivering solutions that address healthcare’s greatest needs. Through our mission-based culture of inclusion and innovation, our organization brings value not just to our customers, but to the millions of patients and members they serve.
  
  
**Who You Are**
As an Executive Communications Lead (Principal Creative Services Manager), you translate complex business narratives into executive presentations that can withstand close scrutiny from the CEO, Board members, investors, and other senior stakeholders. You serve as a standalone individual contributor reporting to the Head of Business Performance, partnering directly with C level leaders to shape strategic communications, investor materials, M&A narratives, and quarterly business reviews. In this role, you combine narrative strategy, business judgment, and presentation discipline to strengthen executive decision making and confidence.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Own the strategy and execution of Board materials, investor presentations, and executive strategic communications from intake through final delivery.
* Lead conversations with C level stakeholders to understand objectives, gather inputs, define messaging priorities, and shape clear presentation strategies.
* Develop business cases and strategic narratives by challenging assumptions, testing logic, identifying weak points, and restructuring arguments before executive review.
* Design presentations for stakeholder scrutiny by anticipating likely questions, building supporting depth into materials, and ensuring each slide can stand on its own under cross examination.
* Define the visual and narrative architecture of executive materials, including story flow, visual hierarchy, slide logic, and consistency across summaries, reviews, and full length decks.
* Manage feedback cycles across multiple senior stakeholders by synthesizing input, resolving conflicting perspectives, and preserving narrative coherence through revision rounds.
* Create clear, decision driving charts, infographics, and presentation visuals that improve comprehension and support executive level communication.
* Establish presentation standards, templates, playbooks, and best practices for the business to improve the quality and consistency of executive communications over time.
* Advise leaders on how to communicate with executive audiences by applying insight into stakeholder psychology, risk evaluation, and investor or Board expectations.

**What You'll Need**

title: Chemical Engineering
description:
**About Turing:**

* Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies, accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.
* Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.

**Role Overview:**

* We are seeking an experienced Chemical Engineering expert to lead a team of technical trainers developing realistic, terminal-based engineering tasks for a frontier AI training and evaluation initiative.
* In this role, you will oversee a pod of approximately 5–10 trainers, review chemical engineering tasks for technical accuracy, reproducibility, and evaluation quality, and ensure tasks reflect authentic chemical engineering workflows. You will also mentor trainers, maintain quality standards, and drive consistent task delivery.

**What you'll do:**

* Lead and mentor a pod of technical trainers, ensuring consistent quality, productivity, and timely delivery of chemical engineering tasks.
* Review engineering tasks end to end, including problem statements, reaction kinetics, thermodynamic and property data, process flowsheets, computational environments, reference solutions, and automated tests.
* Validate tasks involving reaction engineering, thermodynamics, phase equilibria, transport phenomena, separation processes, process simulation, process control, optimization, combustion, and electrochemical engineering.
* Ensure tasks reflect realistic chemical engineering workflows and require meaningful multi-step technical reasoning.
* Verify engineering correctness across mass and energy balances, thermodynamic consistency, property data, unit handling, and numerical convergence.
* Validate computational models, stiff ODE/DAE solvers, solver tolerances, initial conditions, and simulation results to ensure reproducibility and technical accuracy.
* Review automated graders to ensure they evaluate meaningful engineering outputs such as conversion, yield, selectivity, purity, energy consumption, and process constraint satisfaction.
* Identify technical inaccuracies, unrealistic assumptions, incorrect tolerances, and opportunities to bypass engineering calculations or simulations.
* Provide clear, actionable technical feedback, track revisions, and ensure quality issues are resolved before task approval.
* Onboard trainers, allocate work, monitor quality and throughput, escalate blockers, and maintain technical documentation and best practices.

**What we're looking for:**

* Ph.D., postdoctoral experience, or equivalent advanced technical experience in Chemical Engineering.
* Strong programming skills in Python, Julia, C/C++, or MATLAB/Octave, with proficiency in Linux environments.
* Hands-on expertise in at least one major area: process modeling, reaction kinetics, thermodynamic modeling, process simulation, or optimization.
* Strong understanding of chemical engineering fundamentals, numerical methods, computational modeling, and technical validation.
* Experience reviewing complex technical work, chemical process simulations, computational models, or research outputs.
* Ability to evaluate mass and energy balances, thermodynamic assumptions, numerical accuracy, solver convergence, and the reliability of computational results.
* Strong analytical judgment with the ability to identify technical errors, edge cases, and flawed engineering assumptions.
* Experience mentoring, reviewing, or leading small technical teams.
* Excellent written communication skills for providing precise technical feedback and documenting quality standards.

**Nice to have:**

* Experience with chemical engineering simulation and computational tools such as Cantera, CoolProp, Pyomo, IDAES, DWSIM, CasADi, or OpenFOAM.
* Familiarity with commercial process simulation software such as Aspen Plus, Aspen HYSYS, or gPROMS, including reproducing workflows using open-source tools.
* Experience with process optimization, reactor modeling, separation systems, process control, or electrochemical simulations.
* Familiarity with Docker, Git, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing.
* Experience developing or evaluating AI coding agents, terminal-based agents, or LLM-generated engineering solutions.
* Industry experience in petrochemicals, pharmaceuticals, energy, specialty chemicals, or chemical process manufacturing.
* Prior experience in AI training, technical quality control, benchmark development, or evaluation programs.

**Offer Details:**

* **Commitments Required:**
  At least 4 hours per day and minimum 40 hours per week with overlap of 4 hours with PST.
* **Employment type :**
  Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave)
* **Duration of contract :**
  4 week [expected start date is next week]

**Note**

Candidates must have a relevant background in Motion Control Systems, Servo Drives, Servo Motors, and VFDs. Candidates without experience in these areas are requested not to apply, as non-relevant profiles will not be considered.
  
  

* Experience:\*\* 5–8 Years
