* Domain:\*\* Industrial Automation & Engineering Services
* Travel:\*\* Up to 80% across India
* Notice Period:\*\* Immediate to 30 days preferred
* Interview Process:\*\* 3 rounds – 1 virtual and 2 face-to-face
* Interview Date:\*\* 17 October

### Job Summary
  
  
We are looking for an experienced Application Engineer specializing in Motion Control and Industrial Automation. The role involves designing and implementing machine automation solutions, developing and integrating control systems, troubleshooting technical issues, and supporting commissioning activities at customer sites.
  
  
The ideal candidate will have hands-on expertise in servo drives, servo motors, VFDs, PLCs, motion controllers, and industrial automation systems, along with strong customer interaction and technical problem-solving skills.
  
  
### Key Responsibilities
  
  
\*\*1. Automation Solution Design\*\*
  
  

* Design machine automation solutions using servo drives, motion controllers, PLCs, and industrial communication networks.
* Develop motion control concepts based on customer and OEM requirements.
* Evaluate technical feasibility and recommend suitable automation architectures.
* Define control topologies, communication protocols, and system integration strategies.

\*\*2. Application Engineering & Customer Engagement\*\*
  
  

* Interact with OEMs, customers, and sales teams to understand technical requirements.
* Conduct technical discussions, application reviews, and solution presentations.
* Prepare technical proposals and recommend suitable automation solutions.
* Provide technical support throughout solution development and customer evaluation.

\*\*3. Software Development & System Integration\*\*
  
  

* Develop, test, and validate application software for machine control systems.
* Integrate PLCs, HMIs, motion controllers, servo drives, and industrial communication systems.
* Optimize machine performance, functionality, and reliability.

\*\*4. Commissioning & Troubleshooting\*\*
  
  

* Support prototype development, system testing, commissioning, and machine startup.
* Perform hardware diagnostics, technical troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis.

Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don't happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
**Job Summary**
The Analyst, TSG Product Management, is assigned to one or a few products. The Analyst is responsible for responding to user inquiries and troubleshooting issues, performing routine updates, and validating changes through testing. This role gathers product insights by tracking key metrics, monitoring usage and adoption, and collecting user feedback through periodic surveys. The Analyst also scopes and drives smaller enhancement requests — translating business needs into clear requirements — while communicating effectively with business users, technical teams, and other stakeholders to ensure their needs are fulfilled.
  
  
**Principal Accountabilities and % of time**
**Product Maintenance & Analytics (50%)**

* Supports existing enterprise analytics products (e.g., Power BI and Tableau) by responding to user inquiries and troubleshooting issues, investigating root cause and escalating to technical teams or platform specialists when required

* Strong user support and troubleshooting skills; ability to respond to user inquiries, investigate issues, identify root causes, resolve where appropriate, and escalate effectively to technical teams or platform specialists
* Working knowledge of business intelligence and analytics concepts (e.g., dashboards/reporting, data access, user permissions, tool platform concepts, adoption, and common end-user workflows); familiarity with tools such as Power BI or Tableau; experience consuming data from Databricks or an enterprise data platform preferred
* Strong work management and organizational skills; ability to work from a backlog, coordinate multiple workstreams, track actions and dependencies, prioritize work, and communicate dependencies and tradeoff implications
* Ability to translate business needs into actionable requirements, including soliciting use cases, stakeholder requirements, and platform pain points
* Strong stakeholder communication skills; ability to work effectively with business users, technical teams, platform administrators, vendors, and product leadership
* Strong written communication and documentation skills, including product documentation, status updates, process materials, user guidance, and executive-ready summaries
* Curiosity and willingness to learn emerging analytics technologies; ability to quickly learn new tools and evaluate capabilities; experience incorporating AI tools into day-to-day operations preferred

**Experience**

* Experience supporting technology products, analytics platforms, or business systems, ideally in a product management, product operations, business analyst, or similar role. Experience with business intelligence tools (Power BI, Tableau) and enterprise data platforms is preferred
* Experience with product maintenance and testing, including supporting routine updates and enhancements, validating functionality through testing, and assessing whether changes continue to meet user needs

title: Mechanical & Aerospace Engineering
description:
**About Turing:**

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies, accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.

**Role Overview:**

* We are seeking an experienced Mechanical or Aerospace Engineering expert to lead a team of technical trainers developing realistic, terminal-based engineering tasks for a frontier AI training and evaluation initiative.

* In this role, you will oversee a pod of approximately 5–10 trainers, review engineering tasks for technical accuracy, reproducibility, and evaluation quality, and ensure that tasks reflect authentic mechanical and aerospace engineering workflows. You will also mentor trainers, maintain quality standards, and drive consistent task delivery.

**What you'll do:**

* Lead and mentor a pod of technical trainers, ensuring consistent quality, productivity, and timely delivery of engineering tasks.
* Review engineering tasks end to end, including problem statements, geometry and mesh files, simulation inputs, material properties, reference solutions, and automated tests.
* Validate tasks involving finite-element analysis (FEA), computational fluid dynamics (CFD), thermodynamics, heat transfer, dynamics, robotics, flight simulation, propulsion, and orbital mechanics.
* Ensure tasks reflect realistic mechanical and aerospace engineering workflows and require meaningful multi-step technical reasoning.
* Verify engineering correctness across units, equilibrium, conservation laws, boundary conditions, mesh convergence, solver tolerances, reference frames, and numerical stability.
* Validate computational environments, simulation tools, solvers, and dependencies to ensure reproducible results.
* Review automated graders to ensure they evaluate meaningful engineering outputs such as stresses, deflections, natural frequencies, aerodynamic coefficients, thermal performance, orbital parameters, and safety margins.
* Identify technical inaccuracies, unrealistic assumptions, incorrect tolerances, and opportunities to bypass engineering calculations or simulations.
* Provide clear, actionable technical feedback, track revisions, and ensure quality issues are resolved before task approval.
* Onboard trainers, allocate work, monitor quality and throughput, escalate blockers, and maintain technical documentation and best practices.

**What we're looking for:**

* Ph.D., postdoctoral experience, or equivalent advanced technical experience in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a closely related discipline.
* Strong programming skills in Python, C/C++, Fortran, Julia, or MATLAB/Octave, with proficiency in Linux environments.
* Hands-on expertise in at least one major area: FEA, CFD, dynamics, flight simulation, thermal modeling, astrodynamics, guidance, navigation and control (GNC), or propulsion modeling.
* Strong understanding of engineering simulation, numerical methods, computational modeling, and technical validation.
* Experience reviewing complex technical work, engineering simulations, computational models, or research outputs.
* Ability to evaluate engineering assumptions, numerical accuracy, solver convergence, and the reliability of computational results.
* Strong analytical judgment with the ability to identify technical errors, edge cases, and flawed engineering assumptions.
* Experience mentoring, reviewing, or leading small technical teams.
* Excellent written communication skills for providing precise technical feedback and documenting quality standards.

**Nice to have:**

* Experience with engineering simulation and computational tools such as OpenFOAM, SU2, CalculiX, Code\_Aster, FEniCS, Elmer, Gmsh, FreeCAD, CadQuery, MuJoCo, ROS, XFOIL, AVL, OpenVSP, JSBSim, OpenMDAO, pyCycle, poliastro, Orekit, GMAT, or SPICE.
* Familiarity with commercial engineering software such as ANSYS, Abaqus, COMSOL, or NASTRAN, including reproducing workflows using open-source tools.
* Experience with state estimation, trajectory optimization, topology optimization, aeroelastic analysis, or multidisciplinary design optimization.
* Familiarity with Docker, Git, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing.
* Experience developing or evaluating AI coding agents, terminal-based agents, or LLM-generated engineering solutions.
* Industry or agency experience in automotive, energy, manufacturing, robotics, aircraft, launch vehicles, satellites, or UAVs.
* Prior experience in AI training, technical quality control, benchmark development, or evaluation programs.

  At least 4 hours per day and minimum 40 hours per week with overlap of 4 hours with PST.

title: Project Lead (Assessments) – RMEAL
description:
**About The Job Project Lead (Assessments) - RMEAL**
**Position**
:
**Project Lead, Student Learning Assessments**
**Location**
:
**Delhi**
**Experience needed:**
**8+ years**
**Previous Experience in-**
**Educational Measurement & Assessments / Foundational Learning Assessments/ Large-scale assessment programs**
**Central Square Foundation**
Founded in 2012, Central Square Foundation is a non-profit philanthropic foundation working with the vision of ensuring quality school education for all children in India. We are driven by our mission to transform the school education system with a focus on improving the learning outcomes of children, especially from low-income communities.
  
  
We believe that effective foundational learning is essential for better learning outcomes of all children in school. Development of foundational literacy and numeracy skills between pre-primary and Class 3 can help children progress to higher levels of learning which is an essential building block for creating equal access to opportunities needed for leading a better life. In this regard, a majority of CSF’s efforts are directed towards improving the foundational learning levels in the country.
  
  
To achieve this, we partner with individuals and social impact organizations to bring innovative solutions in education, as well as work with the government to drive systemic impact. We also collaborate with the ecosystem to leverage knowledge and create proven tools around critical issues such as early learning, technology in education, classroom instruction methods and governance.
  
  
CSF’s team members bring a deep sense of commitment and passion towards our collective vision that every child deserves a quality education. We strive for excellence in everything we do and collaborate to create an impact as we move closer to achieving our mission. We encourage an entrepreneurial outlook that evokes new and bold ideas along with taking smart risks. CSF provides a dynamic, learning, and positive environment that is driven by our strong sense of values.
  
  
**Position Summary -**
CSF is seeking a dedicated Project Lead to join our dynamic Research, Monitoring, Evaluation, Assessment, and Learning (RMEAL) team. This pivotal role is at the heart of CSF's mission to improve student learning outcomes across our portfolio states. As part of the RMEAL team, the Project Lead will offer both technical and strategic expertise in the evaluation and assessment of student learning, focusing on foundational skills in Literacy and Numeracy. The role involves a collaborative approach to supporting states with tools and methodologies for designing and implementing student assessments within Foundational Literacy and Numeracy (FLN) programs and beyond. These programs range from large-scale, system-level assessments to more localized, school-based evaluations.
  
  
The Project Lead will play a crucial role in advancing central and state-level initiatives, offering measurement and assessment-related technical support. This encompasses the development, implementation, and analysis of various assessments and evaluations aimed at understanding and improving student learning outcomes. Based in CSF’s Delhi office, this position offers the unique opportunity to work closely with the Director of RMEAL and contribute significantly to shaping the future of student assessments in the country.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities Include, But Are Not Limited To**

* Strategic Implementation: Collaborate closely with central and state teams to strategize and execute student learning assessments, ensuring they are aligned with learning goals and standards.
* Assessment Quality and Rigor: Oversee the quality and rigor of all aspects of assessments, from item creation to methodology. This includes conducting thorough quality checks, reviewing items meticulously, and finalizing assessment tools to meet the highest standards of excellence.
* Capacity Building: Lead the creation of comprehensive training materials and organize dissemination workshops. These workshops, aimed at educators and administrators at the State/UT/district levels, are crucial for the effective post-assessment application of insights gained.
* Knowledge Leadership: Develop and contribute to key knowledge products, including position papers, approach notes, and concept notes. These documents will serve as foundational resources in the field of student assessments and monitoring, guiding future initiatives and strategies.

**Educational And Professional Background**

* A PhD./Master’s degree or equivalent, with a focus on Education, Student Assessment & Measurement, or Data Analysis. This specialization is crucial for a deep understanding of the theoretical and practical aspects of student assessments.
* A minimum of 8 years of professional experience in the field of large-scale assessment programs, preferably with States or with the central agencies such as NCERT, PARAKH.
* Ideal candidates will have a background working with governmental entities at the state or central level, showcasing a broad understanding of the educational landscape and technical assessment processes.

**Technical Expertise And Methodological Skills**

* Expertise in designing, and implementing high-quality assessments and analyzing data from assessments to evaluate student learning outcomes, particularly in foundational skills.
* Proficiency in quantitative and qualitative data analysis techniques to interpret assessment results and make data-driven recommendations for improving student learning outcomes.
* Understanding of assessment methods/ theories (including Classical Test Theory and Item Response Theory) and working knowledge of the software used for analyzing assessment data, and reporting findings. Knowledge of statistical analysis software (e.g., SPSS, R, Stata) is essential.
* Ability to communicate technical insights to non-technical audiences
* Skills in working collaboratively with a range of stakeholders, including government entities, educators, and research teams. Effective communication skills are essential for liaising between different groups and ensuring the successful implementation of assessments.
* Strong writing and conceptualization skills, as well as the ability to synthesize research and practice into actionable insights.

Given the role's focus on foundational literacy and numeracy within large-scale assessment programs, candidates should ideally have a strong grounding in educational theory, alongside practical experience in assessment design and implementation. The ability to lead and innovate in the field of educational assessments, while working closely with a range of stakeholders, is crucial for success in this role.
  
  
**Location:**
This role is based in CSF’s office in Delhi, with potential travel to support and oversee projects within our portfolio states.
  
  
**Reporting**
The Project Lead will report directly to the Director of Research, Monitoring, Evaluation, Assessment, and Learning (RMEAL) in Delhi.
  
  
**Compensation**
Remuneration will be competitive with Indian philanthropy pay scales and will depend upon the candidate’s experience level..

title: Project Associate – High Potential Students
description:
**Central Square Foundation**
About the job Project Associate - High Potential Students
  
  
Founded in 2012, Central Square Foundation (CSF) is a non-profit philanthropic organization working with the vision of ensuring quality school education for all children in India. We believe that effective foundational learning is essential for better learning outcomes for all children in school. The development of foundational literacy and numeracy skills by Class 3 can help children progress to higher levels of learning and is an essential building block in a child's life.
  
  
We are driven by our mission to enable the school education system to adopt solutions that are scalable, sustainable, and effective so that all children get equal access to opportunities needed for leading a better life.
  
  
Read more about our work here: www.centralsquarefoundation.org
  
  
**About High Potential Students Workstream At CSF**
India’s school education system serves ~25 crore children. Many of these students come from underserved communities and face systemic gaps in identification and support. With most interventions beginning only after Grade 10, much of this potential remains untapped and underdeveloped.
  
  
To bridge this gap, CSF introduced a new workstream in 2025, High Potential Students (HPS), to support India’s bright young minds from underprivileged backgrounds in becoming future innovators, researchers and leaders. By 2030, we aim to transform the learning journeys of 1 lakh students by equipping them with the skills, support and exposure needed to thrive in higher education and high-growth careers. Through this work, we are committed to advancing equity and excellence, empowering young minds from every corner of India to realise their full potential.
  
  
CSF is working with government model school systems to strengthen pathways for high-potential students (HPS) from underserved communities. The work focuses on designing and implementing initiatives within government model schools to support students’ academic, socio-emotional, and career development. Key areas include programme planning and implementation, partner and government coordination, field engagement, documentation, and evidence generation. The work also supports effective classroom practices, academic enrichment, structured advanced learning opportunities, career pathways, and overall student progression.
  
  
**Position Summary**
CSF is seeking a Project Associate to join the High Potential Students workstream in Delhi and support the planning and implementation of HPS programme. The Project Associate will be responsible for supporting assigned programme priorities, managing day-to-day implementation, maintaining trackers and documentation, supporting review and reporting processes, conducting field visits, analysing implementation data, and identifying risks that require course correction. The role requires strong project management skills, comfort with data, clear written communication, field orientation, and the ability to work in a dynamic and evolving environment.
  
  
**The Core Areas Of Contribution Are**
**Programme Implementation and Coordination**

* Support the execution of key programme priorities under the High Potential Students workstream, especially across model schools.
* Build and manage working relationships with diverse stakeholders, including regional government teams, school leaders, programme partners, educational nonprofits, vendors and internal CSF teams.
* Coordinate with implementation partners to monitor and review programs across EdTech, assessments, academic enrichment, and career pathways, ensuring effective progress tracking, timely identification of gaps, and appropriate follow-through on action items.
* Support stakeholder convenings, partner check-ins, review meetings and government updates by collating data, preparing materials, documenting discussions and tracking next steps.

**Project Management, Reviews and Reporting**

* Maintain programme trackers, timelines, meeting notes, action-item logs, data templates and other tools required for day-to-day monitoring and review.
* Manage timelines and deliverables for assigned workstreams to ensure that activities are on track and aligned with project objectives.
* Prepare clear written outputs, including field visit notes, meeting minutes, update emails, review notes, progress summaries, presentations, reports and internal briefing documents.
* Provide timely updates to internal teams and CSF leadership on implementation progress, key insights, risks, opportunities and areas for course correction.

**Data, Field Insights and Documentation**

* Support rigorous data cleaning, validation and analysis to identify trends, implementation gaps, inconsistencies and areas requiring follow-up or course correction, while also supporting the development and maintenance of dashboards, trackers and other data platforms for programme monitoring and review.
* Conduct targeted field visits to schools and institutions to gather operational and academic insights, understand implementation realities and document observations.
* Document key learnings, field insights, implementation challenges and emerging practices to inform reviews, reporting, programme improvement and future scale-up.

**Problem Solving and Agile Support**

* Identify, assess and escalate implementation risks and bottlenecks in partner delivery, school-level execution, data availability or communication, while supporting proactive issue resolution.

* Written and oral communication

description:
**About Air India SATS Airport Services Private Limited**
:

AISATS, a leading gateway services provider in India, is a 50-50 joint venture between Air India Limited (a part of the TATA Group) and SATS Ltd., one of the world’s largest providers of air cargo handling services and Asia’s leading airline caterer. ‘AISATS’ is defined by its people – they are our greatest strength. Their commitment to seamless delivery and customer delight is what enables us to fulfil our brand promise of service excellence. This has been the hallmark of our business for more than a decade. With deep domain knowledge of the aviation ecosystem, we offer end-to-end ground handling services such as passenger and baggage handling, ramp handling, aircraft interior cleaning, load control and flight operations, and cargo handling services for general, perishable, transshipment, express courier and special cargo.

**Job Title**
: Technical Officer SMS

**Location**
: Gurgaon

**Department**
: Safety & Quality

**Role Overview**
:

The SMS Technical Officer is responsible for supporting the implementation, administration, monitoring, and continual improvement of the organization's Safety Management System (SMS) within a DGCA CAR-145 approved Maintenance Organization. The role focuses on hazard identification, risk assessment, occurrence reporting, safety investigations, safety performance monitoring, and promotion of a positive safety culture across the organization.

The incumbent will work closely with maintenance personnel, quality teams, and operational departments to ensure effective integration of safety management principles into daily maintenance activities.

**Key Responsibilities**
:

1. **Safety Management System Administration**

* Support the implementation and maintenance of the organization's Safety Management System (SMS).
* Ensure compliance with DGCA requirements relating to Safety Management Systems.
* Assist in the development, review, and revision of SMS manuals, procedures, and processes.
* Monitor SMS effectiveness and recommend improvements.

1. **Hazard Identification & Risk Management**

* Facilitate proactive hazard identification across maintenance operations.
* Conduct risk assessments using approved risk management methodologies.
* Maintain the Hazard Register and Risk Register.
* Monitor implementation and effectiveness of risk mitigation measures.
* Identify emerging safety risks and escalate significant concerns to management.

1. **Safety Occurrence Reporting**

* Manage safety reporting systems and encourage confidential reporting.
* Review and analyze safety reports, incidents, errors, and near-miss events.
* Ensure proper recording, classification, and tracking of occurrences.
* Coordinate investigations and support root cause analysis activities.

1. **Safety Investigations**

* Participate in investigations involving maintenance errors, quality escapes, incidents, and safety occurrences.
* Apply root cause analysis techniques to determine systemic causes.
* Develop and monitor corrective and preventive actions.
* Verify effectiveness of implemented actions.

1. **Safety Performance Monitoring**

* Monitor Safety Performance Indicators (SPIs) and Safety Performance Targets (SPTs).
* Prepare trend analyses and safety performance reports.
* Identify recurring issues and recommend preventive measures.
* Support management reviews and Safety Review Board meetings.

1. **Safety Promotion & Training**

* Conduct safety awareness programs, briefings, and workshops.
* Support Human Factors and Safety Management training initiatives.
* Promote reporting culture and safety awareness throughout the organization.
* Develop safety communication materials including newsletters, alerts, and bulletins.

1. **Audit & Regulatory Support**

* Support DGCA audits, customer audits, and internal assessments related to SMS.
* Assist in the closure of safety-related findings and observations.
* Coordinate safety documentation and compliance records.
* Ensure documentation is maintained and readily available for inspections.

**Qualifications:**

**Essential**

* AME Diploma/Bachelor's Degree in Aeronautical, Aerospace, Mechanical Engineering, Aviation Management, Safety Management, or equivalent.

**Preferred**

* Safety Management System Certification.
* Human Factors Training Certification.
* Internal Auditor / Lead Auditor Certification.
* Aviation Safety Investigation Training.

**Knowledge Requirements**

Strong understanding of:

* DGCA Safety Management System requirements
* CAR-145 Quality and Safety requirements
* ICAO Annex 19 Safety Management Principles
* Hazard Identification and Risk Assessment
* Human Factors in Aircraft Maintenance
* Root Cause Analysis Techniques
* Safety Performance Monitoring
* Occurrence Reporting Systems
* Aircraft Maintenance Operations
* Quality and Compliance Systems

**Experience**
:

**Essential**

* Minimum 3-5 years of experience in one or more of the following:
* Aircraft Maintenance
* Quality Assurance
* Safety Management
* Continuing Airworthiness
* MRO Operations

**Preferred**

* Experience in a CAR-145 approved maintenance organization.
* Experience in SMS implementation and administration.
* Experience conducting safety investigations and risk assessments.
* Knowledge of EASA and ICAO safety management principles.

**Personal & Behavioural Characteristics:**

**Technical Competencies**

* Safety Risk Management
* Hazard Analysis
* Incident Investigation
* Root Cause Analysis
* Safety Data Analysis
* Aviation Regulations
* Human Factors
* Safety Performance Monitoring

**Behavioural Competencies**

* Analytical Thinking
* Attention to Detail
* Effective Communication
* Integrity and Professional Ethics
* Problem Solving
* Team Collaboration
* Decision Making
* Influencing and Safety Leadership

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

* AME or Aviation Professional with hands-on MRO experience.
* Strong knowledge of aircraft maintenance processes and aviation safety systems.
* Experience in safety investigations, human factors, and risk management.
* Familiarity with DGCA CAR-145, SMS requirements, and aviation compliance audits.
* Proficient in safety reporting software, data analysis, and technical report writing.

title: GIS Subject Matter Expert
description:
**Company Description**
**About Ramboll**
Founded in Denmark, Ramboll is a foundation-owned people company. We have more than 18,000 experts working across our global operations in 35 countries. Our experts are leaders in their fields, developing and delivering innovative solutions in diverse markets including Buildings, Transport, Planning & Urban Design, Water, Environment & Health, Energy, and Management Consulting. We invite you to contribute to a more sustainable future working in an open, collaborative, and empowering company. Combining local experience with global knowledge, we together shape the societies of tomorrow.
  
  
**Ramboll in India**
Ramboll has more than 1,000 experts working across five offices in India applying their passion to deliver innovative solutions in markets as diverse as Buildings, Transport, Planning & Urban Design, Water, Environment & Health and Energy. Founded in Denmark, Ramboll is a people company. We invite you to contribute to a sustainable future working in an open, collaborative and empowering culture.
  
  
**Job Description**
We are seeking an experienced
**GIS Subject Matter Expert (SME)**
with 7+ years of professional experience to support Environmental, Social, Health & Safety (ESHS), Sustainability, ESG, and Impact Assessment projects across infrastructure, renewable energy, industrial, urban development, transportation, water, and manufacturing sectors. The role will focus on geospatial analysis, map development, web GIS applications, spatial databases, and GIS-based decision support for environmental and social assessments. GIS capabilities are an integral part of Ramboll's impact assessment, environmental review, site evaluation, due diligence, and sustainability services.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop high-quality GIS maps, figures, dashboards, StoryMaps, and spatial products using ArcGIS Pro and ArcGIS Online in accordance with Ramboll cartographic and quality standards.
* Conduct spatial analyses including environmental constraints mapping, land-use assessment, accessibility studies, socio-economic profiling, cumulative impact assessment, climate risk screening, and site suitability analysis.
* Integrate environmental, social, infrastructure, demographic, regulatory, and satellite datasets to support project planning and decision-making.
* Support project teams in site selection, alternatives assessment, permitting, due diligence, stakeholder engagement, and impact assessment studies.
* Develop and maintain web GIS applications, ArcGIS Online solutions, dashboards, and interactive mapping tools.
* Manage geospatial datasets, metadata, quality assurance, and GIS standards.
* Support biodiversity screening, critical habitat assessments, social baseline studies, climate risk assessments, and ESG due diligence through geospatial analysis.
* Prepare maps and geospatial deliverables for technical reports, client presentations, lender reviews, and regulatory submissions.
* Collaborate with environmental, social, biodiversity, health & safety, climate, and sustainability specialists in multidisciplinary projects.
* Contribute to proposal preparation, methodology development, innovation initiatives, and business development activities.
* Mentor junior GIS analysts and support the development of GIS best practices and workflows.
* Ensure all GIS deliverables adhere to organisational GIS standards, data governance requirements, cartographic guidelines, metadata standards, and quality assurance processes. Promote consistent use of approved ArcGIS workflows, templates, symbology standards, and enterprise geospatial services across projects.
* Support the development and maintenance of the organisation's enterprise geospatial ecosystem, including ArcGIS Online content, shared data services, map templates, and reusable GIS workflows.
* Review GIS outputs produced by other team members to ensure compliance with organizational standards, project requirements, and client expectations.
* Act as the geospatial subject matter expert for Environment & Health projects, providing technical guidance, mentoring, and best-practice recommendations to project teams and junior GIS professionals.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in GIS, Geography, Geoinformatics, Remote Sensing, Environmental Science, Urban Planning, Geology, or related discipline.
* 7–10 years of relevant GIS and geospatial analysis experience.
* Strong proficiency in ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Online, Enterprise GIS, Web GIS, spatial databases, and geospatial data management. Experience with other GIS platforms is beneficial; however, GIS production workflows, map authoring, cartography, and client deliverables should be developed using the organisations standard ArcGIS platform.
* Experience in environmental and social impact assessments, sustainability, infrastructure planning, renewable energy, or related sectors.
* Experience working with satellite imagery, remote sensing data, and geospatial modelling techniques.
* Working knowledge of international standards such as IFC Performance Standards, World Bank EHS Guidelines, Equator Principles, ESG frameworks, and sustainability reporting requirements is desirable.
* Strong analytical, visualization, communication, and problem-solving skills.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with Python, ArcPy, SQL, Power BI, FME, or GIS automation tools.
* Experience developing GIS dashboards, enterprise GIS solutions, and decision-support systems.
* Knowledge of biodiversity assessments, climate risk mapping, ESG due diligence, environmental permitting, and sustainability reporting.
* Experience supporting renewable energy, transportation, industrial, mining, water, urban development, or infrastructure projects.

**Key Competencies**

* GIS & Geospatial Analytics
* Environmental & Social Constraints Assessment
* Impact Assessment Mapping
* Site Suitability Analysis
* Spatial Data Management
* Web GIS & Dashboard Development
* Remote Sensing & Spatial Modelling
* Climate Risk & Sustainability Analytics
* Technical Report Preparation
* Stakeholder-Focused Data Visualization
* Multidisciplinary Collaboration
* Quality Assurance & Data Governance

**Additional Information**

* Investment in your development
* Leaders you can count on, guided by our Leadership Principles
* Be valued for the unique person you are
* Never be short of inspiration from colleagues, clients, and projects
* The long-term thinking of a foundation-owned company

Ramboll is a global architecture, engineering, and consultancy company. We believe that the purpose of sustainable change is to create a thriving world for both nature and people. So, that’s where we start – and how we work. At Ramboll, our core strength is our people, and our history is rooted in a clear vision of how a responsible company should act. Being open and curious is a cornerstone of our culture. We embrace an inclusive mindset that looks for fresh, diverse, and innovative perspectives. We respect, embrace, and invite diversity in all forms to actively cultivate an environment where everyone can flourish and realise their full potential.

**About Us**
We’re proud to have been helping our clients build better financial futures for over 50 years. How have we achieved this? By working together - and supporting each other - all over the world. So, join our team and feel like you’re part of something bigger.
  
  
**About Your Team**
The Technology Controls and Assurance (TCA) team is part of the Global Cyber & Information Security (GCIS) group, reporting to the Head of Global Information Security which is a centralized global team with responsibility for supporting assurance activities across Technology and Enterprise services function, working closely with our internal and external auditors in delivering business value from Technology and Digital (T&D) Department in a consistent and transparent way. The scope of the TCA team covers support to T&D in managing their Technology and Information Security risks; Facilitation of External Audit and Certifications to Industry Standards (such as ISO, PCI DSS SWIFT and ITGC (including monitoring, testing and internal control testing/ verifications to ensure controls throughout T&D are working effectively).
  
  
**About Your Role**
As a Technology Specilaist, you will collaborate closely with the Technology and Digital teams to support the organization’s compliance with various standards and certifications, including ISAE 3402/SOC 2, ISO 42001. Your responsibilities will include coordinating audit programs with internal stakeholders and external auditors, managing the certification lifecycle to ensure timely renewals and ongoing compliance, and spearheading continuous improvement initiatives.
  
  
You will define and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and key risk indicators (KRIs), maintaining an effective control library aligned with organizational policies and regulatory requirements. Additionally, you will lead efforts to automate control testing and evidence collection, thereby increasing the efficiency and accuracy of compliance reporting. Collaborating with both technology and business teams, you will help implement effective controls and act as a key point of contact during audit processes.
  
  
With expertise in IT General Controls, you will identify opportunities for process simplification and automation, driving ongoing enhancements. You will also serve as a trusted advisor on AI governance, ensuring alignment with ISO 42001 standards and ethical AI principles.
  
  
This role involves complex challenges and requires strong data analysis skills, including proficiency in advanced Excel functions and data visualization tools, to define KPIs and KRIs, report on control effectiveness, and analyze non-compliance issues for corrective actions. The ideal candidate is a strategic thinker with the ability to resolve system issues and propose innovative solutions. Furthermore, you should be a collaborative team player capable of liaising effectively with geographically dispersed Technology teams.
  
  
**Your Key Accountabilities**

* Data analysis and data modelling capabilities in order, to define KPI’s and KRI’s for key controls indicators.
* Automated Control Testing for Key controls against FIL Policies to report on control effectiveness.
* Preventive, Detective and Corrective Control Measures to mitigate the operational and functional risk.
* Support in ITGC control testing and facilitation.
* Perform Management Review on Key controls on quarterly and bi-annually basis.
* Understanding on ISAE 3402/SOC 2, ISO 27001 Controls and it’s testing approach.
* Provide subject matter expertise and support for IT General Controls (ITGC) and management control testing, ensuring alignment with certification requirements.
* Collaborate with technology and business teams to ensure effective implementation of preventive, detective, and corrective controls. Act as a liaison between internal stakeholders and external auditors to facilitate successful audits and assessments.
* Act as a trusted advisor to business, technology, and non-technology teams on AI governance and assurance practices, aligned with ISO 42001 and FIL’s ethical AI principles.
* Coordination with various internal stakeholders, as well as the external auditors for successful audit programm.

**Your Skills And Experience**

* Graduate from reputed institute with 7+ years of experience and progressive working knowledge of ITGC/SOC 2 Audits, Governance, Risk and Compliance domain and associated technologies
* Strong understanding of Information Security control frameworks and standards like, AI 42001, ISO 27001, NIST and CoBIT etc.
* Ability to multi-task and prioritise workload.
* Able to drive the internal control assessment and testing with pro-active reporting and escalation to fix the non-compliances on timely manner.
* Commitment to high standards of excellence and integrity.
* Excellent verbal and written communicator, who can consistently deliver high quality work and engage and influence key stakeholders at all levels

* Drive operational excellence
* Improve productivity through automation

Reporting to the Director, Services BD Insights & Enablement, the Analyst will play a key role in supporting the implementation and ongoing evolution of the Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) platform for the Services organization.
  
  
This is a hands-on, execution-focused role that sits at the intersection of sales enablement, product management (internally facing), and process transformation.

* Support the design, preparation, and optimization of Services contracting workflows within the CLM platform
* Assist in translating business requirements into structured workflows, rules, and templates within CLM
* Work closely with stakeholders (Legal, Sales, Operations) to map and migrate contractual constructs into systemized processes
* Participate in testing of new CLM features, including identifying issues, validating outputs, and supporting remediation efforts
* Leverage tools such as Ironclad, Salesforce, Signavio, CPQ, and other enablement platforms to enhance execution and efficiency

* Ability to work effectively in cross-functional, global teams
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to listen, align, and influence
* Structured problem-solver with attention to detail and a bias for execution
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Comfortable working with ambiguity and evolving requirements
* Proficiency in leveraging AI tools to enhance productivity, enable effective multitasking, and operate at a high pace in a demanding environment

title: Content Writer (B2B)
description:
**About The Role**
We are looking for a Content Writer who can take existing content (blogs, case studies, reports) and turn it into high-performing short-form content, while owning brand presence across social platforms and community forums like Reddit and Quora. This role sits at the intersection of content repurposing, brand/community management, and distribution. You are comfortable taking a long-form piece and turning it into a Reddit discussion thread, a Quora answer, a LinkedIn carousel, or any other channel-native format - and getting it in front of the right audience on the right channel. You'll need strong short-form writing skills, a working understanding of SEO as it applies to distribution, and genuine familiarity with how different social and community platforms (and their algorithms) actually work. This is an ideal role for someone early in their career who wants to own content repurposing, brand, and distribution end-to-end - rather than sitting in only one part of the funnel.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Content Writing & Creation:**

* Research and write high-quality content across formats, including blogs, articles, social media posts, Reddit and Quora content, and other short-form content marketing assets.
* Develop content ideas based on audience needs, industry trends, customer pain points, and business objectives.
* Write clear, engaging, and audience-focused content while maintaining Contify's brand voice and tone.
* Work with subject matter experts and internal teams to understand complex topics and translate them into accessible, useful content.
* Edit and proofread content for clarity, accuracy, grammar, consistency, and tone.

**Content Repurposing & Distribution**

* Repurpose long-form content (blogs, case studies, reports) into short-form, channel-native formats - social posts, carousels, discussion threads, forum answers, and more.
* Build and execute a distribution plan that takes one core piece of content and multiplies its reach across different channels.

**Brand & Community Management**

* Own Contify's presence on community forums like Reddit and Quora - identifying relevant conversations, publishing repurposed content, and answering questions in a way that builds brand credibility.
* Maintain a consistent brand voice and tone across all community and social touchpoints.

**Social Media Management**

* Manage posting and publishing across social platforms (LinkedIn, X, Reddit, Quora, and others), from content design to research to scheduling and publishing.
* Maintain a working knowledge of platform-specific best practices and algorithm behavior to maximize reach and engagement.
* Coordinate with design resources (or create using tools like Canva) to ensure content is visually optimized for each platform.

**Performance & Optimization**

* Track content and distribution performance across channels, and use those insights to refine what gets repurposed, where it gets published, and how it's framed.

**Qualifications**

* 1-2 years of experience in content writing, social media, preferably within B2B SaaS or a similar enterprise domain.
* Strong short-form writing and editing skills, with the ability to adapt tone and format for different platforms and audiences.
* Working knowledge of SEO principles as they apply to distribution and discoverability - keyword usage, search intent.
* Hands-on experience or strong familiarity with managing social media platforms (LinkedIn, X, Reddit, Quora) - including a practical understanding of how each platform's algorithm and community norms work.
* Experience or strong aptitude for content repurposing - turning one long-form asset into multiple channel-specific formats.
* Basic design sense and comfort with tools like Canva for creating platform-optimized visuals.
* Ability to work independently across the repurposing-to-distribution lifecycle: research, short-form writing, publishing, and reporting.

**Tools & Technical Skills**

* SEO Basics: Google Search Console, keyword research fundamentals
* Writing & Editing: Google Docs, Grammarly
* CMS & Publishing: WordPress
* Social & Community Platforms: LinkedIn, X, Reddit, Quora
* Design & Visual Content: Canva
* Analytics & Performance Tracking: Google Analytics, Looker Studio
* AI Tools (Content & Research): ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini
* Collaboration & Workflow Management: Jira, Slack, Notion

**Our Culture And Values**
At Contify, we are a people-first organization where emotional intelligence is as critical as strategic expertise. We are looking for a collaborative leader who thrives in a team-centric environment and is deeply committed to our collective mission of delivering exceptional user value. You prioritize the team's success and actively support your colleagues in achieving shared milestones. Beyond individual performance, you have a natural drive to elevate those around you, fostering a culture of continuous improvement, mentorship, and mutual growth.

TTC’s Legal Business Services team helps clients with operating model evaluation, roadmap development for a desired future state, data management solutions, automation opportunities, contract lifecycle management, legal entity management, and legal operating models. Learn more about Deloitte Legal Business Services.
  
  
**Qualifications**

- 4+ years of experience in CLM system configuration, application management, system support, or technology consulting, with a focus on CLM or related platforms (e.g., Icertis, Conga, DocuSign CLM, Agiloft, etc.).

title: Training Specialist II, OPTIMA
description:

OPTIMA is a global team and enables Amazon to deliver a superior shopping experience to customers worldwide. We aspire to provide an end-to-end data solution for the LLM lifecycle, leveraging technology alongside our operational excellence. We enable shopping feature teams deliver superior CX quality by providing them reliable and comprehensive insights and ground truth data to measure and train ML (Machine Learning) models and handle annotation and Root Cause Analysis (RCA) across 10 different languages.
  
  
The Training Specialist II is a high-ownership individual contributor within Optima’s Training & Development organization, responsible for designing, executing, and continuously improving training programs that drive measurable business outcomes across 2 assigned programs. This role operates at the intersection of operational excellence and data-driven decision making — requiring the ability to independently translate business challenges into structured training solutions that deliver measurable impact within assigned programs.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a confident and credible partner to senior stakeholders, a detail-oriented operator who builds for quality and consistency, and a performance-focused professional who holds themselves and their programs to high standards. Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Design and implement end-to-end training programs for 2 processes — including new hire onboarding, cross-training, upskilling, and refresher programs — that target measurable improvements in quality, throughput, and DA readiness
* Own the full training lifecycle for assigned programs: SOP review, training plan creation, session delivery, OJT, CCS, and production sign-off
* Lead UATs and pilot annotation requests independently, partnering with Account Managers to ensure training readiness ahead of program launches
* Proactively identify and clear training blockers — escalating risks to leadership with clear recommendations rather than problems alone
* Define and document launch readiness criteria, ensuring all dependencies are cleared before training begins
* Partner with PMs, Account Managers and Ops leaders to define ramp plans, success metrics, and go/no-go checkpoints
* Own the tracking, standardization, and reporting of all training metrics — including learner satisfaction, post-training quality, ramp-to-production timelines, and assessment performance
* Deep dive into training process data to identify root causes of quality shortfalls and design targeted interventions; track improvement outcomes against baseline
* Own all status communications for assigned programs, including flashes, fortnightly stakeholder updates, and leadership emails — ensuring timely, accurate, and audience-appropriate messaging
* Present training outcomes, risks, and recommendations at WBRs and MBRs with confidence and data-backed narratives
* Identify opportunities to automate, scale, or innovate training delivery

**Basic Qualifications**

* Experience focused on Adult Learning Theory, including 1) virtual training facilitation and dealing with remote teams, and 2) delivering Soft Skills, Technology Skills and/or Technical or other Systems training
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 2+ years of equivalent experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in project management

title: Senior Technical Writer
description:
The MongoDB Documentation team is a group of writers and engineers who develop and maintain the documentation for the MongoDB product family. Our goal is to help our readers, both humans and AI, successfully use MongoDB products by providing outstanding documentation. The MongoDB Documentation team is a part of the MongoDB Core Product organization and is tightly integrated with the engineering teams responsible for each product.
  
  
The Docs team is responsible for documenting all aspects of the MongoDB data platform including the database, query language, Atlas, Vector Search, VoyageAI models, Full-Text Search, Stream Processing, client libraries, administrative tools, connectors, and more.
  
  
Your AI-forward mindset coupled with strong writing and technical skills will create clear reference docs and tutorials on high-complexity features. Your work, along with the other two MongoDB Docs teams, support AI agents, answer engines, and a large global community of new and experienced MongoDB users.
  
  
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurgaon, Bengaluru or Mumbai for our hybrid working model.
  
  
Candidate Profile:
  
  
Candidates must have experience in a technical writing, technical communications, developer relations, or similar role in the software industry. Beyond industry experience, we are looking for someone who:
  
  

* Has experience writing technical documentation from scratch in English
* Possesses strong critical reading and writing skills
* Has hands-on experience using AI tools to accelerate documentation work
* Leverages sound editorial judgment to evaluate AI-generated content against source material for technical accuracy
* Has experience with cloud and database technologies
* Is able to read code for technical examples in at least one programming language (e.g., C++, C#, Java, Python, JavaScript)
* Has experience testing and validating documentable features and concepts

Position Expectations:
  
  

* Advocate for users in everything you write
* Work with technical and non-technical teams to meet the documentation needs of our users
* Research complex product features and validate with diligent testing
* Produce technically accurate and well-written documentation
* Contribute feedback to the team through copy review and planning discussions

Success Measures:
  
  
In 3 months:
  
  

* You'll be comfortable with our toolchain, AI tooling, and writing workflow
* You can implement small to medium complexity documentation requests
* You're getting to know our server engineers and are getting comfortable with participating in intra and inter team discussions
* You've completed the required technical training and courses required for MongoDB Engineering

In 6 months:
  
  

* You are getting comfortable doing deep dives into database architecture and technology as part of feature documentation
* You've got a working knowledge of the MongoDB data platform and know who to follow up with when you need to learn more
* You've adapted to our style of writing and your work demonstrates technical writing best practices
* You begin reviewing the work of your peers and learning from it
* You and your manager have discussed your career trajectory and growth opportunities
* You've helped the team improve and establish effective, well-vetted AI-assisted workflows for drafting and review

In 12 months:
  
  

* You're creating consistently high quality documentation for entire feature sets, complex tutorials, and high level concepts
* You know how much work you can manage and are contributing at a healthy pace
* You provide quality copy and technical reviews for your team members
* You provide best practices and coaching on AI-assisted workflows for your team members

**About MongoDB**
MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
  
  
With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
  
  
Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.
  
  
To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. title: Product Analyst Intern
description:
**About the Role**

We are rebuilding a large enterprise operations platform. The Product Analyst Intern will work closely with the Product Manager across documentation, requirement analysis and internal research through the specification and validation phase.

The work is mostly about understanding how a complex process works, writing it down clearly, and spotting where the existing documentation is incomplete or contradicts itself. Good fit for someone who reads carefully, writes cleanly and likes getting to the bottom of how something actually works.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Documentation**

• Draft and maintain product documentation — process flows, requirement breakdowns, configuration guides, release and change notes

• Convert workshop discussions and stakeholder inputs into structured written requirements

• Keep the document set current and version-controlled as decisions change

**Requirement analysis**

• Review business requirement documents for gaps, contradictions and outdated references; maintain an open-items register with proposed resolutions

• Map existing process rules and workflows and identify where they diverge from the documented standard

• Prepare test scenarios and validation checklists from existing specifications

**Internal research**

• Work with operations and client-facing teams to understand how the current process actually runs, and write up the findings

• Trace how specific cases and exceptions are handled today to surface undocumented behaviour
**Analysis**

• Work with operational datasets and configuration workbooks to reconcile inconsistencies and support requirement decisions with evidence

**Support to the Product Manager**

• Day-to-day BAU — meeting notes and action tracking, stakeholder follow-ups, status updates, query logs and quick turnaround asks

**Required skills**

• Strong written communication — able to explain a complex process simply and precisely

• Strong reading comprehension for long business documents

• Structured thinking and high attention to detail

• Working knowledge of Excel and comfort with documentation tools (Word, Confluence or similar) • Pursuing or recently completed a degree in engineering, business, economics, statistics or a related field

**Good to Have**

• Python (pandas) or SQL for basic data work

• Exposure to business process documentation, workflow tools or rule-based systems

• Familiarity with a high-volume operations or compliance environment

**What you will get**

• Direct exposure to how a large enterprise product is specified, validated and built

• Ownership of independent deliverables alongside hands-on support work

• Regular feedback and a portfolio of documentation and research work at the end

title: Computer Engineering Expert - AI Content Specialist
description:
* Location: Remote


**About The Job**
 At Alignerr, we partner with the world’s leading AI research teams and labs to build and train cutting\-edge AI models.
   

  

 You’ll challenge advanced language models on topics like computer architecture and hardware design, embedded systems and IoT, networking and distributed systems, hardware security, and systems software and operating systems—documenting every failure mode so we can harden model reasoning.
   

  

**Organization** 
 : Alignerr
 **Position** 
 : Computer Engineering Expert \- AI Content Specialist
 **Type** 
 : Hourly Contract
 **Compensation** 
 : $35–$60 /hour
 **Location** 
 : Remote
 **Commitment** 
 : 10–40 hours/week
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Develop Complex Problems: Design advanced computer engineering challenges across domains like RISC\-V/ARM architecture, FPGA development, memory management, and hardware\-software co\-design.
* Author Ground\-Truth Solutions: Create rigorous, step\-by\-step technical solutions, including assembly code, hardware description language (HDL) snippets, and architectural diagrams that serve as "golden responses" for AI training.
* Technical Auditing: Evaluate AI\-generated code (C/C\+\+, Verilog, VHDL), logic gate designs, and operating system kernels for technical accuracy, efficiency, and adherence to industry standards.
* Refine Reasoning: Identify logical fallacies in AI reasoning—such as race conditions, memory leaks, or improper timing constraints—and provide structured feedback to improve the model's "thinking" process.


**Requirements**
* Advanced Degree: Masters (pursuing or completed) or PhD in Computer Engineering, Computer Science with a hardware focus, or a closely related field.
* Domain Expertise: Strong foundational knowledge in core areas such as Computer Architecture, Embedded Systems, Digital Logic Design, or Operating Systems.
* Analytical Writing: The ability to communicate highly technical hardware concepts and low\-level software logic clearly and concisely in written form.
* Attention to Detail: High level of precision when checking bit\-level operations, clock\-cycle timing, and technical documentation.
* No AI experience required


**Preferred**
* Prior experience with data annotation, data quality, or evaluation systems
* Proficiency in engineering software concepts (e.g., SolidWorks, MATLAB, ANSYS) to evaluate AI\-generated code or workflows.


**Why Join Us**
* Competitive pay and flexible remote work.
* Collaborate with a team working on cutting\-edge AI projects.
* Exposure to advanced LLMs and how they’re trained.
* Freelance perks: autonomy, flexibility, and global collaboration.
* Potential for contract extension.


**Application Process (Takes 15\-20 min)**
* Submit your resume
* Complete a short screening
* Project matching and onboarding


*PS: Our team reviews applications daily. Please complete your AI interview and application steps to be considered for this opportunity.*

title: Consultant - TB Diagnostics Expert, Infectious Disease – Tuberculosis
description:
PATH current employees \- please log in and apply
 **Here**
 PATH is a global nonprofit dedicated to achieving health equity. With more than 40 years of experience forging multisector partnerships and with expertise in science, economics, technology, advocacy, and dozens of other specialties, PATH develops and scales up innovative solutions to the world’s most pressing health challenges.
   

  

**About the Project: REACH Bangladesh**
 REACH Bangladesh — Integrated Molecular Diagnostics, Laboratory Systems Strengthening, Emergency Preparedness, and Integrated Laboratory Response Systems — is funded by the U.S. Department of State, Bureau of Global Health Security and Diplomacy (GHSD), and implemented by PATH. The award is a fixed amount award issued under the America First Global Health Strategy to ensure continuity of lifesaving health assistance and to support integrated, country\-led health systems programming, with an anticipated implementation period of approximately 10–12 months.
   

  

 Bangladesh continues to face a significant burden of tuberculosis and other priority infectious diseases, compounded by fragmented laboratory networks, limited decentralized diagnostic access, and gaps in emergency and outbreak\-response readiness at sub\-national levels. PATH will implement the Bangladesh component in close collaboration with the Government of Bangladesh — the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, the National Tuberculosis Programme (NTP), the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), and divisional and district health authorities — with BRAC and icddr,b as potential implementing and research partners. Coverage spans 30 districts across seven geographic clusters, alongside national and divisional coordination.
   

  

 The project is organized around three strategic priority areas: (1\) integrated molecular diagnostics and laboratory network strengthening; (2\) laboratory quality, biosafety and workforce excellence; and (3\) emergency preparedness and laboratory resilience — each delivered at national, regional, and district levels and supported by strengthened data systems, MIS, coordination, and learning.
   

  

**PATH is hiring a Consultant – TB Diagnostics Expert, based in India.**
 The Consultant – TB Diagnostics Expert, under the overall supervision of the Deputy Director – TB, South Asia, PATH, and in close coordination with the PATH Bangladesh country team and project leadership, will provide technical oversight and undertake preparatory and inception\-phase activities for the diagnostics, laboratory systems, and emergency preparedness workstreams of REACH Bangladesh. The consultant will bring regional expertise in molecular diagnostics, laboratory network optimization, quality assurance, and biosafety to support rapid start\-up, co\-design with government and donor stakeholders, and the development of technical packages, SOPs, and monitoring frameworks required for implementation.
   

  

**Specific Roles of this Position include\-**
* Provide technical oversight to the REACH Bangladesh diagnostics and laboratory workstreams, and support PATH teams and potential sub\-awardees in translating the co\-design workshop outputs into an approved inception workplan, staffing plan, implementation schedule, and coordination plan.
* Support preparatory work for updating the national laboratory network optimization plan for integrated HIV, TB and priority infectious diseases, and for developing an integrated molecular testing strategy leveraging existing GeneXpert, Truenat, and RT\-PCR platforms.
* Contribute technical inputs to the national roadmap for novel screening and diagnostic tools for TB — including CAD/AI\-assisted handheld X\-ray, N\-PoC, CRISPR, and repurposing of molecular infrastructure — and to the design of a tiered laboratory network defining testing menus and referral pathways.
* Guide preparatory design of decentralized molecular testing, district specimen collection hubs, specimen referral and transportation networks, QR\-code\-enabled sample referral tracking, electronic specimen tracking, and turnaround\-time monitoring, including outreach testing for hard\-to\-reach populations.
* Support development of the national laboratory quality improvement roadmap, updated biosafety guidelines, expansion of External Quality Assessment to peripheral facilities, competency frameworks, certification and leadership programmes, laboratory performance scorecards, and QA process indicators.
* Provide technical oversight for preparatory activities under emergency preparedness and laboratory resilience, including the integrated emergency laboratory preparedness plan, One Health laboratory coordination, harmonized SOPs and referral protocols, laboratory surge planning, rapid response laboratory teams, and simulation and tabletop exercise designs.
* Support integration of TB–DM–HIV testing pathways and alignment of diagnostic protocols with national algorithms and NTP/DGHS guidance.
* Provide technical inputs to MIS, dashboards, data quality assurance, and performance monitoring frameworks for diagnostic and laboratory indicators, including turnaround time, referral pathway performance, and quality improvement indicators.
* Support preparation for co\-creation and coordination engagements with the U.S. Embassy Dhaka, Government of Bangladesh counterparts, technical working groups, and partners, including preparation of agendas, technical briefs, presentations, and workshop documentation.
* Undertake travel to Bangladesh and within the region (approximately 20–30% of time) for co\-design workshops, stakeholder consultations, laboratory assessments, and technical review meetings, as required.
* Prepare periodic progress updates and document technical products, best practices, and lessons learned for internal and external sharing, in line with donor branding, reporting, and milestone verification requirements.
* Perform any other project\-related tasks assigned by the supervisor.


**Qualifications And Competencies Required**
* PhD or postgraduate degree in Public Health, Microbiology, Laboratory Sciences, Health Administration, or an equivalent discipline from a recognized university.
* Minimum 10 years of experience in public health programmes, of which at least 5 years should be in TB or infectious disease diagnostics, laboratory systems strengthening, or diagnostic network management at national or state/provincial level; regional or international experience preferred.
* Demonstrated expertise in molecular diagnostics (GeneXpert, Truenat, RT\-PCR), laboratory network optimization, specimen referral systems, external quality assessment, biosafety, and laboratory quality management systems.
* Familiarity with national TB diagnostic algorithms, laboratory accreditation and certification frameworks, and emergency preparedness and One Health approaches.
* Experience working with government counterparts, donors, and multi\-partner consortia; prior experience with U.S. Government\-funded programmes and milestone\-based reporting is an added advantage.
* Excellent technical writing skills, with a demonstrated ability to develop strategies, SOPs, guidelines, and donor\-ready technical documents.
* Fluency in English is required; working familiarity with Bangla is an advantage.
* Ability to communicate clearly, mentor, and work collaboratively across geographies and time zones under demanding timelines.


 The position requires travel to Bangladesh and within the region as per project needs. We are looking for a self\-motivated, hard\-working, energetic, and creative individual who is a good team player and is comfortable working in a fast\-paced and evolving environment.
   

  

**Location:** 
 India (Delhi preferred), with travel to Bangladesh
   

  

**Duration:** 
 From the date of joining to August 2027
   

  

**Reporting to:** 
 Deputy Director – TB, South Asia, PATH
   

  

 The candidate must have legal authorization to work in India.

* Hands\-on experience with Pinnacle 21 Community/Enterprise and a good understanding of data traceability.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (Customer-Facing | Prompt Engineering | AI Automation)
description:
**About This Job**
**MyOperator**
**Location:** 
 Greater Delhi Area, India
   

  

**Work Mode:** 
 On\-site
   

  

**Industry:** 
 Software Development,Telecommunications,IT Services and IT Consulting
   

  

**Job Description**
 About MyOperator
   

  

 MyOperator is a Business AI Operator and category leader that unifies WhatsApp, Calls, and AI\-powered chatbots \& voice bots into one intelligent business communication platform.Unlike fragmented communication tools, MyOperator combines automation, intelligence, and workflow integration to help businesses run WhatsApp campaigns, manage calls, deploy AI chatbots, and track performance — all from a single no\-code platform.Trusted by 12,000\+ brands including Amazon, Domino’s, Apollo, and Razor\-pay, MyOperator enables faster responses, higher resolution rates, and scalable customer engagement
   

  

 Role Summary
   

  

 We’re hiring a Front Deployed Engineer (FDE)—a customer\-facing, field\-deployed engineer who owns the end\-to\-end delivery of AI bots/agents.
   

  

 This role is “frontline”: you’ll work directly with customers (often onsite), translate business reality into bot workflows, do prompt engineering \+ knowledge grounding, ship deployments, and iterate until it works reliably in production.
   

  

 Think: solutions engineer \+ implementation engineer \+ prompt engineer, with a strong bias for execution.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Requirement Discovery \& Stakeholder Interaction


 Join customer calls alongside Sales and Revenue teams.Ask targeted questions to understand business objectives, user journeys, automation expectations, and edge cases.Identify data sources (CRM, APIs, Excel, SharePoint, etc.) required for the solution.Act as the AI subject\-matter expert during client discussions.
   

  

* Use Case \& Solution Documentation


 Convert discussions into clear, structured use case documents, including:Problem statement \& goals.Current vs. proposed conversational flows.Chatbot conversation logic, integrations, and dependencies.Assumptions, limitations, and success criteria.
   

  

* Customer Delivery Ownership


 Own deployment of AI bots for customer use\-cases (lead qualification, support, booking, etc.). Run workshops to capture processes, FAQs, edge cases, and success metrics. Drive the go\-live process: requirements through monitoring and improvement.
   

  

* Prompt Engineering \& Conversation Design


 Craft prompts, tool instructions, guardrails, fallbacks, and escalation policies for stable behavior. Build structured conversational flows: intents, entities, routing, handoff, and compliant responses. Create reusable prompt patterns and "prompt packs."
   

  

* Testing, Debugging \& Iteration


 Analyze logs to find failure modes (misclassification, hallucination, poor handling). Create test sets ("golden conversations"), run regressions, and measure improvements. Coordinate with Product/Engineering for platform needs.
   

  

* Integrations \& Technical Coordination


 Integrate bots with APIs/webhooks (CRM, ticketing, internal tools) to complete workflows. Troubleshoot production issues and coordinate fixes/root\-cause analysis.
   

  

 What Success Looks Like
   

  

 Customer bots go live quickly and show high containment \+ high task completion with low escalation.You can diagnose failures from transcripts/logs and fix them with prompt/workflow/knowledge changes.Customers trust you as the “AI delivery owner”—clear communication, realistic timelines, crisp execution.
   

  

 Requirements (Must Have)
   

  

 2–5 years in customer\-facing delivery roles: implementation, solutions engineering, customer success engineering, or similar.Hands\-on comfort with LLMs and prompt engineering (structured outputs, guardrails, tool use, iteration).Strong communication: workshops, requirement capture, crisp documentation, stakeholder management.Technical fluency: APIs/webhooks concepts, JSON, debugging logs, basic integration troubleshooting.Willingness to be front deployed (customer calls/visits as needed).
   

  

 Good to Have (Nice to Have)
   

  

 Experience with chatbots/voicebots, IVR, WhatsApp automation, conversational AI platforms with at least a couple of projects.Understanding of metrics like containment, resolution rate, response latency, CSAT drivers.Prior SaaS onboarding/delivery experience in mid\-market or enterprises.
   

  

 Working Style \& Traits We Value
   

  

 High agency: you don’t wait for perfect specs—you create clarity and ship.Customer empathy \+ engineering discipline.Strong bias for iteration: deploy → learn → improve.Calm under ambiguity (real customer environments are chaotic by default).
